# Gap map — the design system reference versus the product (#195, step 00)

14.09.2026 · read-only reconnaissance, no code changed · task: [`prompt-00-rozpoznanie.md`](prompt-00-rozpoznanie.md) · product state: `main` at `a8032d3` · reference: the design system export in `design/` of 14.09.2026

**Contents:** [Summary](#summary) · [1. Tokens](#1-tokens) · [2. Components](#2-components) · [3. Screens](#3-screens) · [4. Dictionaries](#4-dictionaries) · [5. E2E tests](#5-e2e-tests) · [6. Contradictions](#6-contradictions) · [7. Proposed PR split](#7-proposed-pr-split)

## How to read this map

**What is compared.** The reference is the design system export in `design/`: tokens, components with their `.d.ts` and `.prompt.md`, the two UI kits and the readme. The product is `src/`, `messages/`, `e2e/`, the database schema and `docs/ui-specification.md`, which describes today's interface with element IDs `V-*` (views), `C-*` (shared components), `D-*` (decisions) and `F-*` (findings).

**Which source wins.** For the target:
- [`00-decyzje-2026-09-14.md`](00-decyzje-2026-09-14.md) (decisions of 14.09) wins over [`claude-code-prompt-195.md`](../claude-code-prompt-195.md) (the direction of 13.09).
- Both win over `docs/ui-specification.md`, which describes today.
- Measurements are read from the reference code.

Where these sources disagree and the precedence does not settle it, the point is listed in section 6 and left open.

**Citations.** Every measurement from the reference is cited as `design/<path>:<line>`, every product fact as `src/<path>:<line>` (or `e2e/…`, `messages/…`, `docs/…`). Line numbers are valid for commit `a8032d3` and the export of 14.09. Product copy is quoted literally in its original language: Polish strings stay Polish, in „ ” quotes, sometimes with an English gloss.

**How it was checked.**
- Each part was written by one agent that read its reference and product files in full.
- A second agent then checked the part: 3,950 citations checked, 137 corrections made.
- 441 contradictions recorded along the way were merged into 212 distinct ones.
- Each was checked against its sources: 117 were rejected, with the reason kept in section 6. 95 were confirmed; two of them have since been settled by Dawid (Q-A06, path and language; Q-A07, screenshots in the repository), so 93 remain open.
- The 14 recorded later for the other components were checked the same way: 3 repeat open items, and 11 were rejected.
- A final pass looked for gaps against the acceptance criterion of prompt 00; what it found was patched.

**Limits.**
- Nothing was run: no build, no dev server, no browser, no tests. Where a claim needs a running app (for example, how Next.js routes `/en/settings/unknown` once `[handle]/[slug]` exists), it is marked *unverified*.
- The reference screenshots of prompt 01 do not exist yet. Where a part says "no reference shot", the target rests on reading the JSX alone.

**Deviations from prompt 00.**
- The map is written in English, following the repository rule confirmed by Dawid on 14.09.2026.
- It lives at `design/docs/handoff/00-gap-map.md`, next to the other handoff files, instead of `design/handoff/00-mapa-luk.md`.
- Section 2 also maps the reference components the re-skinned screens are built from (Card, Badge, Divider, TextLink, TopBar, LocaleSwitcher, EmptyState, StatusMessage, HandleField, PhotoUpload, the brand mark).
- Section 7 corrects the proposed order; see 7.3.

## Summary

- **Tokens (section 1).** 158 tokens in the reference.
  - The weights (`--fw-*` 300…800 → 350…850), the weights inside the `--type-*` shorthands and the radius scale (`--radius-xs` … `--radius-2xl`, roughly doubled) differ.
  - Missing from the product: all motion tokens, `--radius-picture` and `--measure-works`.
  - The bare neutral names `--n-*` exist only as `--color-n-*`.
  - The radius scale lives in Tailwind's `@theme`, so the port changes every `rounded-*` utility in the app at once.
- **Components (section 2).** The profile's building blocks are new: ProfileBar, AboutPanel, WorkCard, OrbitTile. Avatar and Plaque are rebuilt (avatar shape; a sign that grows instead of shrinking). The rest is re-skinned or rebuilt as the summary table in section 2 says.
- **Screens and data (section 3).**
  - The work's landing page `/{handle}/{slug}` does not exist today. Creating, editing and deleting a work moves there.
  - The profile becomes one page for every viewer, with no global edit mode.
  - Five stored fields are missing today: `works.slug`, `works.card_layout`, `works.r360_autorotate`, `works.description`, `profiles.avatar_shape`. That is a backend change, and 3.2 lists what every migration must respect.
- **Dictionaries (section 4).** Keys to add, change and delete with literal texts. Rows that depend on an open contradiction are kept apart under "Contested — wait for section 6".
- **E2E (section 5).** 133 selectors or assertions break: 106 in the database project, 27 in the other. There are 22 flows with no test today that the redesign needs.
- **Contradictions (section 6).** 93 open, 18 of them block work. The blocking ones are listed below.
- **PR split (section 7).** 13 pull requests (PR 0–12) instead of five steps.
  - A shell PR for menus, language chip, footer and skip link follows the primitives.
  - A data PR comes before any works screen.
  - The work page comes before the profile.
  - The re-skins of sign-in, onboarding and settings move early.

### Notes on the token table

The table above compares the 158 custom properties in `design/tokens/*.css` with `src/app/globals.css`. These notes say what a 1:1 port does to the product, with evidence. "Port" means replacing the `@theme` / `:root` values of `src/app/globals.css` with the design system's values, as `design/docs/claude-code-prompt-195.md:33` (§2) asks. The 14.09 decisions leave the tokens alone (`design/docs/handoff/00-decyzje-2026-09-14.md:50`, section E).

Tailwind references below are to the installed package, version 4.3.3 (`node_modules/tailwindcss/package.json`, found from `D:/platform-lite/node_modules`). `globals.css:9` imports `node_modules/tailwindcss/index.css`.

#### 1.0 Checking the generated table

Every row was checked against the source lines: all 45 rows that are not "identical" and all 113 "identical" rows, multi-line declarations included. **No row has a wrong value or a wrong file.** Five points make the table more precise:

1. **A multi-line declaration is cited by its first line.** Examples: `--font-mono` `src/app/globals.css:29–30`, `--shadow-sm` `:85–86`, `--shadow-md` `:87–88`, `--shadow-lift` `:89–90`, `--ring-focus-inverse` `:155–156`. Each `--type-hero` … `--type-h4`, `--type-lead` and `--type-body` covers two lines (`:236–251`).
2. **"Only in globals.css: none" is true only for the 158 design names.** `globals.css` also declares 27 `--color-*` names that `design/tokens/` does not have:
   - `--color-n-0` … `--color-n-950` (`src/app/globals.css:40–53`);
   - `--color-plaque-*` (`:55–59`);
   - `--color-state-*` (`:61–68`).
   Tailwind builds its colour utilities from these names. The `n-*` and `plaque-*` utilities are in use today (see 1.4); no `*-state-*` utility is used in `src/` (state colours are read through the bare `--state-*` aliases).
3. **Some rows read "identical" but compute a different value after a port**, because the token they point at changes:
   - `--type-h4` goes from 600 to 650. `--type-body`, `--type-sm` and `--type-mono` go from 400 to 450. Their shorthands match, but `--fw-*` does not.
   - `--radius-control` goes from 6 to 12 px, `--radius-card` from 8 to 16 px, `--radius-panel` from 20 to 28 px. The alias is the same; the value it points at changes.
   - The semantic colours (`--text-*`, `--surface-*`, `--border-*`, `--action-*`, `--focus-ring`) read `var(--n-*)` in `design/tokens/colors.css:15–20` and `var(--color-n-*)` in `src/app/globals.css:124–146`. They stay equal only while both name sets exist.
4. **"Missing from globals.css" does not always mean absent from Tailwind's theme.** Tailwind's built-in theme source already declares two of the motion names, and nothing in `globals.css` overrides them. Whether they exist at run time is **unconfirmed** (no build was run): Tailwind 4 writes a theme variable that is not declared `static` into the built CSS only when a utility uses it (the `static` theme option is parsed in `node_modules/tailwindcss/dist/lib.js`), and the `ease-in` / `ease-out` utilities have 0 uses in `src/`, so the two names are probably undefined in the served CSS today:
   - `--ease-in: cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 1, 1)` (`node_modules/tailwindcss/index.css:444`). This is the same curve as `design/tokens/motion.css:8`.
   - `--ease-out: cubic-bezier(0, 0, 0.2, 1)` (`node_modules/tailwindcss/index.css:445`). This is a **different** curve from `design/tokens/motion.css:7` `cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1)`.
5. **Some Tailwind defaults have no design token and stay as they are after a port:**
   - radii `--radius: 0.25rem` (used by bare `rounded`), `--radius-3xl: 1.5rem`, `--radius-4xl: 2rem` (`node_modules/tailwindcss/index.css:530, 407–408`);
   - shadows `--shadow-2xs`, `--shadow-lg`, `--shadow-xl`, `--shadow-2xl` (`:410, 415–419`);
   - weights `--font-weight-light` … `--font-weight-extrabold` (300 … 800, `:380–385`).

   `src/` uses none of the radius or shadow keys in this list. For the weights, see 1.3.

**Where tokens live, and which Tailwind names they share.** Tailwind puts its own theme into `@layer theme` (`node_modules/tailwindcss/index.css:1–4`). The `:root` block of `globals.css` (`src/app/globals.css:94–256`) is outside any layer. CSS cascade layers give an unlayered declaration priority over a layered one. So a design token placed in plain `:root` under a Tailwind theme name replaces Tailwind's value for every utility that reads that variable. The names involved are `--font-sans`, `--font-mono`, `--radius-xs` … `--radius-2xl`, `--shadow-xs` … `--shadow-md`, `--ease-in` and `--ease-out`. Today `--radius-*` and `--shadow-xs/sm/md/lift/plaque` are deliberately in `@theme` (`src/app/globals.css:70–92`; the comments at `:70–72` and `:81–83` say so).

#### 1.1 Radius — every `rounded-*` changes with the tokens

`--radius-xs` … `--radius-2xl` are Tailwind's own radius keys, declared in `@theme` (`src/app/globals.css:73–78`). Every `rounded-xs`, `rounded-sm`, `rounded-md`, `rounded-lg`, `rounded-xl` and `rounded-2xl` utility in the product therefore reads them. The 1:1 values are in `design/tokens/radius.css:5`.

| `rounded-lg` / `-xl` / `-2xl` | 12 / 20 / 28 px | 20 / 28 / 36 px | 0 | — |
| `rounded-full` | pill | pill (`--radius-full` identical) | 22 in 12 files | Not affected |

Altogether 33 utilities in 21 files change radius the moment `--radius-xs/sm/md` change. Every consumer of `Card`, `Button`, `Input` and `Textarea` changes with them.

**Pictures clipped by the card.** Work-card pictures have no radius of their own today. `WorkCard` in `src/app/[locale]/(public)/[handle]/works-gallery.tsx:313–326` is a `Card` (`rounded-md`, `overflow-hidden`) that clips the picture strip. After the port those photo corners become 16 px. `design/tokens/radius.css:3–4` names exactly that as the thing to avoid ("a photograph is not a card").

**Radius keys the design system does not define.**
- Bare `rounded`, `rounded-3xl`, `rounded-4xl`: **0 uses** in `src/`.

  - `borderRadius: size * RADIUS_RATIO` with `RADIUS_RATIO = 4 / 30` in `src/app/brand-mark.tsx:24, 62`. The comment at `:19` says "--radius-xs, 4px". It draws the tab icon at 32 px, giving a 4.27 px radius (`src/app/icon.tsx:6`), and the iOS icon at 180 px, giving 24 px (`src/app/apple-icon.tsx:6`). After the port the browser mark has 8 px on 30 px, while these images keep 4/30.

**Places still at 4 or 6 px** (prompt-195 §1.2: "Nothing in the interface is 4 or 6 px any more", `design/docs/claude-code-prompt-195.md:24`).
- Today, all 3 `rounded-xs` uses are 4 px and all 18 `rounded-sm` uses are 6 px. The port moves them to 8 / 12 px with no class edits.

- `src/components/ui/card.tsx:27` ("8px radius");

#### 1.3 Weights — what follows `--fw-*` and what does not

After the port the variable font is requested one half-step heavier. Figtree is loaded as the range `wght@0,300..900` (`src/app/globals.css:8`), which covers 350 and 850. Prompt-195 §1.1 gives the roles: headings 750, body 450, labels and buttons 650, hero 850 (`design/docs/claude-code-prompt-195.md:23`).

| Token | Today | After the port | Shorthand weight today → after |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `--fw-light` | 300 | 350 | — |
| `--fw-regular` | 400 | 450 | `--type-body`, `--type-sm`, `--type-mono`: 400 → 450; `--type-lead`: 400 → **550** (switches to `--fw-medium`) |
| `--fw-medium` | 500 | 550 | `--type-label`: 500 → **650** (switches to `--fw-semibold`) |
| `--fw-semibold` | 600 | 650 | `--type-h4`: 600 → 650 |
| `--fw-bold` | 700 | 750 | `--type-display`, `--type-h1`, `--type-h2`, `--type-h3`: 600 → **750** (switch to `--fw-bold`); `--type-eyebrow`: 600 → **750** |
| `--fw-black` | 800 | 850 | `--type-hero`: 600 → **850** (switches to `--fw-black`) |

Sources: `design/tokens/typography.css:23–40`, `src/app/globals.css:230–255`.

| `src/components/ui/text-link.tsx:19, 29` (`TextLink`, `textButtonClassName`) | `font-medium` = 500, overriding `type-sm` | `var(--fw-semibold)` = 650 (`design/components/navigation/TextLink.jsx:19`) |
| `src/app/[locale]/(auth)/two-factor/two-factor-challenge.tsx:24` (selected method) | `font-semibold` = 600 | — |
| `src/app/[locale]/(public)/[handle]/works-gallery.tsx:680` (work name in the lightbox) | `font-medium` = 500 | — |
| `src/components/ui/orbit-ring.tsx:410` (cue label) | `font-medium` = 500 | — |
| `src/app/[locale]/(public)/[handle]/work-form.tsx:1255, 1260, 1449, 1642`; `r360-params.tsx:298` (a quiet part inside a `type-label` line) | `font-normal` = 400 | The parent `type-label` goes 500 → 650, so the step between the two parts grows from 100 to 250 |

**Inline weights outside CSS tokens.** These are drawn by `next/og`, not by the browser, and do not change:
- `fontWeight: 700` at `src/app/brand-mark.tsx:66`, with the committed static `public/figtree-bold.ttf` at weight 700 (`src/app/brand-mark.tsx:39, 44`);
- `fontWeight: 600` at `src/app/api/og/[handle]/route.tsx:72`.

**The plaque reads `--fw-*` for a font with only two weights.**
- `src/components/ui/plaque.tsx:84` sets the name to `fontWeight: "var(--fw-regular)"`: 400 today, **450** after the port.
- `src/components/ui/plaque.tsx:104` sets the red band to `var(--fw-medium)`: 500 today, **550** after the port.
- Fira Sans Condensed is loaded only at `wght@400;500` (`src/app/globals.css:8`).
- The reference uses literal numbers instead: `fontWeight: 400` for the name (`design/components/core/Plaque.jsx:57`) and `fontWeight: 500` for the band (`:64`).
- Prompt-195 §1.3: "Regular 400 (never bold; do not use the 450/550 Figtree weight tokens — the font ships at 400/500 only …)" (`design/docs/claude-code-prompt-195.md:25`).
- The comment at `src/components/ui/plaque.tsx:4–6` claims the token names "match this project's globals.css 1:1, so the port changes only JSX/casing, never a value". After the port that stops being true for the weights.

**Mono text lands between loaded weights.** IBM Plex Mono is loaded only at `wght@400;500;600` (`src/app/globals.css:8`). After the port, `font-mono` text that takes its weight from `type-sm`/`type-body`, and anything using `--type-mono`, asks for 450, which is not loaded. Under CSS Fonts Level 4 font matching, a request between 400 and 500 checks heavier faces up to 500 first, so the 500 face would render. The places:
- `src/components/ui/input.tsx:14` (`mono` inputs: handle and two-factor codes);
- `src/app/[locale]/(app)/handle-form.tsx:383` (inside a `type-sm` paragraph, `:381`);
- `two-factor-settings.tsx:215, 306`;
- `work-form.tsx:1464`;
- `works-gallery.tsx:681` (inside a `type-sm` paragraph, `:679`);
- `upload-progress.tsx:61` in its non-compact form (`type-sm`, `:62`).

Two `font-mono` places take their weight from `type-eyebrow` instead, which goes from 600 today to 750 after the port: `orbit-ring.tsx:424` (the frame counter) and the compact form of `upload-progress.tsx:61–62`. 750 is above Plex Mono's heaviest loaded face (600); under the same matching rules no heavier face exists, so the 600 face would render.

#### 1.5 Motion tokens — missing, and what `src/` has instead

None of the nine motion tokens exists in `globals.css`. The kit uses these (`design/components`, `design/ui_kits`; token files not counted):
- `var(--dur-1)` 3×, `var(--dur-2)` 5×, `var(--dur-3)` 10×, `var(--dur-4)` 0×;
- `var(--ease-standard)` 18×, `var(--ease-out)` 0×, `var(--ease-in)` 0×;
- `var(--transition-control)` 8×: `Button.jsx:74`, `IconButton.jsx:23`, `Input.jsx:40, 55`, `TextLink.jsx:23`, `OrbitTile.jsx:161`, `Hero.jsx:35`, `WorkPage.jsx:46`. `design/tokens/base.css:5` adds a ninth, on every link.
- `var(--transition-surface)` 1×: `design/components/core/Card.jsx:18`.

The new-profile motion in the kit:
- `design/components/profile/ProfileBar.jsx:41` — bar background, border and colour over `--dur-2`;
- `ProfileBar.jsx:54` — colour over `--dur-2`;
- `ProfileBar.jsx:60, 61` — label crossfade, opacity and transform over `--dur-3`;
- `ProfileBar.jsx:63` — chevron transform `--dur-3` plus background `--dur-2`;
- `design/components/profile/AboutPanel.jsx:57` — border colour `--dur-1`;
- `AboutPanel.jsx:165` — panel transform and shadow `--dur-3`;
- `design/components/profile/WorkCard.jsx:26` — photo `scale(1.02)` on hover, `--dur-3`;
- `design/ui_kits/public-web/PublicProfile.jsx:178` — the name beside the avatar fading, opacity and transform `--dur-3`;
- `design/ui_kits/public-web/WorkPage.jsx:47` — switch knob `left`, `--dur-1`;
- `WorkPage.jsx:100` — dragged thumbnail opacity, `--dur-1`.

In the kit, only `design/components/profile/OrbitTile.jsx:30` checks `prefers-reduced-motion`. Prompt-195 §6.7 says motion is "everywhere: 120 / 180 / 280 ms, one curve … everything gated by `motion-safe:`/`prefers-reduced-motion`" (`design/docs/claude-code-prompt-195.md:187`).

| `src/components/ui/upload-progress.tsx:56` | `motion-safe:animate-pulse` while processing | `pulse 2s cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.6, 1) infinite` (`node_modules/tailwindcss/index.css:450`) | No token. `design/readme.md:156–157`: "no skeleton shimmer … A busy control changes its label" |
| `src/components/ui/orbit-cues.tsx:111–114` | Deliberately **no** colour transition on cue buttons ("a fade between the two tones passes through ones that cannot be read (axe caught one mid-way in the lightbox)") | none | The reference cue buttons use `--transition-control` (`OrbitTile.jsx:161`) |

| `src/app/[locale]/(public)/[handle]/owner-profile-view.tsx:78, 141, 1114, 1242`; `src/app/[locale]/(app)/handle-form.tsx:24` | Order save debounce 300 ms, saved notice 2500 ms, place search debounce 250 ms, suggestion list closes 120 ms after blur; handle availability check debounce 400 ms | `setTimeout` | Timing, not animation |

`motion-reduce:` has 0 uses; `motion-safe:` has 1 (`upload-progress.tsx:56`). `ease-*`, `duration-*` (other than the one above), `delay-*` and `animate-*` (other than `animate-pulse`) have 0 uses.

If `--ease-out` is ported into plain `:root`, it also replaces Tailwind's `ease-out` utility curve (see 1.0, point 4). `ease-out` has 0 uses in `src/` today.

#### 1.6 `--measure-works` and the measures in use

`--measure-works: 100rem` (`design/tokens/spacing.css:11`) is missing. The kit reads it three times:
- the profile `<main>`: `design/ui_kits/public-web/PublicProfile.jsx:185`;
- the avatar's left edge: `max(padX, calc((100% - var(--measure-works)) / 2 + padX))` at `PublicProfile.jsx:151`;
- the work page `<main>`: `design/ui_kits/public-web/WorkPage.jsx:180`.

Measures used in `src/` today:

| Measure | Where |
| --- | --- |
| `--measure-page` (68rem) | Profile `<main>`: `src/app/[locale]/(public)/[handle]/page.tsx:242`, `owner-profile-view.tsx:612`. Plaque row: `page.tsx:307`, `owner-profile-view.tsx:1026`. `TopBar`/`Footer` with `maxWidth="measure-page"`: `page.tsx:204, 237, 315`, `owner-profile-view.tsx:582`, `src/app/[locale]/(app)/settings/account/page.tsx:76`. Class built by `src/components/ui/layout.ts:7–9`. The cover's `sizes` attribute also says `68rem` (`profile-sections.tsx:30`) |
| `--measure-wide` (78rem) | Default width of `TopBar` and `Footer` (`src/components/ui/top-bar.tsx:20`, `footer.tsx:9`, through `layout.ts:9`); homepage hero column (`src/app/[locale]/(public)/page.tsx:146`) |

Prompt-195 §4.1 item 4 puts the profile footer at `measure-wide` (`design/docs/claude-code-prompt-195.md:81`); the product profile footer is `measure-page` today (`page.tsx:315`). `layout.ts` accepts only `"measure-wide" | "measure-page"` (`src/components/ui/layout.ts:1`).

#### 1.7 The `.type-*` classes (`src/app/globals.css:258–310`)

- **Names.** The 12 classes map 1:1 onto the 12 `--type-*` shorthands in `design/tokens/typography.css:29–40`. No class lacks a token, and no token lacks a class.
- **Values.** Every class body reads `font: var(--type-*)`, so a port of `--fw-*`/`--type-*` alone changes the classes' weights, with no edit to the classes.
- **The reference has no classes of its own.** A search of `design/` for `.type-` selectors finds none. It sets `font: var(--type-*)` inline and pairs letter-spacing itself.

Prompt-195 §2 says "Delete `.type-*` classes that no longer match and regenerate them from `--type-*`" (`design/docs/claude-code-prompt-195.md:33`). The sources do not say which classes "no longer match". The comparison, class by class:

| Class | `globals.css` letter-spacing / extra | Reference pairing | Uses in `src/` |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `.type-hero` `:263–266` | `--ls-hero` | `--ls-hero` (`design/ui_kits/public-web/Hero.jsx:100`, which also swaps size to `--fs-display` on a phone; the product does the same with `text-(length:--fs-display) sm:text-(length:--fs-hero)`, `src/app/[locale]/(public)/page.tsx:155`) | 1 |
| `.type-display` `:267–270` | `--ls-display` | `--ls-display` (`design/ui_kits/public-web/WorkPage.jsx:209`, which uses `--type-h1` on a phone) | 3 |
| `.type-h1` / `-h2` / `-h3` / `-h4` `:271–286` | `--ls-heading` | `--ls-heading` for h1/h2/h3 (5 + 1 + 8 inline pairings in `design/components`, `design/ui_kits` JSX, not counting lines that choose between two sizes, such as `WorkCard.jsx:86` and `PublicProfile.jsx:178`); h4 has no inline pairing | 4 / 3 / 8 / 7 |
| `.type-lead` / `-body` / `-sm` `:287–298` | `--ls-body` | No inline letter-spacing; inherited from `body{letter-spacing:var(--ls-body)}` (`design/tokens/base.css:3`) | 2 / 4 / 110 |
| `.type-label` `:299–301` | none | No inline letter-spacing; inherits `--ls-body` from `body` (`base.css:3`). Product `body` sets no letter-spacing, so labels get `normal` unless a parent sets it | 18 |
| `.type-mono` `:302–304` | none | same as label | 0 |
| `.type-eyebrow` `:305–309` | `--ls-caps`, `text-transform: uppercase` | `--ls-caps` (6 inline pairings) with `textTransform: "uppercase"` (e.g. `design/components/profile/AboutPanel.jsx:38`) | 14 |

**The reference `Button` does not use `--type-label`; the product button uses `.type-label`.**
- **Reference.** `design/components/core/Button.jsx` never reads `var(--type-label)`. It sets the font in separate inline properties:
  - `fontFamily: "var(--font-sans)"` (`design/components/core/Button.jsx:68`);
  - `fontSize: s.font` (`design/components/core/Button.jsx:69`), taken from the size table: `var(--fs-sm)` for `md`, `var(--fs-body)` for `lg` (`design/components/core/Button.jsx:4–5`);
  - `fontWeight: "var(--fw-semibold)"` (`design/components/core/Button.jsx:70`);
  - `letterSpacing: "var(--ls-body)"` (`design/components/core/Button.jsx:71`).

  No `lineHeight` is set in the component's style object (`design/components/core/Button.jsx:59–79`).
- **Product.** Every `Button` and `ButtonLink` gets the class `type-label` from the shared base string (`src/components/ui/button.tsx:8`, joined in `buttonClassName` at `src/components/ui/button.tsx:31–37`). That class is `font: var(--type-label)` (`src/app/globals.css:299–301`), and `--type-label` is `var(--fw-medium) var(--fs-sm) / 1.4 var(--font-sans)` today (`src/app/globals.css:253`). The class sets no letter-spacing. The size variants change only the height (`src/components/ui/button.tsx:10–13`), so `lg` text is also `--fs-sm`.
- **Field by field, after a 1:1 port of the token values** (`design/tokens/typography.css:21, 26, 38`):

  | Property | Product button (`.type-label`) | Reference `Button` |
  | --- | --- | --- |
  | Weight | `--fw-medium` 500 today; `--fw-semibold` 650 after the port, because the ported `--type-label` reads `--fw-semibold` | `--fw-semibold` 650 |
  | Size, `md` | `--fs-sm` (.875rem) | `--fs-sm` (.875rem) |
  | Size, `lg` | `--fs-sm` (.875rem) | `--fs-body` (1rem) |
  | Line height | 1.4 | not set in the component |
  | Letter-spacing | none from the class (`normal` unless a parent sets it; see 1.8) | `--ls-body` (−.005em) |

  After the port the weight is the same number, reached through a different token. The `lg` size, the line height and the letter-spacing still differ.

#### 1.8 Element defaults: `design/tokens/base.css` versus `globals.css` and Tailwind Preflight

`design/styles.css:2–9` imports `base.css` last. `globals.css` has **no** element rules: no `html`, `body`, `a`, `:focus-visible` or `::selection` selectors (`src/app/globals.css:1–310`). The `<body>` has no class (`src/app/[locale]/layout.tsx:65`). The product's defaults are therefore Tailwind Preflight's, which sits in `@layer base` (`node_modules/tailwindcss/index.css:535`).

| Rule | Reference (`design/tokens/base.css`) | Product today |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Box sizing | `*,*::before,*::after{box-sizing:border-box}` (`:2`) | Preflight: same, plus `margin: 0; padding: 0; border: 0 solid` on every element (`node_modules/tailwindcss/preflight.css:7–16`) |
| `body` | `margin:0; background:var(--surface-page); color:var(--text-body); font:var(--type-body); letter-spacing:var(--ls-body); -webkit-font-smoothing:antialiased; text-rendering:optimizeLegibility` (`:3`), i.e. 450 1rem/1.6 Figtree, -.005em, `#262e36` on `#f6f8f9` | `html` line-height 1.5 and font-family `--default-font-family` → `--font-sans` (Figtree) (`preflight.css:28–47`; `node_modules/tailwindcss/index.css:504`). No weight, colour, background, letter-spacing or smoothing is set. Grey page ground only where a page sets it: `bg-(--surface-page)` on the auth shell (`src/app/[locale]/(auth)/shell.ts:16`), onboarding (`src/app/[locale]/(app)/onboarding/page.tsx:64`), 404 (`src/app/[locale]/not-found.tsx:38`) and the footer (`src/components/ui/footer.tsx:21`). The profile and settings pages set none. No `antialiased` or `text-rendering` anywhere in `src/` |
| Headings, paragraphs | `h1,h2,h3,h4,p{margin:0}` (`:4`) | Preflight zeroes all margins (`preflight.css:13`) and also resets heading `font-size`/`font-weight` to `inherit` (`preflight.css:78–86`) |
| Links | `a{color:var(--text-strong); text-decoration:underline; text-underline-offset:2px; text-decoration-thickness:1px; transition:var(--transition-control)}` (`:5`); `a:hover{text-decoration:none; color:var(--n-700)}` (`:6`) | Preflight: `a{color:inherit; text-decoration:inherit}` (`preflight.css:92–96`). Only `TextLink` sets an underline (`src/components/ui/text-link.tsx:19` `underline underline-offset-2 hover:no-underline`; `:29` without the offset). `no-underline` appears 3× in `src/`, all in `text-link.tsx`. Links rendered: 6 `<Link>` in 5 files, 7 `<ButtonLink>` in 4 files, 11 `<TextLink>` |
| Focus | `a,button,input,select,textarea,[tabindex]:focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--focus-ring); outline-offset:2px}` (`:7`). `design/readme.md:150–151`: "Focus is a 2px ink outline at 2px offset … (white on photographs)" | Box-shadow rings with the outline removed: `focus-visible:outline-none` 18× in 12 files, `focus:outline-none` 3×, `shadow-[var(--ring-focus)]` 23×, `shadow-[var(--ring-focus-inverse)]` 5× (see 1.2). Documented at `docs/ui-specification.md:5207`. No `outline-2`/`outline-offset-*` utilities in `src/` |
| Selection | `::selection{background:var(--n-900); color:var(--n-0)}` (`:8`) | None in `src/`; browser default |

**Cascade consequence of placing these rules.** Tailwind's order is `@layer theme, base, components, utilities` (`node_modules/tailwindcss/index.css:1`). CSS written in `globals.css` outside `@layer` beats every layered rule, whatever its specificity, so an unlayered copy of `base.css` would override utilities:
- `a{color:var(--text-strong)}` over the text colour of `ButtonLink`, whose `solid` variant sets `text-(--action-solid-text)` (`src/components/ui/button.tsx:22, 75`);
- `a{text-decoration:underline}` over every `ButtonLink`, `LogoMark` link (`src/components/ui/logo-mark.tsx:47–50`) and menu link, none of which has `no-underline`;
- the `:focus-visible` outline over the 18 `focus-visible:outline-none` utilities.

The kit's own links opt out inline, e.g. `textDecoration: "none"` on the work-card photo link (`design/components/profile/WorkCard.jsx:24`).

#### 1.9 Fonts

- **The import URL is byte-identical** in `design/tokens/fonts.css:5` and `src/app/globals.css:8` (checked by exact string comparison): `https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Figtree:ital,wght@0,300..900;1,300..900&family=Fira+Sans+Condensed:wght@400;500&family=IBM+Plex+Mono:wght@400;500;600&display=swap`.
- **The family stacks are identical** (table rows `--font-sans`, `--font-mono`, `--font-plaque`).
- **The load order matches: fonts first.** `globals.css` must keep the import before `@import "tailwindcss"` (comment `src/app/globals.css:4–7`). `design/styles.css:2` imports `fonts.css` first as well.
- **F-SHELL-18 stays open.** Fonts load at run time from Google, outside the EU/EEA (`docs/ui-specification.md:5223`). Prompt-195 keeps it open: "Keep loading from Google Fonts for now (F-SHELL-18 stays open, tracked separately); load Figtree as `wght@300..900`" (`design/docs/claude-code-prompt-195.md:23`); also §7 "Kept with a reason … `F-SHELL-18` (fonts — own issue)" (`:192`). The URL already loads Figtree as `300..900`, so a port does not touch F-SHELL-18.
- **The design-system docs describe the product's fonts as they were before.**
  - `design/tokens/fonts.css:1–2` says the product "ships no font binaries (it renders in the Tailwind default stack)";
  - the product commits `public/figtree-bold.ttf` (`src/app/brand-mark.tsx:39`) and overrides `--font-sans` with Figtree at `src/app/globals.css:25–28`;
  - the product's own comment at `src/app/globals.css:1–2` also still says "the product ships no font binaries", although `public/figtree-bold.ttf` exists.

#### 1.10 The `phone` custom variant versus the reference's breakpoint

- **Product.** `@custom-variant phone` = `@media (width < 40rem), (pointer: coarse) and (height < 32rem)` (`src/app/globals.css:15–19`). It is used 4× in `src/`, all in `src/app/[locale]/(public)/[handle]/works-gallery.tsx`: `:742, 743` hide the ring; `:909, 910` set the lightbox orbit's height. The spec defines three screen values, `desktop` (≥ 40rem), `phone` (< 40rem) and `phone:` (`docs/ui-specification.md:53`), plus Tailwind's `sm` 40rem, `md` 48rem and `lg` 64rem (`:5215`).
- **Reference kit.** It has **no media query and no breakpoint at all**. A search of `design/components`, `design/ui_kits` and `design/tokens` for `@media`, `40rem` used as a breakpoint, `matchMedia` other than reduced motion, and `pointer: coarse` finds nothing. "Phone" is a boolean `phone` prop, set by the Tweaks panel's width switch (`design/ui_kits/public-web/index.html:43, 71`). The page renders inside a 390 × 844 px frame (`index.html:9, 60`). The **`(pointer: coarse) and (height < 32rem)` clause does not exist anywhere in the kit.** Only the type declarations name a width: `design/components/profile/AboutPanel.d.ts:29` ("Drawer variant for narrow screens (< 40rem)") and `design/components/profile/WorkCard.d.ts:28` ("Stacked variant for narrow screens (< 40rem)"); the JSX behind them takes the boolean `phone`.
- **Direction documents.**
  - Prompt-195 §1.5: "Breakpoint `sm` (40rem) is the line between `phone` and `desktop` as §1 of the spec defines them" (`design/docs/claude-code-prompt-195.md:27`).
  - §2: "Keep the `phone:` variant" (`:33`).
  - §5.2 item 6: the work-page orbit's ring is "never on `phone:`" (`:146`).
  - §4.3: the about panel is "open on load (≥ 64rem)" on desktop, "closed on load" on a phone (`:113`), repeated in `design/components/profile/AboutPanel.prompt.md:9`.
  - `design/readme.md:111–112`: "Below 40rem everything stacks and the panel becomes a drawer, closed on load".
  - Decision C2: "Telefon zachowuje się jak desktop" (glossed: the phone behaves like the desktop) for the panel's layering (`design/docs/handoff/00-decyzje-2026-09-14.md:35`).
- **What follows.** A phone held sideways (for example 844 × 390 px) matches both `sm:` (width ≥ 40rem) and `phone:` (coarse pointer, height < 32rem). The kit has no such state to compare against.

**Contradictions touching this part (section 6):** Q-B02 — Focus indicator: base.css outline or box-shadow ring; Q-D01 — Monogram colours: white on --n-900 versus the stone palette; Q-E04 — Panel open on load from 64rem, phone line at 40rem

### Avatar

| reference file | equivalent in src | what to do | risks |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `design/components/core/Avatar.jsx`, `design/components/core/Avatar.d.ts`, `design/components/core/Avatar.prompt.md`; used in `design/ui_kits/public-web/PublicProfile.jsx` (page avatar, account-menu trigger), `design/components/profile/AboutPanel.jsx` (panel copy, edit controls), `design/ui_kits/public-web/WorkPage.jsx` (panel copy via AboutPanel, owner account-menu trigger), `design/ui_kits/app/ProfileEditor.jsx` (legacy editor, 128 px); not used in `Hero.jsx`, `NotFound.jsx`, `ProfileBar.jsx`, `Onboarding.jsx` | `src/components/ui/avatar.tsx` (+ `src/lib/monogram.ts`) | **rebuild** — the reference adds a second shape (`square`, radius stepped by size), a 1 px border, a sunken fill, a near-black monogram with a different initials rule and new sizes (176/120/96/40/32), none of which the round-only, border-less, stone-monogram product component has. | Four consumers change at once (visitor page, owner view, account menu on the profile and on settings) and a new data field `profiles.avatar_shape` is needed; changing the monogram palette or initials diverges from the share card (`/api/og/{handle}`) unless both change, and the e2e selectors that find the avatar inside `article` with its alt text stop matching. |

**Reference — dimensions and behaviour**

*The component itself*

- Props: `src`, `name` (default `""`), `size` (default `128`), `square` (default `false`), `alt`, `style`, plus any other attribute spread onto the element (`...rest`) — `design/components/core/Avatar.jsx:10`; typed as `src?: string | null`, `name?: string`, `size?: number`, `square?: boolean`, `alt?: string`, `style?: React.CSSProperties` — `design/components/core/Avatar.d.ts:5-16`.
- Documented sizes: „32 (top bar) · 48 (rows) · 128 (public profile) · 160 (editor). Default 128.” — `design/components/core/Avatar.d.ts:10`; „Sizes are fixed steps: 32 / 48 / 128 / 160.” — `design/components/core/Avatar.prompt.md:8` (the kit actually renders 176, 120, 96, 40 and 32 — see Placements and section 6).
- Box: `width` and `height` = `size` px, `flex: 0 0 auto` — `design/components/core/Avatar.jsx:12-14`; `box-sizing: border-box` comes from the global reset — `design/tokens/base.css:2` — so the border is inside `size`.
- Corner radius — circle (default): `var(--radius-avatar)` — `design/components/core/Avatar.jsx:15` = `var(--radius-full)` = `999px` — `design/tokens/radius.css:5-6`.
- Corner radius — `square`: `size >= 96` → `var(--radius-md)` (16 px); `48 <= size < 96` → `var(--radius-sm)` (12 px); `size < 48` → `var(--radius-xs)` (8 px) — `design/components/core/Avatar.jsx:15`, token values `design/tokens/radius.css:5`; the same rule in words: „Rounded square instead of a circle (radius scales with size: xs < 48, sm < 96, md above). The owner picks the shape once (`profile.avatarShape`) and every placement follows.” — `design/components/core/Avatar.d.ts:12`; decision B5 — `design/docs/handoff/00-decyzje-2026-09-14.md:27`.
- Border: `1px solid var(--border-default)` (`--n-200` `#d7dce0`) — `design/components/core/Avatar.jsx:16`, `design/tokens/colors.css:4,17`.
- Background under a photo: `var(--surface-sunken)` (`--n-100` `#eef1f3`) — `design/components/core/Avatar.jsx:17`, `design/tokens/colors.css:16`; `object-fit: cover` — `design/components/core/Avatar.jsx:18`; `style` prop spreads last and can override any of these — `design/components/core/Avatar.jsx:19`.
- With `src`: an `<img>` with `width`/`height` attributes = `size` and `alt={alt || name}` — an empty-string `alt` falls back to the name — `design/components/core/Avatar.jsx:21`; `.d.ts`: „Display name — the monogram's initials come from it and it is the alt text.” — `design/components/core/Avatar.d.ts:9`.
- Without `src` (monogram): a `<div aria-hidden="true">`, flex-centred — `design/components/core/Avatar.jsx:23-29`; background `var(--n-900)` (`#161c22`), text `var(--n-0)` (`#ffffff`) — `design/components/core/Avatar.jsx:30-31`, `design/tokens/colors.css:4`; font `var(--font-sans)` (Figtree), weight `var(--fw-semibold)` (650), size `max(11, round(size × 0.34))` px, letter-spacing `var(--ls-heading)` (−0.018em) — `design/components/core/Avatar.jsx:32-35`, `design/tokens/typography.css:20,26`. Computed letter sizes: 176 → 60 px, 120 → 41 px, 96 → 33 px, 40 → 14 px, 32 → 11 px.
- Initials rule: trim, split on whitespace; no word → `""`; one word → its first two characters upper-cased; two or more words → first character of the first word + first character of the last word, upper-cased (`toUpperCase()`, no locale) — `design/components/core/Avatar.jsx:3-8`.
- Copy rules: „No photo means initials on `--n-900`, never a placeholder illustration.” — `design/components/core/Avatar.prompt.md:7`; „without one, initials in white on `--n-900` — the same monogram the product draws into its share card.” — `design/readme.md:124-125`.
- No hover, focus, disabled or animation of its own; interactivity always comes from a wrapping `<button>` (below). Focus on those buttons: `outline: 2px solid var(--focus-ring)`, `outline-offset: 2px` — `design/tokens/base.css:7`.

**Product today**

- `Avatar({ src, name, size = 128, alt = "", className = "" })`; `name` is required — `src/components/ui/avatar.tsx:3-11`, `:25`. No shape prop, no `style`, no rest-spread.
- Side is `var(--avatar-size, {size}px)` so a call site steps the size with a CSS variable (96 px phone / 128 px from `sm`) instead of a prop — `src/components/ui/avatar.tsx:18-27`.
- Photo: `<img>` with the caller's `alt` (default empty), `width`/`height` attributes = `size`, Tailwind `rounded-full object-cover`; no border, no background — `src/components/ui/avatar.tsx:28-39`.
- Monogram: `<div aria-hidden="true">`, background `#e7e5e4`, text `#57534e` (`MONOGRAM_BACKGROUND`/`MONOGRAM_FOREGROUND`), font size `calc(side × 0.34)` with no floor, Tailwind `font-semibold` utility (not the `--fw-semibold` token), `rounded-full`, no letter-spacing — `src/components/ui/avatar.tsx:41-54`, `src/lib/monogram.ts:14-15`.
- Initials: split on whitespace, `.`, `_`, `+`, `-`; the first **letter** of each part (a leading digit or symbol is skipped; a part with no letter at all is dropped), the first two such letters kept; upper-cased with `pl-PL`; e.g. „Kowalski” → „K” — `src/lib/monogram.ts:28-38`, `src/lib/monogram.test.ts:39`.
- The share card for a profile with no photo draws the same stone monogram, 512 × 512 — `src/app/api/og/[handle]/route.tsx:60-79`, `src/lib/monogram.ts:54`.
- Consumers:
  - Visitor profile card: 512 px variant, `size={128}`, `alt` = `PublicProfile.avatarAlt` („Zdjęcie profilowe {name}”), `[--avatar-size:96px] sm:[--avatar-size:128px]`, with a cover `-mt-(--sp-14) sm:-mt-(--sp-16)` and `ring-4 ring-(--surface-card)` — `src/app/[locale]/(public)/[handle]/page.tsx:269-279`, `messages/pl.json:433`, `messages/en.json:433`.

**Gaps to close**

1. Shape: reference has `square` with radius 8/12/16 px stepped at 48 and 96 px (`design/components/core/Avatar.jsx:15`, `design/tokens/radius.css:5`); product is round only (`src/components/ui/avatar.tsx:37`, `:50`). The square radii also depend on the tokens PR: product `--radius-xs/sm/md` are 4/6/8 px today (`src/app/globals.css:73-75`).

**Risks**

- Consumers that change: `src/app/[locale]/(public)/[handle]/page.tsx:26,269`, `src/app/[locale]/(public)/[handle]/owner-profile-view.tsx:7,699`, `src/components/ui/account-menu.tsx:7,64` (itself rendered at `src/app/[locale]/(public)/[handle]/owner-profile-view.tsx:604` and `src/app/[locale]/(app)/settings/account/page.tsx:79`). `src/lib/monogram.ts` is also read by `src/app/api/og/[handle]/route.tsx:5-8` — a palette or initials change on the page alone breaks „the share image is the same monogram” (`docs/ui-specification.md:2963`).

### Plaque

| reference file | equivalent in src | what to do | risks |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `design/components/core/Plaque.jsx`, `design/components/core/Plaque.d.ts`, `design/components/core/Plaque.prompt.md`, `design/guidelines/brand-plaque.card.html`; used in `design/components/profile/AboutPanel.jsx` (sticky panel footer, therefore on both `PublicProfile.jsx` and `WorkPage.jsx`) and `design/ui_kits/app/Onboarding.jsx`; not a component on `Hero.jsx` / `NotFound.jsx` (the plaque there is inside the photograph) | `src/components/ui/plaque.tsx` | **rebuild** — the sizing model is inverted: the product fits the name into a fixed width by shrinking the letters (and clips), the reference keeps the letters at one size (44 px, or 22 px at `scale 0.5`) and lets the sign grow, with different paddings, band size, props (`scale`, `minWidth`, `decorative` instead of `width`, `tilt`) and `aria-hidden`. | Long names (up to 80 characters) now produce very wide signs, so every host must scroll horizontally; the tokens PR changes `--fw-regular`/`--fw-medium` to 450/550, which the product plaque reads, so the lettering synthesises a heavier face unless the weights become literal 400/500. |

**Reference — dimensions and behaviour**

*Rules*

- One form: a tall navy field with one centred name, a red band underneath that always reads „Architektów 3d”; letters one fixed size, 44 px (the „Studio Praga” reference); the sign grows horizontally, never shrinks the letters, never wraps, never tilts; `scale` shrinks the whole sign only for a secondary placement (0.5 at the panel foot), never to fit a long name — `design/components/core/Plaque.jsx:3-9`, `design/components/core/Plaque.d.ts:1-8`, `design/components/core/Plaque.prompt.md:10-13`; rule #1 approved 13.09.2026, reference specimen — `design/guidelines/brand-plaque.card.html:1`, `:15`; `design/docs/claude-code-prompt-195.md:25`; `design/readme.md:235-239`; decisions leave §1.3 untouched — `design/docs/handoff/00-decyzje-2026-09-14.md:50`.
- „a host narrower than the sign scrolls it (`overflow-x: auto`)” — `design/components/core/Plaque.prompt.md:13`.
- „Never recolour it. The navy and red are the only saturated colours in the system” — `design/components/core/Plaque.prompt.md:15`; plaque colours „Never used for interface chrome” — `design/tokens/colors.css:6`.

**Risks**

- Consumers: `src/app/[locale]/(public)/[handle]/page.tsx:33,308`, `src/app/[locale]/(public)/[handle]/owner-profile-view.tsx:14,1027`, `src/app/[locale]/(app)/onboarding/onboarding-steps.tsx:10,118`. Removing `width`/`tilt` breaks all three call sites at compile time.
- Width: display names are 1–80 characters (`SPEC.md:55`); at 44 px a long name makes a sign far wider than the onboarding column (reference column `minmax(0,320px)` with no horizontal scroll — `design/ui_kits/app/Onboarding.jsx:34`, `:80`) and at 22 px wider than the panel (316 px of content at 380 px width with 32 px sides — `design/components/profile/AboutPanel.jsx:128`, `:145`, `:247`). The panel host is `display: flex; justify-content: center; overflow-x: auto` (`design/components/profile/AboutPanel.jsx:247`); a centred flex child that overflows may not be scrollable to its start edge — check in a browser.
- Tokens PR ordering: if tokens land before the Plaque rebuild, the product plaque reads `--fw-regular`/`--fw-medium` = 450/550 against a font loaded at 400/500 only (`src/components/ui/plaque.tsx:84`, `:104`; `design/tokens/typography.css:24-25`; `src/app/globals.css:8`) — the synthesised-weight effect the reference warns about (`design/components/core/Plaque.jsx:10-11`).
- The panel sticky footer: without `flex-shrink: 0` the footer was squashed to zero in the overflowing flex column (`design/docs/handoff/00-decyzje-2026-09-14.md:37`); `bottom: calc(-1 × padB)` depends on the panel's padding tokens (`design/components/profile/AboutPanel.jsx:144`, `:246-247`).
- At `scale 0.5` the red band text is 8 px (`16u`, `design/components/core/Plaque.jsx:63`) — the same order as today's 150 px sign (≈ 8.4 px, `src/components/ui/plaque.tsx:103`); the plaque is `aria-hidden`, but axe still runs on the page (`e2e/db/happy-path.spec.ts:244-246`), and a scrollable footer with no focusable content is a region axe may report.
- E2E: no test selects the plaque (`docs/ui-specification.md:611`, `:2941`, `:2252`).
- Decisions and findings: overturns `D-SHELL-11` (`design/docs/claude-code-prompt-195.md:25`, `:194`); resolves `F-SHELL-15` (`design/docs/claude-code-prompt-195.md:25`, `:122`); `F-SHELL-14` / `F-PROFILE-4` / `F-ACCOUNT-4` are named as resolved through `Brand.wordmark` (`design/docs/claude-code-prompt-195.md:122`) but the reference `Plaque` still carries literal defaults for `name` and `footer` (`design/components/core/Plaque.jsx:15-16`). Spec elements: `PROFILE.page.plaque` → moved to the panel (`design/docs/claude-code-prompt-195.md:122`); `ONBOARDING.plaque.sign` re-skinned (`design/docs/claude-code-prompt-195.md:183`).

**Reference — dimensions and behaviour**

*Button* (`design/components/core/Button.jsx`)
- Props from the contract: `variant` `"solid" | "quiet" | "ghost" | "onPhoto" | "onPhotoQuiet"` — solid = ink fill (primary), quiet = bordered, ghost = borderless, onPhoto / onPhotoQuiet = over the hero photo (`design/components/core/Button.d.ts:9-10`); `size` `"md"` = 40 px (forms) · `"lg"` = 48 px (hero, onboarding) (`design/components/core/Button.d.ts:11-12`); `fullWidth`, `disabled` (`design/components/core/Button.d.ts:13-14`); `loading` — "Shows the label you pass while a request is in flight and blocks input" (`design/components/core/Button.d.ts:15-16`); `href` renders an anchor (`design/components/core/Button.d.ts:17-18`); `type` `"button" | "submit"`, `onClick`, `style` (`design/components/core/Button.d.ts:19-21`). Defaults: `variant="solid"`, `size="md"`, `type="button"` (`design/components/core/Button.jsx:45-51`).
- Size `md`: height `var(--control-h)` = 40 px, padding `0 var(--control-pad-x)` = 0 16 px, font-size `var(--fs-sm)` = .875rem (14 px) (`design/components/core/Button.jsx:4`; `design/tokens/spacing.css:12`, `:16`; `design/tokens/typography.css:10`).
- Size `lg`: height `var(--control-h-lg)` = 48 px, padding `0 var(--sp-7)` = 0 24 px, font-size `var(--fs-body)` = 1rem (16 px) (`design/components/core/Button.jsx:5`; `design/tokens/spacing.css:13`, `:5`; `design/tokens/typography.css:9`).
- Box: `display: inline-flex`, centred on both axes, gap `var(--sp-3)` = 8 px between icon and label (`design/components/core/Button.jsx:60-63`); `width: 100%` only when `fullWidth` (`design/components/core/Button.jsx:66`); `border-radius: var(--radius-control)` = `--radius-sm` = 12 px (`design/components/core/Button.jsx:67`; `design/tokens/radius.css:5-6`); `white-space: nowrap` (`design/components/core/Button.jsx:75`); no line-height set (the fixed height governs).
- Type: `font-family: var(--font-sans)`, `font-weight: var(--fw-semibold)` = 650, `letter-spacing: var(--ls-body)` = -.005em, `text-decoration: none` (`design/components/core/Button.jsx:68-72`; `design/tokens/typography.css:21`, `:26`).
- Motion: `transition: var(--transition-control)` = background-color, border-color, color and box-shadow, each `var(--dur-1)` 120 ms `var(--ease-standard)` `cubic-bezier(.2,.6,.2,1)` (`design/components/core/Button.jsx:74`; `design/tokens/motion.css:2`, `:6`, `:9`).
- Every variant carries a 1 px border (transparent where not visible), so all variants share the same box (`design/components/core/Button.jsx:14`, `:20`, `:26`, `:32`, `:38`).
- `solid` (default): background `var(--action-solid)` (#0c1116), hover `var(--action-solid-hover)` (`--n-800` #262e36); text `var(--action-solid-text)` (white); border transparent (`design/components/core/Button.jsx:34-39`; `design/tokens/colors.css:18`). No pressed/active colour.
- `quiet`: background `var(--surface-card)` (white), hover `var(--action-quiet-hover)` (`--n-50`); text `var(--text-strong)`; border `var(--action-quiet-border)` (`--n-300`), hover `var(--border-strong)` (also `--n-300`) (`design/components/core/Button.jsx:10-15`; `design/tokens/colors.css:17`, `:19`).
- `ghost`: background transparent, hover `var(--surface-active)` (`--n-100`); text `var(--text-body)`; border transparent (`design/components/core/Button.jsx:16-21`; `design/tokens/colors.css:16`).
- `onPhoto`: background `rgba(255,255,255,.94)`, hover `var(--n-0)` (lighter, not darker); text `var(--n-950)`; border transparent (`design/components/core/Button.jsx:22-27`). The readme rule: "on-photo buttons go *lighter*, never darker" (`design/readme.md:146-148`).
- `onPhotoQuiet`: background transparent, hover `rgba(255,255,255,.14)`; text `var(--text-on-photo)` (#fff); border `1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.6)` (`design/components/core/Button.jsx:28-33`). The hero overrides this border to `rgba(255,255,255,.55)` (`design/ui_kits/public-web/Hero.jsx:104`).
- Hover is JavaScript state (`onMouseEnter`/`onMouseLeave`) and is suppressed while off (`design/components/core/Button.jsx:56`, `:76`, `:80-83`). "Nothing scales, shrinks or lifts on press — the colour change is the whole feedback" (`design/readme.md:149-150`).
- Disabled or loading ("off"): `cursor: not-allowed`, `opacity: 0.45`, native `disabled` on the `<button>` (`design/components/core/Button.jsx:58`, `:73`, `:77`, `:92`); readme: "Disabled is opacity 0.45 with the cursor blocked" (`design/readme.md:152`). No spinner: the caller passes the busy label, e.g. "Logging in…" (`design/components/core/Button.prompt.md:9`; `design/ui_kits/app/Auth.jsx:51`).
- `href` and not off → `<a href>` with the same style; off with `href` → a disabled `<button>` (`design/components/core/Button.jsx:84-95`).
- Focus: the component sets none; the global rule draws `outline: 2px solid var(--focus-ring)` at `outline-offset: 2px` on `button:focus-visible` and `a:focus-visible` (`design/tokens/base.css:7`). The readme adds "white on photographs" (`design/readme.md:150-151`).
- Usage rules: onPhoto / onPhotoQuiet are the hero pair, never the ink variants over the facade photo (`design/components/core/Button.prompt.md:8`); full-width buttons only in the 28rem form column (`design/components/core/Button.prompt.md:10`).
- Bar usage by tone: visitor desktop „Zaloguj się” is `onPhotoQuiet` over the cover and `ghost` once the bar is solid; „Załóż konto” is `onPhoto` → `solid` (`design/ui_kits/public-web/PublicProfile.jsx:126-127`). The hero bar uses `onPhotoQuiet` / `onPhoto` (`design/ui_kits/public-web/Hero.jsx:74-75`); its phone menu uses `quiet` / `solid` with `fullWidth` (`design/ui_kits/public-web/Hero.jsx:82-83`); the hero calls to action are `lg`, `fullWidth` on a phone (`design/ui_kits/public-web/Hero.jsx:103-104`). 404 „Wróć do domu” is `quiet` (`design/ui_kits/public-web/NotFound.jsx:5`, `:19`).
- Buttons with an icon child (icon first, then text, 8 px apart): „Zmień tło” — `onPhoto` + `image` 16 px `strong`, absolutely placed `right: padX` (24 px desktop / 12 px phone), `bottom: var(--sp-4)` (12 px), `z-index: 3`, only while editing (`design/ui_kits/public-web/PublicProfile.jsx:142`, `:180`). „+ Realizacja” — `quiet` + `plus` 16 px `strong` + text „Realizacja”, `position: absolute; top: gap` (24 px desktop / 16 px phone) `right: avatarLeft`, `z-index: 3`, owner in edit mode only (`design/ui_kits/public-web/PublicProfile.jsx:10`, `:153`, `:184`; decision B6, `design/docs/handoff/00-decyzje-2026-09-14.md:28`).
- Other kit usages: `ghost` „Cancel” (`design/ui_kits/app/ProfileEditor.jsx:62`), `lg` onboarding submit (`design/ui_kits/app/Onboarding.jsx:52`, `:73`), `quiet` settings actions aligned `flex-start` (`design/ui_kits/app/AccountSettings.jsx:46`), `ghost`/`solid` in the generic TopBar (`design/components/navigation/TopBar.jsx:99-100`), `quiet` photo chooser (`design/components/forms/PhotoUpload.jsx:22`).

*IconButton* (`design/components/core/IconButton.jsx`)
- Contract: "A square, borderless control carrying one Lucide glyph — overflow menus, close, copy" (`design/components/core/IconButton.d.ts:1`); `icon` Lucide name (`:3`), `label` required — accessible name and tooltip (`:5`), `size` box in px, glyph 45 %, default 40 (`:7`), `tone` `"quiet" | "bordered" | "onPhoto"` (`:9`), `onClick`, `style`. No `disabled` or `pressed` prop.
- `<button type="button" aria-label={label} title={label}>` (`design/components/core/IconButton.jsx:8-11`); remaining props are spread (the hero passes `aria-expanded`, `design/ui_kits/public-web/Hero.jsx:70`).
- Box: `width = height = size` (default 40 px), `inline-flex` centred, `border-radius: var(--radius-control)` = 12 px, `cursor: pointer`, `transition: var(--transition-control)` (`design/components/core/IconButton.jsx:4`, `:15-23`).
- Background: transparent at rest; hover `rgba(255,255,255,.14)` for `onPhoto`, `var(--surface-active)` otherwise (`design/components/core/IconButton.jsx:24-26`).
- Border: `1px solid var(--action-quiet-border)` for `bordered`, `1px solid transparent` otherwise (`design/components/core/IconButton.jsx:27`).
- Colour: `var(--text-on-photo)` for `onPhoto`, `var(--text-body)` otherwise; glyph `Icon` at `Math.round(size * 0.45)` (40 → 18 px, 32 → 14 px, 44 → 20 px) in the matching tone (`design/components/core/IconButton.jsx:28`, `:33`).
- Rules: the label is mandatory; `tone="onPhoto"` for the hero; `tone="bordered"` when it sits alone (`design/components/core/IconButton.prompt.md:7-8`).
- Where it is used: the hero's phone menu toggle, `icon` `x` when open and `menu` when closed, `tone="onPhoto"`, label „Menu główne” (`design/ui_kits/public-web/Hero.jsx:7`, `:70`); the legacy profile editor's name pencil „Edit display name” (`design/ui_kits/app/ProfileEditor.jsx:68`; the readme says that editor "predates the panel-based editing", `design/readme.md:195`); the specimen card (`design/components/core/core.card.html:19-20`).

*Inline round icon controls in the kit (not IconButton)* — unless noted, each is round (`border-radius: var(--radius-full)`, or a pixel radius of half its size), `inline-flex` centred, with no hover style and no transition, and carries `aria-label` equal to `title`; exceptions: the filmstrip move buttons have no `title` (item 12), the filmstrip add tile and the drop zones are not round (items 13–14, the drop zones are named by their visible text), the hamburger gets its `aria-label` from the popover and has no `title` (item 15), and the back link is a link (item 16):
1. Owner pencil in the profile bar: 40 × 40 px, `padding: 0`, `border: 0`, background `rgba(255,255,255,.94)`, colour `var(--n-950)`, `box-shadow: var(--shadow-md)`, glyph `pencil` 16 px `strong`; label „Edytuj profil”; `aria-pressed={editing}`; `disabled` while editing with `opacity: .5` and `cursor: default`; the same white look on the transparent and the solid bar (`design/ui_kits/public-web/PublicProfile.jsx:10`, `:138`; decision A4, `design/docs/handoff/00-decyzje-2026-09-14.md:12`). `--shadow-md` = `0 2px 8px rgba(12,17,22,.06), 0 1px 2px rgba(12,17,22,.04)` (`design/tokens/elevation.css:7`).
2. Work page pencil (owner, read-only): identical 40 px white-94 % `--shadow-md` button, `pencil` 16 `strong`, label „Edytuj”, no disabled state (`design/ui_kits/public-web/WorkPage.jsx:10`, `:165`; decision A8, `design/docs/handoff/00-decyzje-2026-09-14.md:16`).

Work card pencil (owner): `position: absolute; top: var(--sp-4); right: var(--sp-4)` (12 px), `z-index: 2`, 40 × 40, white 94 %, `--shadow-md`, `pencil` 16 `strong`, label "Edytuj: " + work name (hard-coded concatenation), anchored on the picture block in every layout (`design/components/profile/WorkCard.jsx:71-83`; decision B4, `design/docs/handoff/00-decyzje-2026-09-14.md:26`).

*Segmented control `Seg`* (work page edit, „Karta na profilu”)
- Track: `role="radiogroup"` with `aria-label` = the section label; `display: inline-flex; flex-wrap: wrap; padding: 3px; gap: 2px`; `border-radius: var(--radius-control)` (12 px); background `var(--surface-sunken)` (`design/ui_kits/public-web/WorkPage.jsx:30-32`).
- Segment: `<button role="radio" aria-checked>`; height 34 px, padding `0 var(--sp-4)` (0 12 px), `border: 0`, `border-radius: 9px`, `font: var(--type-label)`; selected → background `var(--surface-card)`, colour `var(--text-strong)`, `box-shadow: var(--shadow-sm)`; unselected → transparent, `var(--text-muted)`; unavailable → native `disabled`, `title` = the reason („Wymaga co najmniej trzech zdjęć.” / „Wymaga opisu.”), colour `var(--text-subtle)`, `opacity: .6`, `cursor: not-allowed` (`design/ui_kits/public-web/WorkPage.jsx:15`, `:33-38`). No arrow-key handling: each segment is its own Tab stop.
- Options „Okładka” · „Okładka + 2 miniatury” · „Okładka + opis” (`design/ui_kits/public-web/WorkPage.jsx:15`); a disabled current choice falls back to `cover` (`design/ui_kits/public-web/WorkPage.jsx:151-152`); the hint line under the row shows the reason while the stored choice is disabled (`design/ui_kits/public-web/WorkPage.jsx:204`).
- Row layout: `display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; align-items: center; gap: var(--sp-4) var(--sp-8)` (12 px / 32 px) (`design/ui_kits/public-web/WorkPage.jsx:200`).

*Switch `Toggle`* („R360 obraca się sam na profilu”, only when the work has an orbit)
- `<button role="switch" aria-checked>`, `inline-flex`, gap `var(--sp-3)` (8 px), `border: 0`, transparent, `padding: 0`, label in `--type-label` `--text-body` (`design/ui_kits/public-web/WorkPage.jsx:43-45`, `:202`).
- Track 40 × 24 px, radius 12, background `var(--n-950)` on / `var(--n-300)` off, `transition: var(--transition-control)`; knob `position: absolute; top: 3px; left: 19px` on / `3px` off, 18 × 18, radius 9, white, `transition: left var(--dur-1) var(--ease-standard)` (`design/ui_kits/public-web/WorkPage.jsx:46-47`).

*TextLink* (`design/components/navigation/TextLink.jsx`)
- Contract: "Inline or standalone link. Ink, semibold, underline on hover — never blue" (`design/components/navigation/TextLink.d.ts:1`); `tone` `"strong" | "muted" | "onPhoto"` (`:6`); `underline` `"hover" | "always"` — always inside a sentence, hover for standalone (`:7-8`); optional trailing `icon` (`:9-10`).
- Defaults `tone="strong"`, `underline="hover"` (`design/components/navigation/TextLink.jsx:4`); `display: inline` or `inline-flex` with an icon, gap 4 px (`:14-16`); colour `--text-on-photo` / `--text-muted` / `--text-strong` (`:17`); `font: inherit`, `font-weight: var(--fw-semibold)` (`:18-19`); `always` → underlined, removed on hover; `hover` → underline appears on hover (`:20`); `text-underline-offset: 2px`, `transition: var(--transition-control)` (`:21-23`); trailing icon 16 px (`:29`).
- Rules: running text uses `underline="always"`; on the hero photo `tone="onPhoto"` (`design/components/navigation/TextLink.prompt.md:8-9`); readme: "Links gain an underline on hover, or lose it if they were underlined in a sentence" (`design/readme.md:148-149`).

**Product today**
- `Button` variants `solid | quiet | onPhoto | onPhotoQuiet` — no `ghost` (`src/components/ui/button.tsx:4`); sizes `md | lg` (`src/components/ui/button.tsx:5`, `:10-13`: `h-(--control-h)` 40 px, `h-(--control-h-lg)` 48 px).
- Shared classes: `inline-flex`, centred, `gap-(--sp-3)` 8 px, `rounded-sm`, `px-(--control-pad-x)` 16 px for both sizes, `type-label`, `transition-colors`, `focus-visible:outline-none`, `disabled:cursor-not-allowed disabled:opacity-50` (`src/components/ui/button.tsx:7-8`). `rounded-sm` reads Tailwind's `--radius-sm`, which `@theme` sets to 6 px (`src/app/globals.css:74`); `.type-label` is `--fw-medium` (500 today) `--fs-sm`/1.4 with no letter-spacing (`src/app/globals.css:232`, `:253`, `:299-301`). `globals.css` defines no `--dur-*`, `--ease-*` or `--transition-*` token (`src/app/globals.css:1-310`).
- `solid`: `--action-solid` fill, `--action-solid-text`, hover `--action-solid-hover`, active `--action-solid-active`, focus ring `--ring-focus`; no border (`src/components/ui/button.tsx:21-22`).
- `quiet`: 1 px `--action-quiet-border`, transparent, `--text-body`, hover `--action-quiet-hover` (`src/components/ui/button.tsx:23-24`).
- `onPhoto`: opaque `--surface-card`, `--text-strong`, hover `n-100`, active `n-150` (darker), `--ring-focus-inverse` (`src/components/ui/button.tsx:25-26`).
- `onPhotoQuiet`: `border-white/55`, transparent, `--text-on-photo`, hover `white/10`, `--ring-focus-inverse` (`src/components/ui/button.tsx:27-28`).
- `Button` renders `<button type="button">` unless told otherwise and forwards `ref` (`src/components/ui/button.tsx:39-61`); `ButtonLink` renders next-intl `Link` with the same classes (`src/components/ui/button.tsx:63-77`); `buttonClassName` styles file-picker `<label>`s (`src/components/ui/button.tsx:31-37`; `src/app/[locale]/(public)/[handle]/work-form.tsx:1339-1345`, `:1382-1389`). No `loading`/`fullWidth` props: callers swap the label and add `aria-busy` (`src/app/[locale]/(public)/[handle]/owner-profile-view.tsx:591-603`), pass `w-full` (`src/app/[locale]/(public)/[handle]/work-form.tsx:1327`), colour a danger action with `text-(--state-danger)` (`src/app/[locale]/(public)/[handle]/works-gallery.tsx:463-466`, `:499-502`), or make an icon-only button with `w-(--control-h) px-0` (`src/app/[locale]/(public)/[handle]/work-form.tsx:1372-1380`).
- Auth screens raise buttons to `min-h-(--control-h-lg)` below `sm` (`AUTH_TOUCH`, `AUTH_SUBMIT`, `src/app/[locale]/(auth)/shell.ts:33-41`) — decision D-AUTH-3 (`docs/ui-specification.md:5248`).

Imported nowhere — F-SHELL-17 (`docs/ui-specification.md:5171`, `:5199`).
- Round/icon controls are hand-styled where needed: 36 px ink-solid round camera `<label>`s with a 2 px card border (`src/app/[locale]/(public)/[handle]/owner-profile-view.tsx:637-641`, `:712-716`); 32 px square grip (`src/app/[locale]/(public)/[handle]/works-gallery.tsx:439-448`); 44 px round lightbox controls on white/10 (`src/app/[locale]/(public)/[handle]/works-gallery.tsx:604-605`, `:621-629`); 36 px round orbit enlarge on `n-950/80` with `plus` 16 (`src/app/[locale]/(public)/[handle]/works-gallery.tsx:880-888`); 20 px round chip grip and remove (`src/app/[locale]/(public)/[handle]/profile-sections.tsx:87-114`); 40 px square hamburger with `menu` 22 (`src/components/ui/mobile-menu.tsx:35-45`).

**Risks**
- Consumers of `Button`/`ButtonLink`/`buttonClassName` (20 files): `src/app/[locale]/(app)/handle-form.tsx:6`, `src/app/[locale]/(app)/onboarding/onboarding-steps.tsx:6`, `src/app/[locale]/(app)/settings/account/change-email-form.tsx:6`, `change-password-form.tsx:5`, `two-factor-settings.tsx:7`, `src/app/[locale]/(auth)/login/login-form.tsx:6`, `register/register-form.tsx:6`, `register/verified/page.tsx:2`, `register/verified/resend-form.tsx:5`, `reset-password/new/new-password-form.tsx:5`, `reset-password/request-form.tsx:6`, `two-factor/two-factor-challenge.tsx:6`, `src/app/[locale]/(public)/page.tsx:4`, `src/app/[locale]/(public)/[handle]/leave-dialog.tsx:5`, `owner-profile-view.tsx:8`, `[handle]/page.tsx:27`, `r360-params.tsx:5`, `work-form.tsx:14`, `works-gallery.tsx:13`, `src/app/[locale]/not-found.tsx:3`. Consumers of `TextLink`/`textButtonClassName` (13 files) start at `src/app/[locale]/(app)/handle-form.tsx:8` and `src/app/[locale]/(auth)/login/login-form.tsx:9`. `IconButton`: none.
- `rounded-sm` is Tailwind's own key: porting `--radius-sm` 12 px through `@theme` (`src/app/globals.css:74`) changes every `rounded-sm` in `src` at once (18 occurrences in 12 files), including photo tiles the reference wants at `--radius-picture` 8 px (`src/app/[locale]/(public)/[handle]/work-form.tsx:1272`; `design/tokens/radius.css:6`).
- e2e: icon-only buttons keep working only if their `aria-label`s equal today's visible names — „Edytuj profil” (`e2e/db/happy-path.spec.ts:123`, `design/ui_kits/public-web/PublicProfile.jsx:138`), „Zapisz” with `exact: true` (`e2e/db/happy-path.spec.ts:124`; `design/components/profile/AboutPanel.jsx:201`), „Anuluj” (`e2e/db/works.spec.ts:759`; `design/ui_kits/public-web/WorkPage.jsx:160`). „Dodaj realizację” (`e2e/db/leave-guard.spec.ts:65`) has no reference control: the kit's button reads „Realizacja” with a `plus` icon (`design/ui_kits/public-web/PublicProfile.jsx:10`, `:184`). With two buttons named „Zapisz” or „Anuluj” on screen at once, `getByRole` becomes ambiguous.
- Accessibility: icon-only controls depend on `aria-label` (the reference also sets `title`, which duplicates the name); a disabled ✓ at 40 % opacity on white (`design/ui_kits/public-web/WorkPage.jsx:161`) and a white-94 % pill over an unknown photo are axe contrast candidates (`e2e/a11y.spec.ts` runs axe); 24 px and 32 px targets on a phone sit under the 44 px thumb figure in `src/app/[locale]/(auth)/shell.ts:33-37`; the bar pencil keeps `aria-pressed` while it is `disabled` (`design/ui_kits/public-web/PublicProfile.jsx:138`). The segmented control has no roving keyboard model (`design/ui_kits/public-web/WorkPage.jsx:33-38`).
- Decisions overturned: D-SHELL-7 and D-PROFILE-7 (labelled edit control → round pencil, `docs/ui-specification.md:5237`, `:5292`; decisions A4/A8/B4, `design/docs/handoff/00-decyzje-2026-09-14.md:12`, `:16`, `:26`); D-WORKS-2 (orbit „+” → `arrow-up-right` on the card / `maximize-2` on the work page, `docs/ui-specification.md:3946`; `design/components/profile/OrbitTile.jsx:134`). D-AUTH-3 (`docs/ui-specification.md:5248`) is not addressed by the reference.
- Findings: F-SHELL-17 (dead `IconButton`, `docs/ui-specification.md:5199`) closes if IconButton is adopted or deleted. F-WORKS-13 (names built by concatenation, `docs/ui-specification.md:3967`) is repeated by the kit's "Edytuj: " + name (`design/components/profile/WorkCard.jsx:74`) while prompt-195 asks for a `Works.card.editNamed` key (`design/docs/claude-code-prompt-195.md:101`). F-AUTH-3 (no touch floor on text links, `docs/ui-specification.md:5383`) is untouched.

### Input (with Textarea and FormField)

| reference file | equivalent in src | what to do | risks |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| design/components/forms/Input.jsx, Input.d.ts, Input.prompt.md; used in design/components/forms/HandleField.jsx, forms.card.html, design/ui_kits/public-web/WorkPage.jsx, design/ui_kits/app/Auth.jsx, Onboarding.jsx, AccountSettings.jsx, ProfileEditor.jsx | src/components/ui/input.tsx | rebuild — the reference adds `size="lg"` (56 px), a visible `invalid` state, a `prefix` slot and a 14 px mono face; the product has only `mono`. | 14 files import it; the product removed the in-field prefix on purpose (05.09.2026) and the mono font size would shrink every handle and code field. |
| No Textarea component in the reference; inline `<textarea>` in design/ui_kits/public-web/WorkPage.jsx | src/components/ui/textarea.tsx | re-skin — same box as Input (radius, colours), `min-height` 120 px, counter in the hint line. | Its only consumer (headline and bio fields in owner-profile-view.tsx) disappears with decision C5; the work page description becomes the new consumer. |
| design/components/forms/FormField.jsx, FormField.d.ts, FormField.prompt.md; used in design/components/forms/HandleField.jsx, forms.card.html, design/ui_kits/app/Auth.jsx, Onboarding.jsx, AccountSettings.jsx, ProfileEditor.jsx | src/components/ui/form-field.tsx | rebuild — the reference has an `error` line (`role="alert"`) and a `status` line (`role="status"`), an optional label and a subtle-toned hint. | 10 files import it, and most of them (not onboarding-steps.tsx or two-factor-settings.tsx) render their own field error `<p>` inside `children`; moving errors into the component changes live-region announcements that e2e and screen readers see (F-AUTH-5, F-ACCOUNT-17). |

**Reference — dimensions and behaviour**

*Input* (`design/components/forms/Input.jsx`)
- Contract: `value`, `onChange`, `type` `"text" | "email" | "password" | "tel" | "url"` (`design/components/forms/Input.d.ts:3-5`); `invalid` — "Red border; pair it with a FormField error string" (`:6-7`); `disabled` (`:8`); `mono` — IBM Plex Mono for handles, codes and addresses (`:9-10`); `size` `md` = 48 px (default) · `lg` = 56 px (`:11-12`); `prefix` — static text glued to the left inside the border, e.g. "architektow3d.pl/" (`:13-14`); `placeholder`, `autoComplete`, `maxLength`, `style` (`:15-18`).
- Height `var(--field-h)` 48 px, or `var(--field-h-lg)` 56 px for `lg` (`design/components/forms/Input.jsx:32`; `design/tokens/spacing.css:14-15`).
- Padding `0 var(--sp-5)` (0 16 px); with a prefix `0 var(--sp-5) 0 0` (`design/components/forms/Input.jsx:33`).
- Width `100%`; with a prefix `flex: 1; min-width: 0` (`design/components/forms/Input.jsx:31`).
- Border `1px solid` — `var(--border-default)` at rest, `var(--n-950)` on focus, `var(--state-danger)` when `invalid` (invalid wins over focus) (`design/components/forms/Input.jsx:16-20`, `:34`); `aria-invalid="true"` when invalid (`design/components/forms/Input.jsx:27`).
- Radius `var(--radius-control)` = 12 px (`design/components/forms/Input.jsx:35`; `design/tokens/radius.css:5-6`).
- Background `var(--surface-card)`, `var(--surface-sunken)` when disabled; text `var(--text-strong)` in both states (`design/components/forms/Input.jsx:36-37`).
- Font `var(--type-body)` (450, 1rem/1.6 Figtree) or `var(--type-mono)` (450, .875rem/1.5 IBM Plex Mono) when `mono` (`design/components/forms/Input.jsx:38`; `design/tokens/typography.css:36`, `:39`).
- `outline: none` inline, `transition: var(--transition-control)` (`design/components/forms/Input.jsx:39-40`). Focus is tracked in JavaScript state (`design/components/forms/Input.jsx:15`, `:28-29`). No placeholder colour is set.
- With `prefix`: a wrapper `display: flex; align-items: center` carries the 1 px border (same colour rules), the 12 px radius, the white/sunken background and the transition; the prefix `<span>` has `padding: 0 var(--sp-1) 0 var(--sp-5)` (0 2 px 0 16 px), `font: var(--type-mono)`, colour `var(--text-subtle)`, `white-space: nowrap`; the `<input>` inside has no border and no radius (`design/components/forms/Input.jsx:46-70`).
- Rules: always inside a FormField, no label of its own; focus is "a 1px ink border plus the browser focus ring; no glow, no colour fill"; `invalid` only after a submit attempt, never while typing the first character (`design/components/forms/Input.prompt.md:1`, `:8-9`).
- Kit usages: work-page name field `size="lg"`, placeholder „Nowa realizacja”, spanning both grid columns on desktop (`design/ui_kits/public-web/WorkPage.jsx:10`, `:187-190`); „Inwestor” and „Deweloper” side by side in `minmax(0,1fr) minmax(0,1fr)`, gap `var(--sp-5) var(--sp-8)` (16 / 32 px), stacked on a phone, header `max-width: 64rem` (`design/ui_kits/public-web/WorkPage.jsx:186`, `:191-192`); handle field with `mono` and `prefix` (`design/components/forms/HandleField.jsx:37-46`); settings handle `mono` without prefix and the full address in mono under the field (`design/ui_kits/app/AccountSettings.jsx:85-86`); one-time code `mono`, `maxWidth: 180` (`design/ui_kits/app/Auth.jsx:124`); legacy name editor `size="lg"` (`design/ui_kits/app/ProfileEditor.jsx:58`).

*Textarea* (no component; work page „Opis”)
- Style object `area`: `font: var(--type-body)`, `padding: var(--sp-4) var(--sp-5)` (12 / 16 px), `border: 1px solid var(--border-default)`, `border-radius: var(--radius-control)` (12 px), `resize: vertical`, `min-height: 120px`, colour `var(--text-body)`, `font-family: var(--font-sans)`, `width: 100%`, `box-sizing: border-box` (`design/ui_kits/public-web/WorkPage.jsx:173`).
- `maxLength={300}`, labelled by `<label htmlFor="w-desc">` „Opis” (`design/ui_kits/public-web/WorkPage.jsx:11`, `:194-195`).
- Hint line under it in `--type-sm` `--text-subtle`: „Do 300 znaków. Widoczny na stronie realizacji i — w układzie „Okładka + opis” — na karcie.” followed by the counter „{n}/300” in `--type-mono` (`design/ui_kits/public-web/WorkPage.jsx:11`, `:196`). No near-limit colour, no live region.
- No focus style of its own: the global `textarea:focus-visible` outline applies (2 px `--focus-ring`, offset 2 px) (`design/tokens/base.css:7`).
- The about panel no longer uses textareas: name, headline and bio are `contentEditable` frames (`design/components/profile/AboutPanel.jsx:49-61`, `:212`, `:217`, `:239`; decision C5, `design/docs/handoff/00-decyzje-2026-09-14.md:38`).

*FormField* (`design/components/forms/FormField.jsx`)
- Contract: `label?`, `htmlFor?` (must match the control's id), `hint?` — grey helper line, always visible, `error?` — red line with `role="alert"` that takes precedence over `status`, `status?` — neutral live line with `role="status"`, `children`, `style` (`design/components/forms/FormField.d.ts:5-17`).
- Wrapper: `display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: var(--field-gap)` = 4 px (`design/components/forms/FormField.jsx:5`; `design/tokens/spacing.css:6`).
- Label (only when given): `<label htmlFor>`, `font: var(--type-label)` (650, .875rem/1.4), colour `var(--text-body)` (`design/components/forms/FormField.jsx:6-10`; `design/tokens/typography.css:38`).
- Order rendered: label → control → error → status (only when there is no error) → hint (`design/components/forms/FormField.jsx:6-20`).
- Error: `<p role="alert">`, `--type-sm`, `var(--state-danger)`, margin 0 (`design/components/forms/FormField.jsx:12-14`).
- Status: `<p role="status">`, `--type-sm`, `var(--text-muted)` (`design/components/forms/FormField.jsx:15-17`).
- Hint: `<p>`, `--type-sm`, `var(--text-subtle)`; no `id`, and the component does not wire `aria-describedby` (`design/components/forms/FormField.jsx:18-20`).
- Rules: hints stay on screen, not tooltips; one field per row in the 28rem form column (`design/components/forms/FormField.prompt.md:9-10`).
- The work page does not use FormField: it builds the same column inline (`gap: var(--sp-2)`, label `--type-label` `--text-body`) (`design/ui_kits/public-web/WorkPage.jsx:171-172`).

**Product today**
- `Input`: `forwardRef` `<input>` with one extra prop `mono` (`src/components/ui/input.tsx:3-9`); classes `h-(--field-h)` 48 px, `rounded-sm` (6 px, `src/app/globals.css:74`), `border border-(--border-default)`, `bg-(--surface-card)`, `px-(--control-pad-x)` 16 px, `type-body`, `text-(--text-strong)`, `placeholder:text-(--text-subtle)`, `focus:border-(--action-solid)`, `focus:outline-none`, `focus-visible:shadow-[var(--ring-focus)]`, `disabled:bg-(--surface-sunken)`, `disabled:text-(--text-subtle)`; `mono` adds Tailwind `font-mono` only (`src/components/ui/input.tsx:14`). No `size`, `invalid` or `prefix`; no transition; no styling tied to `aria-invalid` anywhere in `src` (callers set the attribute, e.g. `src/app/[locale]/(auth)/login/login-form.tsx:109`).
- The handle field deliberately has no in-field prefix: "The prefix used to sit INSIDE the field, where it ate the width the address itself needed: on a phone the visitor could not see what they were typing (seen 05.09.2026)"; the full address is shown below in mono (`src/app/[locale]/(app)/handle-form.tsx:341-389`); spec element C-HANDLE-FORM (`docs/ui-specification.md:2281`).
- The onboarding name field is a default 48 px `Input` (`src/app/[locale]/(app)/onboarding/onboarding-steps.tsx:75-86`).
- `Textarea`: `forwardRef` `<textarea>`, `rounded-sm`, `border-(--border-default)`, white, `px-(--control-pad-x)` `py-(--sp-4)`, `type-body`, `text-(--text-strong)`, subtle placeholder, the same focus and disabled classes as Input, `resize-y`; height comes from `rows` (`src/components/ui/textarea.tsx:3-17`). Only consumer: the headline/bio field, which adds a right-aligned `type-sm tabular-nums` counter that turns `--state-warning` at 90 % with `aria-live="polite"`, and an error `<p role="alert">` (`src/app/[locale]/(public)/[handle]/owner-profile-view.tsx:1045-1106`). The work form's text inputs carry the same counter pattern (`src/app/[locale]/(public)/[handle]/work-form.tsx:1637-1667`).
- `FormField`: required `label` and `htmlFor`, optional `hint` (node) with `hintId`; column `gap-(--field-gap)`; label `type-label text-(--text-body)`; hint `<p id={hintId}>` `type-sm text-(--text-muted)`; no error or status slot (`src/components/ui/form-field.tsx:3-29`). Callers put their error `<p>` inside `children` without a live role (`src/app/[locale]/(auth)/login/login-form.tsx:100-136`).
- Spec coverage: catalogue entries for `form-field.tsx`, `input.tsx`, `textarea.tsx` (`docs/ui-specification.md:5170`, `:5175`, `:5185`); related findings F-AUTH-5 (silent client-side errors, `docs/ui-specification.md:5385`), F-FORM-10 (work form errors not tied to fields, `:4879`), F-ACCOUNT-14 and F-ACCOUNT-17 (inconsistent field error feedback, `:2792`, `:2795`), F-PROFILE-12 and F-PROFILE-13 (name input without visible label; headline textarea accepting line breaks, `:3620-3621`).

**Gaps to close**
1. Radius: 12 px (`design/components/forms/Input.jsx:35`) vs 6 px (`src/components/ui/input.tsx:14`; `src/app/globals.css:74`); same for the textarea (`design/ui_kits/public-web/WorkPage.jsx:173` vs `src/components/ui/textarea.tsx:13`).
2. `size="lg"` (56 px, `var(--field-h-lg)`) missing (`design/components/forms/Input.jsx:32` vs `src/components/ui/input.tsx:3-5`); needed by the work-page name field (`design/ui_kits/public-web/WorkPage.jsx:189`).
3. Invalid state: red 1 px border + `aria-invalid` from an `invalid` prop (`design/components/forms/Input.jsx:16-17`, `:27`) vs no visual at all, attribute set by callers (`src/components/ui/input.tsx:14`; `src/app/[locale]/(auth)/login/login-form.tsx:109`).

Textarea: `min-height: 120px` and `--text-body` text (`design/ui_kits/public-web/WorkPage.jsx:173`) vs `rows` and `--text-strong` (`src/components/ui/textarea.tsx:13`; `src/app/[locale]/(public)/[handle]/owner-profile-view.tsx:1075`); counter inside the hint in mono, no warning, no live region (`design/ui_kits/public-web/WorkPage.jsx:196`) vs separate right-aligned counter with warning colour and `aria-live` (`src/app/[locale]/(public)/[handle]/owner-profile-view.tsx:1088-1093`).
