12. FormField hint colour `--text-subtle` (`design/components/forms/FormField.jsx:19`) vs `--text-muted` (`src/components/ui/form-field.tsx:23`); product exposes `hintId` for `aria-describedby`, the reference does not (`src/components/ui/form-field.tsx:13`, `:23`).

**Risks**
- Consumers of `Input` (14 files): `src/app/[locale]/(app)/handle-form.tsx:7`, `onboarding/onboarding-steps.tsx:9`, `settings/account/change-email-form.tsx:8`, `change-password-form.tsx:7`, `two-factor-settings.tsx:11`, `src/app/[locale]/(auth)/login/login-form.tsx:8`, `register/register-form.tsx:8`, `register/verified/resend-form.tsx:7`, `reset-password/new/new-password-form.tsx:7`, `reset-password/request-form.tsx:8`, `two-factor/two-factor-challenge.tsx:9`, `src/app/[locale]/(public)/[handle]/owner-profile-view.tsx:12`, `r360-params.tsx:6`, `work-form.tsx:17`. `Textarea` (1 file): `src/app/[locale]/(public)/[handle]/owner-profile-view.tsx:15`. `FormField` (10 files): `src/app/[locale]/(app)/onboarding/onboarding-steps.tsx:8`, `settings/account/change-email-form.tsx:7`, `change-password-form.tsx:6`, `two-factor-settings.tsx:9`, `src/app/[locale]/(auth)/login/login-form.tsx:7`, `register/register-form.tsx:7`, `register/verified/resend-form.tsx:6`, `reset-password/new/new-password-form.tsx:6`, `reset-password/request-form.tsx:7`, `two-factor/two-factor-challenge.tsx:7`.
- The mono size change (16 → 14 px) touches the handle field (`src/app/[locale]/(app)/handle-form.tsx:350`) and both one-time-code fields (`src/app/[locale]/(app)/settings/account/two-factor-settings.tsx:317`; `src/app/[locale]/(auth)/two-factor/two-factor-challenge.tsx:176`); 16 px is also the size below which mobile Safari zooms into a focused field (general browser behaviour, not stated in the repository).
- Reintroducing the in-field prefix would bring back the phone problem recorded in `src/app/[locale]/(app)/handle-form.tsx:341-345`.
- Adding `role="alert"` errors to FormField changes what screen readers announce on submit (addresses F-AUTH-5, `docs/ui-specification.md:5385`) and can double-announce where callers already render an alert (`src/app/[locale]/(auth)/login/login-form.tsx:138-142`); e2e locates fields by label (e.g. `e2e/two-factor.spec.ts:61` `getByLabel("Kod")`), which stays stable only if labels stay `<label for>`.
- Removing focus rings from inputs (reference `outline: none`, `design/components/forms/Input.jsx:39`) leaves a 1 px border change as the only focus signal — an axe/WCAG focus-visibility question for `e2e/a11y.spec.ts`.
- Decision C5 removes the product's only `Textarea` consumer (`design/docs/handoff/00-decyzje-2026-09-14.md:38`); the new work-page description field is its next user.

### Icon

| reference file | equivalent in src | what to do | risks |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| design/components/core/Icon.jsx, Icon.d.ts, Icon.prompt.md; design/readme.md (Iconography); every file listed in the inventory below | src/components/ui/icon.tsx | rebuild — keep the hand-authored 24 × 24 SVG set (prompt-195 §6.8) but add 19 glyphs the reference renders, and reconcile the default size (18 vs 24) and the tone model (named tones vs `currentColor`). | 14 files import it; copying the reference's own mechanism (CSS mask of files from unpkg.com) would send every visitor's browser to a third-party host, the same class of problem as F-SHELL-18. |

**Reference — dimensions and behaviour**
- Contract: `name` Lucide kebab-case (`design/components/core/Icon.d.ts:6-7`); `size` px, default 18 — "Use 16 inside 14px text, 20 in buttons, 24 in headers" (`:8-9`); `tone` `"body" | "muted" | "strong" | "onPhoto" | "success" | "danger"` (`:10`); `strokeWidth`, `style` (`:11-12`). Stated as "Lucide glyph, loaded from CDN and tinted with a text token … Lucide at 1.75 stroke stands in" (`:1-4`).
- Render: `<span aria-hidden="true">`, `display: inline-block`, `width = height = size`, `flex: 0 0 auto`; `background` = the tone colour; `mask-image: url(https://unpkg.com/lucide-static@0.544.0/icons/{name}.svg)`, `mask-repeat: no-repeat`, `mask-size: contain` (`design/components/core/Icon.jsx:3`, `:15-35`).
- Tones: `body` `--text-body`, `muted` `--text-muted`, `subtle` `--text-subtle`, `strong` `--text-strong`, `onPhoto` `--text-on-photo`, `success` `--state-success`, `danger` `--state-danger`; any other string is used as a raw colour (`design/components/core/Icon.jsx:5-13`, `:24`).
- `strokeWidth` (default 1.75) does not change the drawn line: below 1.75 it only lowers opacity to 0.9 (`design/components/core/Icon.jsx:15`, `:31`).
- Rules: decorative (`aria-hidden`), the label next to the icon carries the meaning; one family only, "never hand-draw an SVG" (`design/components/core/Icon.prompt.md:7-8`); "1.75 stroke, sizes 16 / 18 / 20 / 24 — never scaled between steps" (`design/readme.md:172-174`); vocabulary list (`design/readme.md:175-180`); replacing the CDN base is the only change if the brand commissions its own set (`design/readme.md:182-183`).
- Motion on an icon: the bar chevron rotates 180° when the panel is open, `transition: transform var(--dur-3) var(--ease-standard), background-color var(--dur-2) var(--ease-standard)` (`design/components/profile/ProfileBar.jsx:63`; decision A2, `design/docs/handoff/00-decyzje-2026-09-14.md:10`).

6. Place chip: `map-pin` 14 `muted` read-only and `circle-x` 16 in a 24 px remove button while editing (`design/components/profile/AboutPanel.jsx:22-29`) vs `map-pin` 14 subtle or `grip-vertical` 14, and `x` 12 in a 20 px button (`src/app/[locale]/(public)/[handle]/profile-sections.tsx:86-114`).
7. Owner empty state: `folder-open` 28 `subtle` (`design/ui_kits/public-web/PublicProfile.jsx:188`) — same size as `src/components/ui/empty-state.tsx:19`; no gap in the glyph, only in the surrounding box (WorkCard/profile entries).

**Risks**
- Consumers (14 files): `src/app/[locale]/(app)/settings/account/two-factor-settings.tsx:10`, `src/app/[locale]/(auth)/register/verified/page.tsx:4`, `src/app/[locale]/(auth)/two-factor/two-factor-challenge.tsx:8`, `src/app/[locale]/(public)/[handle]/owner-profile-view.tsx:11`, `profile-sections.tsx:2`, `work-form.tsx:16`, `works-gallery.tsx:16`, `src/app/[locale]/not-found.tsx:4`, `src/components/ui/account-menu.tsx:9`, `channel-reveal.tsx:11`, `empty-state.tsx:2`, `icon-button.tsx:2`, `mobile-menu.tsx:5`, `upload-progress.tsx:4`. Changing the default size from 24 to 18 silently shrinks every call that omits `size`.
- The name union is a TypeScript type (`src/components/ui/icon.tsx:6`): a kit name not added to it fails the typecheck, which is the desired guard but means every screen PR depends on the icon PR landing first.
- Copying the reference mechanism (unpkg.com mask, `design/components/core/Icon.jsx:3`) would add a runtime request to a host outside the product for every visitor — the same data-path concern as F-SHELL-18 for fonts (`docs/ui-specification.md:5223`); it would also replace `<svg>` with `<span>`, and e2e reads `svg` only inside the orbit ring (`e2e/db/r360.spec.ts:150`), which is not an `Icon`.
- Hand-drawn paths may not match Lucide's published glyphs exactly (the reference forbids hand-drawn SVG, `design/components/core/Icon.prompt.md:8`); nothing in the repository verifies the paths against Lucide.
- Findings: none of §11 is specific to icons; F-SHELL-17 lists `IconButton` as dead code (`docs/ui-specification.md:5199`).

**Contradictions touching this part (section 6):** Q-B01 — Icon sizes outside the allowed 16/18/20/24 set; Q-B03 — Input focus: ring plus border, or border colour only; Q-B04 — FormField: hint before or after the error line; Q-D04 — Gap between avatar shape toggle and camera: 8 versus 4 px; Q-G05 — Work description limit: 300 versus 600 characters; Q-H10 — Handle field: address prefix inside the border versus a bare field

**Risks**

- Consumers (import grep): `src/app/[locale]/(public)/page.tsx:6`, `:48`; `src/app/[locale]/(public)/[handle]/page.tsx:30`, `:223`. New consumers per A5 and prompt-195: the new profile bar (owner, `other`, `no-handle`), the settings bar (`claude-code-prompt-195.md:63`), the auth shell (`:64`).
- E2E: `e2e/i18n.spec.ts:38` finds the trigger with `getByRole("button", { name: "Polski" })` — survives if the accessible name stays the language name; `e2e/i18n.spec.ts:39` clicks `getByRole("link", { name: "English" })` — breaks if options become `role="option"` as in the kit (`Hero.jsx:41`); the same test asserts the URL `/en`, `html[lang="en"]` and the `NEXT_LOCALE=en` cookie (`i18n.spec.ts:40-48`), which the kit's callback-only option does not produce. `e2e/db/profile-sections.spec.ts:68-83` uses `getByRole("option")` for the place suggestions; an open language listbox on the same page would add options to that query. All e2e projects run `Desktop Chrome` (`playwright.config.ts:96`, `:106`), so no test sees the phone form.
- Accessibility: kit options are not keyboard reachable (`Hero.jsx:41`); the product's link options are. Adopting `listbox` implies arrow-key handling that prompt-195 §3.3 names only for `role="menu"` (`claude-code-prompt-195.md:70`). Chevron 14 px is outside the readme's allowed icon sizes 16/18/20/24 (`design/readme.md:172`).
- Decisions overturned: `D-SHELL-9` „it is the product's only switcher” is contested on the phone (language items inside `AccountMenu`/`VisitorMenu`, `PublicProfile.jsx:82`, `:98`) and on the profile footer (`PublicProfile.jsx:197` → `Footer.jsx:42`).
- Findings resolved: `F-SHELL-4` / `F-PROFILE-5` / `F-AUTH-2` / `F-ACCOUNT-6` (switcher reachable for signed-in viewers and on settings/auth, `claude-code-prompt-195.md:63-64`, `:192`); `F-SHELL-13` for this popover (`:70`). `F-SHELL-12` (query dropped, session cookie) is not addressed by the kit; issue #62 (open, „Store the user's language: today it lives only in a browser cookie”) proposes a nullable `users.locale` column written at sign-up and updated from the language switcher (issue #62 body, section "The change"); prompt-195 only says "#62 makes the choice stick" (`claude-code-prompt-195.md:63`).

**Reference — dimensions and behaviour**

*Popover shell* (`PublicProfile.jsx:27-50`)

**Risks**

- Consumers (import grep): `AccountMenu` — `src/app/[locale]/(public)/[handle]/owner-profile-view.tsx:6`, `:604`; `src/app/[locale]/(app)/settings/account/page.tsx:6`, `:79`. `MobileMenu` — `src/app/[locale]/(public)/page.tsx:8`, `:119`; `src/app/[locale]/(public)/[handle]/page.tsx:32`, `:240`; `TopBar`'s `mobileMenu` slot (`top-bar.tsx:24-27`, `:47-56`). `useDismissable` — `account-menu.tsx:10`, `language-chip.tsx:7`, `mobile-menu.tsx:6`.
- E2E: `e2e/db/happy-path.spec.ts:254` `getByRole("button", { name: "Menu konta" })`, `:257` `getByRole("menuitem", { name: "Konto" })`, `:258` `getByRole("menuitem", { name: "Wyloguj" })`; `e2e/db/leave-guard.spec.ts:87` (trigger) and `:88` (`menuitem` „Konto” must open the leave dialog). They survive if the trigger's name and the items' `menuitem` role and names stay; `leave-guard.spec.ts:88-92` breaks if „Konto” becomes a `<button>` (as `MenuItem` is in the kit, `PublicProfile.jsx:54`) without the guard learning about it. `e2e/login.spec.ts:139-140` and `e2e/db/happy-path.spec.ts:260-261` expect the homepage's „Zaloguj się” and „Załóż konto” as links at desktop width. No test opens a hamburger (spec `:251`, `:289`); tests run at `Desktop Chrome` only (`playwright.config.ts:96`, `:106`).
- Accessibility: the kit's `role="menu"` holds language items that are `menuitem` buttons with a visual `check` but no `aria-checked` (`PublicProfile.jsx:57`, `:65-66`); `D-SHELL-8` (`docs/ui-specification.md:484`) chose `<nav>` for the hamburger precisely because it held mixed content — the kit's VisitorMenu overturns it for the profile. The product's `<p role="alert">` inside `role="menu"` (`account-menu.tsx:102`) is a non-item child (`F-SHELL-13`).
- Stacking on a phone: while the about panel is open, its scrim is `position: fixed; inset: 0; z-index: 44`, rendered after the bar (also `z-index: 44`), so it paints over the menu trigger and a tap closes the panel (`design/components/profile/AboutPanel.jsx:148`; `ProfileBar.jsx:31`; `PublicProfile.jsx:164`, `:199`). On any width the panel `aside` is `z-index: 45` (`AboutPanel.jsx:157`) and can cover the part of an open popover that overlaps it (panel width on a phone `min(100% − 88px, 320px)`, `AboutPanel.jsx:128`).
- Data: `other` / `no-handle` menus need the viewer's own session profile on `/[handle]` (today only a boolean, `[handle]/page.tsx:49-58`); the square trigger needs `profiles.avatar_shape` (B5 names `profile.avatarShape`, `00-decyzje-2026-09-14.md:27`; the migration is listed in `design/docs/handoff/prompt-00-rozpoznanie.md:25`; `src/db/schema.ts` has no such column today).
- Decisions overturned: `D-SHELL-6` (`docs/ui-specification.md:351`) — on the profile the phone collapse is no longer about width: every viewer's language, and the visitor's sign-in and sign-up, sit under one trigger (A6). `D-SHELL-8` (`:484`) for the profile's visitor menu. prompt-195 §3.2 keeps `D-SHELL-6` and `MobileMenu` for the homepage (`claude-code-prompt-195.md:62`).
- Findings resolved: `F-SHELL-5` / `F-PROFILE-1` (menu for signed-in non-owners, „Zaloguj się” for visitors), `F-SHELL-6` (onboarding exit), `F-SHELL-10`, `F-SHELL-11` / `F-PROFILE-25`, `F-SHELL-13` (`claude-code-prompt-195.md:192`). `F-SHELL-9`'s stale comments in `mobile-menu.tsx:8-16` and `use-dismissable.ts:3-5` (`docs/ui-specification.md:361`) go stale again if the files are rebuilt.

### Footer

| reference file | equivalent in src | what to do | risks |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `design/components/navigation/Footer.jsx`, `Footer.d.ts`, `Footer.prompt.md`; `design/components/navigation/LocaleSwitcher.jsx` (rendered inside it); kit uses `design/ui_kits/public-web/Hero.jsx:110`, `design/ui_kits/public-web/PublicProfile.jsx:197`, `design/ui_kits/public-web/WorkPage.jsx:273`; `design/readme.md:13`, `:106` | `src/components/ui/footer.tsx` (`Footer`), `src/components/ui/layout.ts` (`measureWidthClass`) | **re-skin** — prompt-195 keeps `C-FOOTER` and only names its measure (`claude-code-prompt-195.md:81`, `:147`); the reference's extra slots (note, links, a footer language switch) contradict the spec and each other, and adopting them would turn this into a rebuild. | The width is coupled to the page's bar through `measureWidthClass`; the new profile bar is full-bleed, so "the company line under the logo" no longer has a partner. A note in `--text-subtle` is the colour the product's own comment says fails AA here. |

**Reference — dimensions and behaviour**

- Role: public-page footer signed by the company, not the product — „Architectorium” in the footer, „Architektów 3d” in header and hero (`Footer.d.ts:1-4`; `Footer.prompt.md:1`, `:7`; `design/readme.md:13`).
- Props (`Footer.d.ts:5-15`; `Footer.jsx:4-13`): `company` (default "Architectorium", `Footer.jsx:5`), `links: { label, href? }[]` (default `[]`), `locale` (default `"pl"`), `onLocaleChange`, `note`, `copyright`, `style`, rest spread onto `<footer>`. The `.d.ts` doc comments are out of order — both "One quiet line under the company name" and "Second line under the company, e.g. „© 2026”" sit above `copyright`, and `note` has none (`Footer.d.ts:10-13`).
- `<footer>`: `border-top: 1px solid var(--border-hairline)`; `background: var(--surface-card)`; `style` overrides (`Footer.jsx:15`).
- Inner row: `max-width: var(--measure-wide)` (78rem) centred; `padding: var(--sp-9) var(--sp-7)` = 40 px vertical, 24 px horizontal at every width (no phone variant); `display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: var(--sp-7)` (24 px); `align-items: baseline; justify-content: space-between` (`Footer.jsx:16-26`; `spacing.css:5`, `:10`).
- Left column: `flex-direction: column; gap: var(--sp-2)` (4 px) (`Footer.jsx:28`):
  - company — `font: var(--type-sm)` with `font-weight: var(--fw-semibold)` (650), `--text-strong` (`Footer.jsx:29`);
  - `note` if given — `--type-sm`, `--text-subtle` (`--n-500`) (`Footer.jsx:30`; `colors.css:15`);
  - `copyright` if given — `--type-sm`, `--text-muted` (`--n-600`) (`Footer.jsx:31`).
- Links, when `links.length`: `<nav>` (no `aria-label`), `display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: var(--sp-6)` (20 px); each `<a href={l.href || "#"}>` `--type-sm`, `--text-muted`, `text-decoration: none` (`Footer.jsx:33-41`). The kit's base rule would otherwise underline links (`base.css:5`); focus outline 2 px `--focus-ring` (`base.css:7`).
- Language switch, when `onLocaleChange` is passed: `LocaleSwitcher current={locale}` — text links „Polski” / „English”, active semibold and underlined (`Footer.jsx:42`; `LocaleSwitcher.jsx:3-31`).
- Usage in the kit:
  - Hero: `company="Architectorium Sp. z o.o."`, `copyright="© 2026"`, `links={[]}`, `style={{ background: "var(--surface-page)", border: 0 }}` — page tint, no top border, no switch (`Hero.jsx:110`).
  - Profile: `note="Warszawa · architektow3d.pl"`, links „Regulamin”, „Prywatność”, „Kontakt” (no `href` → `#`), `locale`, `onLocaleChange={onLocale}` — so a `LocaleSwitcher` is rendered; `company` not passed → "Architectorium"; no `copyright` (`PublicProfile.jsx:197`). It sits after `<main>` inside a `position: relative; z-index: 1; background: var(--surface-page)` wrapper, below the cover (`z-index: 2`) and under the fixed about panel (`PublicProfile.jsx:165`, `:182`, `:197-198`).
  - Work page: the same note and links, `locale`, no `onLocaleChange` → no switch; `company` "Architectorium"; no `copyright` (`WorkPage.jsx:273`).
- prompt-195: profile — „Footer (`C-FOOTER`, `measure-wide`)” (`claude-code-prompt-195.md:81`); work page — „Footer.” (`:147`); tokens-and-shared-elements PR lists „footer” (`:205`). The readme puts the top bar and footer in 78rem (`design/readme.md:106`).

**Product today**

- Spec ID `C-FOOTER` (`docs/ui-specification.md:587-597`); `D-SHELL-9` „no footer switcher” (`:527`, `:595`); homepage and profile placements (`:641`, `:2821`, `:2976`).
- Async server component reading `Footer.company` and `Footer.copyright` (`src/components/ui/footer.tsx:8-17`). One prop: `maxWidth` `"measure-wide"` (default) | `"measure-page"` (`footer.tsx:9-15`; `src/components/ui/layout.ts:1-10`), which must equal the page's `TopBar` value (`top-bar.tsx:29-32`).
- `<footer>`: `border-t border-(--border-hairline) bg-(--surface-page)` (`footer.tsx:21`).
- Inner column: `mx-auto flex flex-col items-start gap-(--sp-1)` (2 px), `px-(--sp-5)` 16 px / `sm:px-(--sp-7)` 24 px, `py-(--sp-7)` 24 px / `sm:py-(--sp-8)` 32 px, `text-left`, measure class (`footer.tsx:25-27`).
- Company: `type-label` (product: weight 500, 0.875rem / 1.4) `--text-strong` — „Architectorium Sp. z o.o.” (`footer.tsx:28`; `globals.css:253`; `messages/pl.json:49-51`; `messages/en.json:49-51`).
- Copyright: `type-sm` `--text-muted` — „© 2026”; the comment records that `--text-subtle` measured under 4.5:1 here (`footer.tsx:29-31`).
- No links, no note, no language switch (`footer.tsx:4-7`; spec `:595`).
- Rendered on: homepage, `measure-wide` (`src/app/[locale]/(public)/page.tsx:188`); owner profile, `measure-page` (`[handle]/page.tsx:204`); visitor profile, `measure-page` (`[handle]/page.tsx:315`). Not on settings (`settings/account/page.tsx:73-157`), onboarding, auth screens or 404 (spec `:596`; `src/app/[locale]/not-found.tsx:17-70`).
- Tests: none (spec `:597`).

**Gaps to close**

1. Background: `--surface-card` (`Footer.jsx:15`) vs `--surface-page` (`footer.tsx:21`); the kit's hero overrides to `--surface-page` with no border (`Hero.jsx:110`).
2. Layout: a wrapping row, `space-between`, baseline-aligned, 24 px gap (`Footer.jsx:21-25`) vs a single left-aligned column (`footer.tsx:26`).
3. Vertical padding: 40 px at every width (`Footer.jsx:20`) vs 24 px phone / 32 px from `sm` (`footer.tsx:26`).
4. Horizontal padding: 24 px at every width (`Footer.jsx:20`) vs 16 px phone / 24 px from `sm` (`footer.tsx:26`).
5. Line gap: 4 px (`Footer.jsx:28`) vs 2 px (`footer.tsx:26`).
6. Company type: `--type-sm` + weight 650 (`Footer.jsx:29`; `typography.css:26`) vs `type-label` weight 500 at line-height 1.4 (`footer.tsx:28`; `globals.css:253`).
7. Note line in `--text-subtle` (`Footer.jsx:30`, used at `PublicProfile.jsx:197`, `WorkPage.jsx:273`) vs none (`footer.tsx:28-31`).
8. Links nav, 20 px gap, `--text-muted`, no underline (`Footer.jsx:33-41`) vs none (`footer.tsx:4-7`).
9. Footer language switch on the profile (`PublicProfile.jsx:197` → `Footer.jsx:42`) vs none (`footer.tsx:6-7`; `D-SHELL-9`).
10. Measure on the profile: `--measure-wide` 78rem (`Footer.jsx:18`; `claude-code-prompt-195.md:81`) vs `measure-page` 68rem (`[handle]/page.tsx:204`, `:315`).
11. Company string on profile and work page: "Architectorium" (default, `Footer.jsx:5`) vs „Architectorium Sp. z o.o.” (`messages/pl.json:50`); the kit's hero uses the full form (`Hero.jsx:110`).
12. Copyright on profile and work page: absent in the kit (`PublicProfile.jsx:197`; `WorkPage.jsx:273`) vs „© 2026” on every footer (`footer.tsx:31`).
13. Work page gets a footer (`WorkPage.jsx:273`; `claude-code-prompt-195.md:147`) — the route does not exist in the product yet.

**Risks**

- Consumers (import grep): `src/app/[locale]/(public)/page.tsx:5`, `:188`; `src/app/[locale]/(public)/[handle]/page.tsx:29`, `:204`, `:315`; new: the work page (`claude-code-prompt-195.md:147`). `measureWidthClass` is shared with `TopBar` (`layout.ts:3-10`; `top-bar.tsx:2`, `:34`); the new `ProfileBar` has no measure (`ProfileBar.jsx:25-46`), so the pairing rule in `top-bar.tsx:29-32` and `footer.tsx:11-13` loses its partner on profile and work pages.
- Accessibility: `--text-subtle` for the note (`Footer.jsx:30`) is the colour `footer.tsx:29-30` says measures under 4.5:1 on this background; `e2e/db/happy-path.spec.ts:244-245` runs axe on the live public profile. Kit links point to `#` (`Footer.jsx:36`) and the product has no terms, privacy or contact pages to point them at.
- Dictionaries: the note „Warszawa · architektow3d.pl” and the links „Regulamin”, „Prywatność”, „Kontakt” exist only as literals in the kit (`PublicProfile.jsx:197`; `WorkPage.jsx:273`); SPEC A8 requires every string in both dictionaries (`SPEC.md:59`).
- Server/client: the product footer is an async server component (`footer.tsx:8`, `:16`); a switch driven by a callback, as in the kit (`Footer.jsx:42`), needs a client island or next-intl links like the chip's.
- Decisions: `D-SHELL-9` (`docs/ui-specification.md:527`) is contradicted by the profile kit's footer switch. No finding is resolved by the footer itself; `F-SHELL-4` evidence cites the missing footer switch (`:356`).

### ProfileBar

| reference file | equivalent in src | what to do | risks |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `design/components/profile/ProfileBar.jsx`, `design/components/profile/ProfileBar.d.ts`, `design/components/profile/ProfileBar.prompt.md`; users: `design/ui_kits/public-web/PublicProfile.jsx` (bar, `useSolid`, `Popover`, `MenuItem`, `AccountMenu`, `VisitorMenu`, owner pencil), `design/ui_kits/public-web/WorkPage.jsx` (always solid bar, work-page actions); supporting: `design/ui_kits/public-web/Hero.jsx` (`LanguageChip`, `Flag`), `design/components/core/Button.jsx`, `design/components/core/Icon.jsx`, `design/components/profile/AboutPanel.jsx` (the layers the bar interleaves with) | `src/components/ui/top-bar.tsx` (`TopBar`), `src/components/ui/logo-mark.tsx` + `src/components/ui/mark.tsx` (left slot), bar markup in `src/app/[locale]/(public)/[handle]/page.tsx:221-241` (visitor) and `src/app/[locale]/(public)/[handle]/owner-profile-view.tsx:581-611` (owner); no work page exists (there is no `[handle]/[slug]` directory under `src/app/[locale]/(public)/[handle]/`) | **new** — the reference is a fixed, full-width, transparent-then-solid bar whose left group is a separate fixed panel-toggle button (not a link) on its own layer; nothing of that is in `TopBar`, which stays for the homepage and settings (`design/docs/claude-code-prompt-195.md:62-63`). | Every owner e2e spec drives the bar's „Edytuj profil”/„Zapisz” toggle, which becomes a disabled-while-editing pencil plus a ✓ in the panel; the transparent bar over a photo and gradient puts the profile page into axe's undecidable-contrast gate, which today is waived only for the landing page (`e2e/axe.ts:53`). |

**Reference — dimensions and behaviour**

*Props (`design/components/profile/ProfileBar.d.ts`)*
- `profile: { displayName: string }` — used for the toggle's accessible name (`design/components/profile/ProfileBar.d.ts:11-12`).
- `brand?: string`, default „Architektów 3d” — shown while the panel is open; crossfades with the display name (`design/components/profile/ProfileBar.d.ts:13-14`, default at `design/components/profile/ProfileBar.jsx:18`).
- `solid?: boolean`, default `false` — white background, hairline, ink text (`design/components/profile/ProfileBar.d.ts:15-16`, `design/components/profile/ProfileBar.jsx:18`).
- `aboutOpen?: boolean`, default `false` — turns the left group ink (`design/components/profile/ProfileBar.d.ts:17-18`, `design/components/profile/ProfileBar.jsx:21`).
- `onToggleAbout?: () => void` — fired by the mark and the name alike (`design/components/profile/ProfileBar.d.ts:19-20`).
- `toggleDisabled?: boolean`, default `false` — "Identity editing: the mark/label button is inert" (`design/components/profile/ProfileBar.d.ts:21-22`, `design/components/profile/ProfileBar.jsx:52-53`).
- `phone?: boolean`, default `false` (`design/components/profile/ProfileBar.d.ts:23`); a JavaScript prop in the kit, switched by the kit's width tweak (`design/ui_kits/public-web/index.html:43`).
- `actions?: React.ReactNode` — the right-hand slot (`design/components/profile/ProfileBar.d.ts:24-25`); `style` spreads last onto the `<header>` (`design/components/profile/ProfileBar.jsx:42`), and extra props go to the `<header>` too (`design/components/profile/ProfileBar.jsx:44`).
- The component renders a Fragment of two siblings: the `<header>` (right slot only) and the logo `<button>` (`design/components/profile/ProfileBar.jsx:24-65`). The logo button is NOT inside the `<header>`.

*The `<header>` (toolbar layer)*
- `position: fixed; top: 0; left: 0; right: 0` — full viewport width, no max-width column (`design/components/profile/ProfileBar.jsx:26-30`).
- `z-index: 44` (`design/components/profile/ProfileBar.jsx:31`; decisions A1 `design/docs/handoff/00-decyzje-2026-09-14.md:9`).
- Height 64 px desktop / 56 px phone (`design/components/profile/ProfileBar.jsx:22,32`).
- `display: flex; align-items: center; gap: var(--sp-4)` = 12 px (`design/components/profile/ProfileBar.jsx:33-35`; `--sp-4:12px` at `design/tokens/spacing.css:5`).
- Side padding `0 var(--sp-7)` = 24 px desktop, `0 var(--sp-4)` = 12 px phone (`design/components/profile/ProfileBar.jsx:36`; `design/tokens/spacing.css:5`).
- Background `var(--surface-card)` (#fff, `design/tokens/colors.css:16`) when `solid`, else `transparent` (`design/components/profile/ProfileBar.jsx:37`).
- Bottom border always 1 px: `var(--border-hairline)` (`--n-150` #e4e8eb, `design/tokens/colors.css:4,17`) when `solid`, else `transparent` — so the bar's box does not change height between states (`design/components/profile/ProfileBar.jsx:38`).
- Text colour `#fff` over the photo, `var(--text-strong)` (#0c1116) when solid (`design/components/profile/ProfileBar.jsx:19-20,39`; `design/tokens/colors.css:15`).
- `pointer-events: none` on the header; only the right-slot wrapper sets `pointer-events: auto` (`design/components/profile/ProfileBar.jsx:40,46`). In the kit the clicks that fall through land on the cover band, which is itself a panel toggle (`design/ui_kits/public-web/PublicProfile.jsx:166`).
- Transition: `background-color`, `border-color`, `color` each `var(--dur-2)` (180 ms) `var(--ease-standard)` (`cubic-bezier(.2,.6,.2,1)`) (`design/components/profile/ProfileBar.jsx:41`; `design/tokens/motion.css:3,6`).
- Right-slot wrapper: `margin-left: auto; display: flex; align-items: center`, gap `var(--sp-3)` = 8 px phone, `var(--sp-4)` = 12 px desktop (`design/components/profile/ProfileBar.jsx:46`; `design/tokens/spacing.css:5`).

*The logo layer (mark + label + chevron — one button)*
- `<button type="button">`, `position: fixed`, `top: (barH − 44) / 2` = 10 px desktop / 6 px phone, `left: var(--sp-7)` 24 px desktop / `var(--sp-4)` 12 px phone, `z-index: 48` (`design/components/profile/ProfileBar.jsx:48-49,54`; decisions A1 `design/docs/handoff/00-decyzje-2026-09-14.md:9`).
- Box: `display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: var(--sp-3)` (8 px); height 44 px; `min-width: 0`; padding `0 var(--sp-3) 0 0` (8 px right only); no border; transparent background; `text-align: left`; `pointer-events: auto` (`design/components/profile/ProfileBar.jsx:54`).
- Colour `leftInk`: `#fff` only when over the photo AND the panel is closed; otherwise `var(--text-strong)` — on every width (`design/components/profile/ProfileBar.jsx:21,54`; decisions A3 `design/docs/handoff/00-decyzje-2026-09-14.md:11`). Colour transition `var(--dur-2) var(--ease-standard)` (`design/components/profile/ProfileBar.jsx:54`).
- `aria-expanded={aboutOpen}` (`design/components/profile/ProfileBar.jsx:50`).
- `aria-label` = „Otwórz panel: ” + display name when closed, „Zamknij panel: ” + display name when open — hard-coded Polish, no English variant in the component (`design/components/profile/ProfileBar.jsx:51`).
- Disabled: `disabled={toggleDisabled}`, `onClick` removed, `cursor: default` (else `pointer`) (`design/components/profile/ProfileBar.jsx:52-54`). The profile passes `toggleDisabled={editing}` (`design/ui_kits/public-web/PublicProfile.jsx:164`); the work page does not pass it, so the logo keeps toggling the panel in the work's edit mode (`design/ui_kits/public-web/WorkPage.jsx:178`; decisions A7 `design/docs/handoff/00-decyzje-2026-09-14.md:15`).
- No focus style is written in the JSX; the readme rule is "a 2px ink outline at 2px offset, visible on every control (white on photographs)" (`design/readme.md:150-151`).
- **A3D mark:** `aria-hidden="true"`, 32×32 px, `flex: 0 0 auto`, `position: relative; overflow: hidden`, `border-radius: var(--radius-xs)` (8 px, `design/tokens/radius.css:5`), background `var(--plaque-navy)` (#0f4eb1), text `var(--plaque-ink)` (#fff) (`design/tokens/colors.css:9`), `font-family: var(--font-sans)`, `font-weight: var(--fw-bold)` (750, `design/tokens/typography.css:27`), `font-size: 12px`, `letter-spacing: -.02em`, content „A3D”; red band `position: absolute; left/right/bottom: 0; height: 12%; background: var(--plaque-red)` (#c9150f) (`design/components/profile/ProfileBar.jsx:56-57`).
- **Label:** a `<span aria-live="polite">` with `display: inline-grid`, `font: var(--type-h3)` (750, 1.125rem / 1.28, `design/tokens/typography.css:6,15,33`), `letter-spacing: var(--ls-heading)` (−.018em), `white-space: nowrap`, `min-width: 0` (`design/components/profile/ProfileBar.jsx:59`). Two children stacked in the same grid cell (`grid-area: 1 / 1`):
  - display name — `overflow: hidden; text-overflow: ellipsis`, `max-width: 44vw` phone / `24rem` desktop; visible (opacity 1, no transform) when the panel is closed; when open opacity 0 and `translateY(-6px)`; `aria-hidden={aboutOpen}` (`design/components/profile/ProfileBar.jsx:60`).
  - brand „Architektów 3d” — opacity 1 when open; when closed opacity 0 and `translateY(6px)`; `aria-hidden={!aboutOpen}`; no max-width (`design/components/profile/ProfileBar.jsx:61`).
  - Both transition `opacity` and `transform` over `var(--dur-3)` (280 ms, `design/tokens/motion.css:4`) `var(--ease-standard)` (`design/components/profile/ProfileBar.jsx:60-61`).
- **Chevron:** `Icon name="chevron-right" size={18}`, tinted with `leftInk`; `transform: rotate(180deg)` when the panel is open, none when closed; transition `transform var(--dur-3) var(--ease-standard)` (`design/components/profile/ProfileBar.jsx:63`; decisions A2 `design/docs/handoff/00-decyzje-2026-09-14.md:10`). `Icon` is a CSS-masked Lucide glyph, `aria-hidden`, stroke 1.75 (`design/components/core/Icon.jsx:15-25`).

*Transparent → solid*
- Profile: `useSolid` observes the cover band with `IntersectionObserver`, `rootMargin: "-{barTop}px 0px 0px 0px"`, `threshold: 0`; `solid = !isIntersecting` — the bar turns solid once the band's bottom edge passes under the bar (`design/ui_kits/public-web/PublicProfile.jsx:14-24,117-119`). The band is always present (photo or navy placeholder), so the bar always starts transparent (`design/ui_kits/public-web/PublicProfile.jsx:109`; `design/components/profile/ProfileBar.prompt.md:11`; decisions B1 `design/docs/handoff/00-decyzje-2026-09-14.md:23`). `onPhoto = hasCover && !solid`; the bar receives `solid={!onPhoto}` (`design/ui_kits/public-web/PublicProfile.jsx:120,164`).
- Cover floor keeps the page avatar out of the bar: `coverMin = barTop + avatar/2 + gap` = 64 + 88 + 16 desktop, 56 + 60 + 12 phone; height `clamp(coverMin, 19vh, 240px)` desktop, `clamp(coverMin, 17vh, 150px)` phone (`design/ui_kits/public-web/PublicProfile.jsx:144-147`). The band carries a top scrim `linear-gradient(to bottom, rgba(12,17,22,.5), rgba(12,17,22,0) 60%)` for the bar's legibility (`design/ui_kits/public-web/PublicProfile.jsx:173`). The cover band is `z-index: 2`, the page avatar row `z-index: 3` inside it (`design/ui_kits/public-web/PublicProfile.jsx:165,175`).
- Work page: always `solid` (`design/ui_kits/public-web/WorkPage.jsx:178`); `<main>` therefore starts with `padding-top` 104 px desktop (64 + 40) / 80 px phone (56 + 24) (`design/ui_kits/public-web/WorkPage.jsx:180`).
- Note: `design/docs/claude-code-prompt-195.md:55` says the cover is sticky and "the earlier IntersectionObserver rule is gone"; the same file's `:79`, the kit and decisions B1 keep the observer.

*Stacking (every width)*

| layer | z-index | source |
| --- | --- | --- |
| cover band / page avatar row (profile only) | 2 / 3 (inside the band) | `design/ui_kits/public-web/PublicProfile.jsx:165,175` |

*Work page specifics*
- Logo opens/closes the read-only AboutPanel, which starts under the bar (`start = barTop`), width 380 (on a phone the panel ignores it and uses `min(100% − 88px, 320px)`, `design/components/profile/AboutPanel.jsx:128`), panel avatar 120 / 96 px at top 32 / 24 px; within the bar and panel only that avatar navigates to the profile (`onAvatar={onBack}`) (`design/ui_kits/public-web/WorkPage.jsx:137-141,179`; A7 `design/docs/handoff/00-decyzje-2026-09-14.md:15`); the page body's own back link „Wszystkie realizacje” also returns to the profile (`design/ui_kits/public-web/WorkPage.jsx:10,181-183`). The label crossfade therefore works on the work page exactly as on the profile.

*Documentation-level statements*
- "Fixed, 64 px (56 on a phone), transparent over the cover and white once past it" (`design/components/profile/ProfileBar.prompt.md:1`); "No avatar in the bar" (`design/components/profile/ProfileBar.d.ts:5`, `design/components/profile/ProfileBar.prompt.md:9`); "Replaces C-TOPBAR on profile pages" (`design/components/profile/ProfileBar.d.ts:6`).
- prompt-195 (older, overridden where decisions differ): the group "never collapses into a hamburger, never hides on scroll (resolves F-SHELL-7)" (`design/docs/claude-code-prompt-195.md:56`); the right slot "resolves F-SHELL-5" (`design/docs/claude-code-prompt-195.md:57`); every bar is a `<header>` landmark preceding `<main>` plus a skip link „Przejdź do treści” (`design/docs/claude-code-prompt-195.md:66`); popovers must move focus in, return it on Escape/outside press and support arrow keys (F-SHELL-13), reset `signOutFailed` on close (F-SHELL-10), route „Wyloguj” through the leave guard (F-SHELL-11) (`design/docs/claude-code-prompt-195.md:70`).

**Contradictions touching this part (section 6):** Q-C01 — Profile bar side padding on a phone: 12 or 16 px; Q-C02 — Work page bar: empty right slot and a different account trigger; Q-C03 — Account menu in the work page's edit-mode bar

- Cover without a photo: `design/docs/claude-code-prompt-195.md:79` says both "always present" and, at its end, "Without a cover: no band; the avatar sits directly under the solid bar"; the kit always draws the band (`design/ui_kits/public-web/PublicProfile.jsx:109`).

**Product today**

- `TopBar` is a plain `<div>`, `position: sticky; top: 0; z-index: 20` (in flow, it takes 56/64 px of page height), card surface with a hairline bottom border unless `onPhoto`, which is transparent without a border (`src/components/ui/top-bar.tsx:36-41`). No transparent→solid switching, no transition.
- Inner row centred in a max-width column (`measure-page` 68rem on profiles), height `--sp-11` 56 px below `sm` / `--sp-12` 64 px from `sm`, gutters `--sp-5` 16 px / `--sp-7` 24 px, `justify-between`, gap 12 px; left box `min-w-0`, gap `--sp-6` 20 px; right box gap 12 px / 20 px from `sm`; optional `mobileMenu` replaces `right` below `sm` (`src/components/ui/top-bar.tsx:43-57`; `src/components/ui/layout.ts:6-10`).
- Visitor bar (signed-out, no-handle and signed-in other render identically): left `Logo href="/"`; right `LanguageChip` + „Załóż konto” `ButtonLink` `quiet` → `/register`; below `sm` both move into `MobileMenu` (`src/app/[locale]/(public)/[handle]/page.tsx:221-241`). The page reads the session only to decide ownership (`src/app/[locale]/(public)/[handle]/page.tsx:49-58,192`). No „Zaloguj się”, no account menu for a signed-in non-owner.
- Owner bar (view and edit, every width): left `LogoMark href={/${handle}}` (a link to the same page); right a `Button` `quiet` with `pencil`/`check` 16 px icon and the label `PublicProfile.editProfile` „Edytuj profil” → `PublicProfile.saveProfile` „Zapisz” → busy `PublicProfile.savingProfile` „Zapisywanie…”, `disabled` and `aria-busy` while leaving, no `aria-pressed`; then `AccountMenu` (`src/app/[locale]/(public)/[handle]/owner-profile-view.tsx:579-611`; toggle logic `src/app/[locale]/(public)/[handle]/owner-profile-view.tsx:531-565`; copy `messages/pl.json:434-437`, `messages/en.json:434-437`). No language chip for the owner.
- Logo: `Mark` 30 px square, `rounded-xs` (`--radius-xs` is 4 px in `src/app/globals.css:73`), „A3D” at 34 % of the side, red band 12 % (`src/components/ui/mark.tsx:5-22`); wordmark `type-h3` (`--type-h3` is weight `--fw-semibold` = 600, `src/app/globals.css:233,244`), `whitespace-nowrap`, gap 8 px / 12 px from `sm`; rendered as a next-intl `Link` with a focus ring, or a `<span>` without `href` (`src/components/ui/logo-mark.tsx:23-53`); wordmark from `Brand.wordmark` (`messages/pl.json:40-41`).
- `AccountMenu`: trigger `Avatar` 30 px, `aria-label`/`title` `AccountMenu.menuLabel` „Menu konta”, `aria-haspopup="menu"`; menu `<nav role="menu">` 170 px wide, `rounded-md`, `--border-default`, `shadow-md`, items `type-sm` with 16 px icons, links to `/{handle}` and `/settings/account`, sign-out button with busy label and a `role="alert"` failure line (`src/components/ui/account-menu.tsx:15-110`).
- `LanguageChip`: `h-(--control-h)` 40 px, `px-(--sp-3)` 8 px, `type-sm`, `aria-haspopup="menu"`; panel is a `<nav>` of next-intl `Link`s with `aria-current` (not a listbox) (`src/components/ui/language-chip.tsx:83-129`).
- `MobileMenu`: 40 px trigger, `menu` icon 22 px, label `MobileMenu.menuLabel` „Menu główne”, panel a `<nav>` 15rem wide holding the same elements as the desktop row (`src/components/ui/mobile-menu.tsx:33-65`; `messages/pl.json:448-450`).
- Dismissal for all three popovers: `useDismissable` — outside pointerdown and Escape (`src/components/ui/use-dismissable.ts:6-25`).
- The product's `phone:` variant is `width < 40rem` OR `pointer: coarse and height < 32rem` (`src/app/globals.css:15-19`); `TopBar` itself uses `sm:` only (`src/components/ui/top-bar.tsx:44`).
- No work page route and therefore no work-page bar (directory `src/app/[locale]/(public)/[handle]/` has no `[slug]`).
- Spec coverage: `C-TOPBAR` frame and variant table (`docs/ui-specification.md:179-202`), `TOPBAR.visitor.logo/.language/.sign-up/.menu` (`docs/ui-specification.md:254-290`), `TOPBAR.owner.logo/.edit-toggle/.account-menu` (`docs/ui-specification.md:292-322`), flows (`docs/ui-specification.md:343-347`), `C-LOGO` (`docs/ui-specification.md:550-569`), `PROFILE.topbar.actions` (`docs/ui-specification.md:2827-2838`), `PROFILE-OWNER.topbar.logo/.edit-toggle/.account-menu` (`docs/ui-specification.md:2991-3019`). Decisions: `D-SHELL-6` hamburger only where the row does not fit (`docs/ui-specification.md:351`), `D-SHELL-7` / `D-PROFILE-7` labelled edit toggle without `aria-pressed` (`docs/ui-specification.md:352,3090`). Findings: `F-SHELL-4` (`:356`), `F-SHELL-5` (`:357`), `F-SHELL-7` (`:359`), `F-SHELL-8` (`:360`), `F-PROFILE-1` (`:2968`), `F-PROFILE-5` (`:3094`). Positioning: fixed full-width bar at z 44 plus a separate fixed logo button at z 48 (`design/components/profile/ProfileBar.jsx:26-31,54`) vs a sticky in-flow `<div>` at z 20 inside a 68rem column (`src/components/ui/top-bar.tsx:36-44`). Work page bar (new): always solid; owner read-only pencil „Edytuj” + account trigger; owner edit trash / × / ✓ (40 px each, icons 18/20/20, ✓ 40 % when it cannot save); nothing for other viewers (`design/ui_kits/public-web/WorkPage.jsx:155-169,178`) — no product equivalent. `trash-2` is not in the product icon set (`src/components/ui/icon.tsx:6-27`).
17. Landmark: the reference `<header>` holds only the right slot; the logo button is a sibling outside it (`design/components/profile/ProfileBar.jsx:25,47-48`) vs a `<div>` with no landmark (`src/components/ui/top-bar.tsx:36`; `F-SHELL-8`, `docs/ui-specification.md:360`).
18. Motion tokens: the bar uses `--dur-2`, `--dur-3`, `--ease-standard` (`design/components/profile/ProfileBar.jsx:41,54,60-63`; `design/tokens/motion.css:3-6`); `src/app/globals.css` defines no `--dur-*` or `--ease-*` custom property (no match in the file).

**Risks**

- Consumers: `TopBar` is imported by `src/app/[locale]/(public)/page.tsx:9`, `src/app/[locale]/(public)/[handle]/page.tsx:34`, `src/app/[locale]/(public)/[handle]/owner-profile-view.tsx:16`, `src/app/[locale]/(app)/settings/account/page.tsx:11`; only the two profile files move to `ProfileBar` — the homepage and settings keep `TopBar` (`design/docs/claude-code-prompt-195.md:62-63`). `LogoMark` is imported by `owner-profile-view.tsx:13` and, inside `src/components/ui`, by `Logo` (`src/components/ui/logo.tsx:4`); `Logo` by the homepage, settings, the visitor profile and seven auth pages (`src/app/[locale]/(auth)/login/page.tsx:4` and siblings); `MobileMenu` by the homepage and the visitor profile; `AccountMenu` by the owner view and settings; `LanguageChip` by the homepage and the visitor profile. Changing `AccountMenu`/`LanguageChip` for the bar also changes settings and the homepage.
- e2e — `getByRole("button", { name: "Edytuj profil" })` still resolves to the pencil (`design/ui_kits/public-web/PublicProfile.jsx:138`), but the pencil stays visible (disabled) during editing, so assertions that it is visible after „Zapisz” no longer prove editing ended (`e2e/db/happy-path.spec.ts:187-188`; `e2e/db/leave-guard.spec.ts:168-170,182-184`; `e2e/db/works.spec.ts:521-523,633-635,783-785,905-907,943-945,1010-1012`). Today, every `getByRole("button", { name: "Zapisz", exact: true })` in `e2e/` targets the bar's edit toggle. It is the only element named exactly „Zapisz” (`PublicProfile.saveProfile`, `messages/pl.json:436`; `src/app/[locale]/(public)/[handle]/owner-profile-view.tsx:591-603`). The work form's own submit is named „Zapisz realizację” / „Zapisz zmiany” (`src/app/[locale]/(public)/[handle]/work-form.tsx:1599-1601`; `messages/pl.json:527-528`), which `exact: true` excludes. On the profile the name moves to the panel's ✓, which commits only the identity draft (`design/components/profile/AboutPanel.jsx:198-203`; `design/ui_kits/public-web/PublicProfile.jsx:116`). That affects `e2e/db/happy-path.spec.ts:124`, `e2e/db/profile-sections.spec.ts:111,134,156`, `e2e/db/leave-guard.spec.ts:160,167,181` and `e2e/db/lightbox.spec.ts:197`. In `e2e/db/works.spec.ts:492,617,620,629,782,904,942,1009` the same toggle also settles the open work form (#85: `owner-profile-view.tsx:546-553`; `work-form.tsx:1179-1194`) or leaves editing before a reload. Neither the panel ✓ nor the work page ✓ (`design/ui_kits/public-web/WorkPage.jsx:161`) does either (section 5, WK-19). The toggle's busy label „Zapisywanie…” (`owner-profile-view.tsx:598-599`) has no reference counterpart (`e2e/db/works.spec.ts:491`). „Menu konta” keeps its name (`design/ui_kits/public-web/PublicProfile.jsx:10,79`; `e2e/db/happy-path.spec.ts:254`, `e2e/db/leave-guard.spec.ts:87`). Both Playwright projects are desktop-only (`playwright.config.ts:92-106`), so none of the phone triggers is covered.
- e2e click interception: a fixed bar and a fixed 44 px logo layer at the top of the viewport can sit over elements that `scrollIntoViewIfNeeded` leaves at the top edge (`e2e/db/works-order.spec.ts:118`, `e2e/db/r360.spec.ts:79,151`, `e2e/db/works.spec.ts:265`).
- Accessibility gate: the transparent bar puts white text on the cover photo plus a gradient scrim (`design/ui_kits/public-web/PublicProfile.jsx:168,173`); axe cannot decide contrast on gradients and the suite fails any undecided `color-contrast` except on `landing-pl`/`landing-en` (`e2e/axe.ts:36,53-57,129-139`); the profile is scanned in `e2e/db/happy-path.spec.ts:244-246`.
- Accessibility semantics: the logo's `aria-label` („Zamknij panel: {name}”) does not contain the visible text („Architektów 3d”) while the panel is open (`design/components/profile/ProfileBar.jsx:51,61`) — WCAG 2.5.3 "label in name"; `aria-live` on text inside a button whose name comes from `aria-label` (`design/components/profile/ProfileBar.jsx:59`); the pencil combines `aria-pressed` with `disabled` (`design/ui_kits/public-web/PublicProfile.jsx:138`); the kit's `Popover` has none of the focus management F-SHELL-13 asks for (`design/ui_kits/public-web/PublicProfile.jsx:31-50`; `design/docs/claude-code-prompt-195.md:70`). No focus ring is drawn in the reference for the logo or the pencil (`design/readme.md:150-151` is the only rule).
- Navigation loss: on a profile the mark is no longer a link (`design/components/profile/ProfileBar.prompt.md:7`); the visitor bar's route to `/` (`docs/ui-specification.md:254-262`) and the owner's logo link (`docs/ui-specification.md:292-300`) have no replacement in the bar; the reference hamburger has no home item (`design/ui_kits/public-web/PublicProfile.jsx:97-102`).
- Leave guard: the owner's logo no longer navigates (so C-LEAVE-GUARD's same-URL early return, `docs/ui-specification.md:297`, is moot); „Wyloguj” in the account menu still bypasses the guard (`F-SHELL-11`, `docs/ui-specification.md:446`), and the work page's edit mode has no account menu at all in the reference (`design/ui_kits/public-web/WorkPage.jsx:156-162`).
- Breakpoints: the kit's `phone` is a boolean prop; the product's `phone:` variant also matches a coarse-pointer landscape screen under 32rem tall (`src/app/globals.css:15-19`), which would give such a screen the 56 px bar and the single-trigger right slot if `phone:` is used instead of `sm:`.
- Decisions overturned: `D-SHELL-7` and `D-PROFILE-7` (labelled toggle, no `aria-pressed`) — recorded as overturned in `design/docs/claude-code-prompt-195.md:194`; `D-SHELL-6` (hamburger only where the row does not fit, `docs/ui-specification.md:351`) no longer describes the phone right slot (A6). `C-TOPBAR` profile rows (`docs/ui-specification.md:193-195`) are replaced.
- Findings resolved if implemented as drawn: `F-SHELL-5` / `F-PROFILE-1` (signed-in other gets an account menu, visitor gets „Zaloguj się”), `F-SHELL-7` (owner bar on a phone is two 40 px controls, label clipped at 44vw), `F-SHELL-4` / `F-PROFILE-5` for the owner on profile pages; `F-SHELL-8` only in part (the `<header>` exists but the logo is outside it, and no skip link is drawn); `F-SHELL-13` not by the kit.

### AboutPanel (the „o nas” panel — read-only mode and identity-edit mode)

| reference file | equivalent in src | what to do | risks |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `design/components/profile/AboutPanel.jsx`, `design/components/profile/AboutPanel.d.ts`, `design/components/profile/AboutPanel.prompt.md`; used by `design/ui_kits/public-web/PublicProfile.jsx` (lines 106–203) and `design/ui_kits/public-web/WorkPage.jsx` (lines 137–141, 179) — **read-only mode** | none as a panel. Its content lives today in the profile card `article`: `src/app/[locale]/(public)/[handle]/page.tsx:243-295` (visitor) and `src/app/[locale]/(public)/[handle]/owner-profile-view.tsx:613-896` (owner), built from `src/app/[locale]/(public)/[handle]/profile-sections.tsx` (`HeadlineView`, `LocationsView`, `PlaceChip`, `SectionHeading`, `BioView`) and the standalone plaque `page.tsx:307-314` / `owner-profile-view.tsx:1026-1028` | **new** — no fixed slide-in panel exists; the card's sections can be reused only after a restyle (chip, heading colour, headline colour, measure) and the address section, copy button, panel avatar copy and sticky plaque footer do not exist at all. | The panel carries the page's only `h1` and is `aria-hidden` when closed (phone default), so the page has no accessible `h1` then; its focusable children while closed break the WCAG rule the e2e axe gate runs (`aria-hidden-focus`). Overturns `D-PROFILE-4` (identity row) and moves every `PROFILE.card.*` element. |
| same files — **edit mode** (`editing`, `Framed`, `PlaceAdder`, shape toggle, camera, ✓/× corner) | `src/app/[locale]/(public)/[handle]/owner-profile-view.tsx` (identity fields 689–894, `PlaceCombobox` 1145–1322, `TextSectionField` 1047–1106, `toggleEditing` 531–565), `src/app/[locale]/(public)/[handle]/use-leave-guard.ts`, `src/app/[locale]/(public)/[handle]/leave-dialog.tsx`, `src/app/api/places/route.ts`, `src/app/api/profile/route.ts`, `src/app/api/profile/sections/route.ts`, `src/app/api/profile/avatar/route.ts`, `src/app/api/profile/cover/route.ts` (cover, driven from the band, not the panel) | **rebuild** — in-place identity editing exists, but the reference replaces inputs/textareas with `contentEditable` frames, the combobox with a chip-shaped adder, the bar toggle with ✓/× in the panel corner, adds an avatar-shape toggle, and (per the reference and decisions C5/C6) a parent-held draft saved on ✓ instead of save-on-blur per field. | The save model is the largest risk: draft + ✓ contradicts `D-PROFILE-8` and the A12 sentence „public the moment it is saved”, while prompt-195 §4.4 keeps save-on-blur — unresolved (see Q-E01). Many e2e selectors (listed under Risks) in `profile-sections`, `happy-path`, `avatar-upload`, `leave-guard`, `works`, `works-order`, `lightbox` specs rely on the current labels and input types. Needs a `profiles.avatar_shape` column that does not exist. |

**Reference — dimensions and behaviour**

*Props and variants (`.d.ts`)*

- Props and defaults: `profile`, `open = true`, `onClose`, `onAvatar`, `phone = false`, `owner = false`, `editing = false`, `draft`, `onDraftChange`, `onSave`, `onCancel`, `onChangePhoto`, `width = 380`, `top = 64`, `start = 0`, `headroom`, `avatarTop`, `avatarSize = 176`, `locale = "pl"`, `children`, `style`, rest spread onto the `aside` — `design/components/profile/AboutPanel.jsx:125`, `:173`.
- `AboutProfile` shape: `displayName`, `handle`, `avatarUrl?`, `avatarShape?: "circle" | "square"` („Circle (default) or rounded square — set once in edit mode, followed by every avatar on the page”), `headline?`, `bio?`, `places?: string[]` — `design/components/profile/AboutPanel.d.ts:13-22`.
- `phone`: „Drawer variant for narrow screens (< 40rem): full-height, scrim behind” — `design/components/profile/AboutPanel.d.ts:29`. The kit does not use a media query: `phone` is a prop switched by the Tweaks panel (`design/ui_kits/public-web/index.html:43`, `:54`).
- `owner`: „kept for API compatibility; editing is started from the bar” — `design/components/profile/AboutPanel.d.ts:31`; destructured but never read in the body — `design/components/profile/AboutPanel.jsx:125`.
- `editing`, `draft` („shown instead of `profile` while `editing`”), `onDraftChange` („Called with a partial draft on every change”), `onSave`, `onCancel`, `onChangePhoto` — `design/components/profile/AboutPanel.d.ts:33-41`; `const d = editing && draft ? draft : profile` — `design/components/profile/AboutPanel.jsx:138`; every edit calls `onDraftChange({ [key]: value })` — `:139`.
- `onAvatar`: „What the panel's avatar does on click. Default: closes the panel (profile page). On a work page pass the way back to the profile” — `design/components/profile/AboutPanel.d.ts:27`.
- `top`: height of the bar (used only to place the ✓/× corner) — `design/components/profile/AboutPanel.d.ts:44-45`, `design/components/profile/AboutPanel.jsx:199`.
- `start`: where the panel begins — `0` with a cover (under the transparent bar), the bar height without one — `design/components/profile/AboutPanel.d.ts:50-51`.
- `headroom`: top padding that clears the avatar (px number or CSS length) — `design/components/profile/AboutPanel.d.ts:52-53`; `avatarTop` / `avatarSize`: the panel's own avatar copy, centred, at this offset, default 176 — `:46-49`.
- `children`: „Extra sections (e.g. a language switcher or a table of contents of works)”, rendered after the bio and before the plaque — `design/components/profile/AboutPanel.d.ts:55-56`, `design/components/profile/AboutPanel.jsx:245`.

*Container (`aside`) — both modes*

- Element `<aside>`; `aria-label` = „Edytuj profil” while editing, otherwise „O nas” (en "Edit profile" / "About"); `aria-hidden={!open}`; no `inert` — `design/components/profile/AboutPanel.jsx:149-151`, strings `:136-137`.
- `position: fixed; top: start; bottom: 0; left: 0; z-index: 45` — `design/components/profile/AboutPanel.jsx:153-157`. Layering around it: bar + toolbar `z-index: 44` — `design/components/profile/ProfileBar.jsx:31`; logo layer (mark + name + chevron) `position: fixed; z-index: 48` — `design/components/profile/ProfileBar.jsx:54`; decision A1 — `design/docs/handoff/00-decyzje-2026-09-14.md:9`.
- Width: desktop `width` prop (380 px; the kit passes `PANEL_W = 380`) — `design/components/profile/AboutPanel.jsx:128`, `design/ui_kits/public-web/PublicProfile.jsx:143`; phone `min(100% - 88px, 320px)` — `design/components/profile/AboutPanel.jsx:128`; decision C2 — `design/docs/handoff/00-decyzje-2026-09-14.md:35`. `box-sizing: border-box` — `design/components/profile/AboutPanel.jsx:159`.
- Padding: top = `headroom` when given, else 24 px phone (`--sp-7`) / 32 px desktop (`--sp-8`); sides `padX` = 20 px phone (`--sp-6`) / 32 px desktop (`--sp-8`); bottom `padB` = 40 px phone (`--sp-9`) / 48 px desktop (`--sp-10`) — `design/components/profile/AboutPanel.jsx:144-145`, `:160`; spacing values `design/tokens/spacing.css:5`.
- Surface: `background: var(--surface-card)` (#fff), `border-right: 1px solid var(--border-hairline)` (n-150 #e4e8eb) — `design/components/profile/AboutPanel.jsx:161-162`; values `design/tokens/colors.css:4`, `:16-17`.
- Shadow: `var(--shadow-lift)` when open (`0 8px 24px rgba(12,17,22,.09), 0 2px 6px rgba(12,17,22,.05)`), `none` when closed — `design/components/profile/AboutPanel.jsx:163`, `design/tokens/elevation.css:8`.
- Open/closed: `transform: translateX(0)` open, `translateX(-102%)` closed — `design/components/profile/AboutPanel.jsx:164`; `transition: transform var(--dur-3) var(--ease-standard), box-shadow var(--dur-3) var(--ease-standard)` = 280 ms, `cubic-bezier(.2,.6,.2,1)` — `:165`, `design/tokens/motion.css:4`, `:6`. No `prefers-reduced-motion` handling in the component.
- Scroll: `overflow-y: auto; overflow-x: hidden` — `design/components/profile/AboutPanel.jsx:166-167`. Because the avatar copy and the ✓/× corner are `position: absolute` children of this scroller, they scroll away with the content; only the plaque footer is sticky.
- Layout: `display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap` 20 px phone (`--sp-6`) / 32 px desktop (`--sp-8`) — `design/components/profile/AboutPanel.jsx:168-170`; decision C3 — `design/docs/handoff/00-decyzje-2026-09-14.md:36`.
- Phone type scale „one step smaller everywhere”: name `--type-h2` (750 1.375rem/1.28) instead of `--type-h1` (750 2rem/1.28); headline `--type-body` (450 1rem/1.6) instead of `--type-lead` (550 1.1875rem/1.6); bio `--type-sm` (450 .875rem/1.6) instead of `--type-body`; corner buttons 32 px (icon 16) instead of 40 px (icon 20) — `design/components/profile/AboutPanel.jsx:129-134`; token values `design/tokens/typography.css:4-5`, `:8-10`, `:24-27`, `:31-32`, `:35-37`.

*Scrim (phone only)*

- Rendered only when `phone && open`: `<div aria-hidden="true">`, `position: fixed; inset: 0; z-index: 44; background: var(--scrim-photo)` (`rgba(12,17,22,.42)`); click calls `onClose`, except while editing (no handler) — `design/components/profile/AboutPanel.jsx:148`, `design/tokens/colors.css:21`. Decision C2: scrim `z 44` „nad toolbarem, pod logo” (over the toolbar, under the logo) — `design/docs/handoff/00-decyzje-2026-09-14.md:35`. The toolbar is also `z-index: 44` (`design/components/profile/ProfileBar.jsx:31`), so the scrim sits above it only by DOM order (the kit renders `AboutPanel` after `ProfileBar` — `design/ui_kits/public-web/PublicProfile.jsx:164`, `:199`).
- Desktop: no scrim, no outside-click close; the panel overlays the left edge of the works — `design/components/profile/AboutPanel.jsx:7-9`.

*Opening, closing, default state (kit behaviour)*

- Read-only close controls: no × and no collapse icon in the panel; the bar's mark/wordmark and the avatar close it „on the phone exactly as on the desktop” — `design/components/profile/AboutPanel.jsx:197`; decision C2 — `design/docs/handoff/00-decyzje-2026-09-14.md:35`.
- Profile page default: `React.useState(aboutDefault ?? !phone)` — open on desktop, closed on phone — `design/ui_kits/public-web/PublicProfile.jsx:110`. Toggles: bar logo (`onToggleAbout`, disabled while editing) — `:164`; the page avatar button — `:158`; the whole cover band (`role="button"`, `tabIndex=0`, Enter/Space) — `:166`; all three ignore clicks while editing.
- Work page default: closed on both widths (`useState(false)`) — `design/ui_kits/public-web/WorkPage.jsx:138`; decision A7 — `design/docs/handoff/00-decyzje-2026-09-14.md:15`.
- No `sessionStorage`, no Escape key handling, no focus movement, no focus trap anywhere in `AboutPanel.jsx` or the kit pages (the only Escape handlers in the kit belong to other components: the bar popover — `design/ui_kits/public-web/PublicProfile.jsx:36`; the language chip — `design/ui_kits/public-web/Hero.jsx:28`; the lightbox — `design/ui_kits/public-web/WorkPage.jsx:283`; and, inside the panel, only the place adder — `design/components/profile/AboutPanel.jsx:103`).

*Geometry in the two hosts*

- Profile: `start = 0` — `design/ui_kits/public-web/PublicProfile.jsx:154`; bar 64 / 56 px — `:117`; avatar 176 / 120 px — `:144`; cover height `clamp(168px, 19vh, 240px)` desktop / `clamp(128px, 17vh, 150px)` phone, floor = bar + avatar/2 + 16/12 — `:146-147`; `avatarTop = calc(coverH - avatarSize/2)` — `:152`; gap 24 / 16 — `:153`; `headroom = calc(coverH + avatarSize/2 + gap)` — `:155`; passed at `:199`.
- Work page: `start = top = barTop` (64 / 56), avatar copy 120 px desktop / 96 px phone at `avatarTop` 32 / 24, `headroom = avatarTop + avatarSize + 24/16` (= 176 px desktop, 136 px phone), `onAvatar = onBack`, never `editing` — `design/ui_kits/public-web/WorkPage.jsx:139-141`, `:179`.
- The page avatar (the trigger) is in the cover band at `z-index: 3` inside a `z-index: 2` band — `design/ui_kits/public-web/PublicProfile.jsx:165`, `:175`; decision B1 — `design/docs/handoff/00-decyzje-2026-09-14.md:23`. The page name beside it fades out when the panel opens (opacity 0, `translateX(-12px)`, `--dur-3`, `aria-hidden` while open) — `design/ui_kits/public-web/PublicProfile.jsx:178`; decision B2 — `design/docs/handoff/00-decyzje-2026-09-14.md:24`.

Inner `Avatar` with `alt=""` — `:181`.
- Edit: the `Avatar` alone (not a button), from the draft (`d.avatarUrl`, `d.displayName`, `square`) — `design/components/profile/AboutPanel.jsx:178`.

*Edit mode — avatar controls (shape toggle + camera)*

"circle" : "square" })` — `design/components/profile/AboutPanel.jsx:185`, `:187-188`, strings `:137`; `design/tokens/colors.css:19`, `design/tokens/elevation.css:7`.

*Edit mode — ✓ save and × cancel (top-right corner)*

- Rendered only while `editing` (no pencil in the panel — „Editing is started from the bar's „Edytuj””) — `design/components/profile/AboutPanel.jsx:197-198`; decision C1 — `design/docs/handoff/00-decyzje-2026-09-14.md:34`.

**Risks**

- **Consumers.** `profile-sections.tsx` is imported by `src/app/[locale]/(public)/[handle]/page.tsx:37-43` and `src/app/[locale]/(public)/[handle]/owner-profile-view.tsx:40-48`; `OwnerProfileView` by `page.tsx:35`; `useLeaveGuard` and `LeaveDialog` only by `owner-profile-view.tsx:36-37`. `CARD_BODY_CLASS` and `CoverView` would lose their card context. The work page (a new route) becomes a second consumer of the read-only panel with `start = bar`, `onAvatar` and no editing (`design/ui_kits/public-web/WorkPage.jsx:179`).
- **Save model and data.** Moving to draft + ✓ overturns `D-PROFILE-8` (`docs/ui-specification.md:3604`) and reads against A12's „public the moment it is saved” (`SPEC.md:63`); keeping save-on-blur makes × unable to undo anything already saved while the reference kit drops the draft (`design/ui_kits/public-web/PublicProfile.jsx:115`). The name, sections, avatar and cover endpoints are separate calls with separate rate limits (20 / 40 / 10 per minute — `src/app/api/profile/route.ts:25`, `src/app/api/profile/sections/route.ts:25-32`, `src/app/api/profile/avatar/route.ts:25-28`); a single ✓ commit needs either several calls in sequence or a new combined write, and an `avatar_shape` column + migration (`src/db/schema.ts:185-217`). Photos cannot be drafted the same way: they are assigned on upload and refreshed at once (`D-PROFILE-9`, `docs/ui-specification.md:3605`).
- **Validation.** `contentEditable` fields have no `maxLength` and accept line breaks and pasted markup (only `innerText` is read — `design/components/profile/AboutPanel.jsx:56`); the server schemas refuse > 80 / 220 / 1500 characters and inner newlines in the name and headline (`src/lib/profile-schemas.ts:14-43`), and the database CHECKs repeat the headline 220, bio 1500 and place limits, but not the name's 80 or the newline rule (the name CHECK only refuses a blank name) (`src/db/schema.ts:226-257`). Without error lines in the reference, a refused save has nowhere to be shown. Findings touched: `F-PROFILE-12` (no `h1` while editing — the `role="textbox"` on the `h1` keeps that true), `F-PROFILE-13` (headline line breaks), `F-PROFILE-14` (8-place limit invisible), `F-PROFILE-18` (unadded place text dropped — in the reference blur with text keeps the adder open), `F-PROFILE-19` (grip on a single chip — gone if the grip goes), `F-PROFILE-27` (focus lost on leaving) — `docs/ui-specification.md:3620-3632`.
- **Place ordering.** The reference drops grips and reordering from the chips while decision C7 says grip/order stay as in the spec (`design/docs/handoff/00-decyzje-2026-09-14.md:40`); `PROFILE-EDIT.places.grip` and the `#66` e2e test depend on it (`docs/ui-specification.md:3266-3277`, `e2e/db/profile-sections.spec.ts:188-228`).
- **Accessibility.** (a) When closed the `aside` is `aria-hidden` but still holds focusable buttons (avatar copy, copy-address) — the axe rule `aria-hidden-focus` is in the `wcag2a` set the gate runs (`e2e/axe.ts:19`, `:28-30`), and `happy-path` runs axe on the live profile (`e2e/db/happy-path.spec.ts:244`). (b) The page's only `h1` is inside the panel, so with the panel closed (phone default, or after × on desktop) there is no accessible `h1`; the name beside the page avatar is a `<p>` (`design/ui_kits/public-web/PublicProfile.jsx:178`). (c) Section headings in `--text-subtle` (#6f7c85) on white compute to about 4.3:1 by the WCAG luminance formula, below the 4.5:1 AA threshold for 11 px text (`design/components/profile/AboutPanel.jsx:38`, `design/tokens/colors.css:4`, `:15`); the product uses `--text-muted` today (`src/app/[locale]/(public)/[handle]/profile-sections.tsx:121`). (d) The shape toggle has a label that names the other shape plus `aria-pressed` — the combination `D-PROFILE-7` avoided for the edit toggle (`design/components/profile/AboutPanel.jsx:187`, `docs/ui-specification.md:3090`); the kit's bar pencil also carries `aria-pressed={editing}` (`design/ui_kits/public-web/PublicProfile.jsx:138`). (e) The listbox has no accessible name (product: „Podpowiedzi”) (`design/components/profile/AboutPanel.jsx:111`, `src/app/[locale]/(public)/[handle]/owner-profile-view.tsx:1277`). (f) The copy-address icon is 15 px, outside the readme's 16/18/20/24 rule (`design/components/profile/AboutPanel.jsx:224`, `design/readme.md:172`).
- **Layering.** Scrim and toolbar share `z-index: 44` (`design/components/profile/AboutPanel.jsx:148`, `design/components/profile/ProfileBar.jsx:31`) — correct only while the panel is rendered after the bar in the DOM. The leave dialog is `z-50` (`src/app/[locale]/(public)/[handle]/leave-dialog.tsx:47`), which stays above panel 45 and logo 48. ✓/× and the avatar copy are absolutely positioned inside the scroller and scroll out of view on a long bio (`design/components/profile/AboutPanel.jsx:166`, `:176`, `:199`).
- **Address.** The domain is hard-coded `architektow3d.pl` (`design/components/profile/AboutPanel.jsx:127`) while dev and previews run on other origins; the copy button in the kit never touches the clipboard and never resets (`:126`, `:223`).
- **E2E selectors that change** (details for section 5): `getByLabel("Nazwa (studia albo Twoja)")` + `toHaveValue` (`e2e/db/happy-path.spec.ts:130-131`) — the reference label is „Nazwa” and a `contentEditable` has no value; `getByLabel("Bio")` (`e2e/db/profile-sections.spec.ts:105`) — label becomes „O nas”; `getByText("{n} / 220")` counter (`:59`); `getByRole("combobox", { name: "Dodaj miejsce" })` exists only after the „+” button of the same name is pressed (`:66`); `Usuń cała Polska` → „Usuń: cała Polska” (`:128`); `li:has(button[aria-label^='Przesuń miejsce'])` and the grip focus test (`:194`, `:202`); „To miejsce już jest na liście.” (`:103`); option names `/^Warszawa miasto, mazowieckie/`, `/Nowa Wieś.*wieś, gm\. Kęty…/` depend on the detail format (`:68-91`); `getByText("Zapisano profil")` (`:112`, `:137`); `getByRole("button", { name: "Zapisz", exact: true })` targets the bar's edit toggle at every use today, because it is the only element named exactly „Zapisz” (`messages/pl.json:436`; `src/app/[locale]/(public)/[handle]/owner-profile-view.tsx:591-603`) and the work form's own submit is „Zapisz realizację” / „Zapisz zmiany” (`src/app/[locale]/(public)/[handle]/work-form.tsx:1599-1601`). On the profile it would find the panel's ✓, which commits only the identity draft (`design/components/profile/AboutPanel.jsx:198-203`; `design/ui_kits/public-web/PublicProfile.jsx:116`), at `e2e/db/happy-path.spec.ts:124`, `e2e/db/profile-sections.spec.ts:111`, `:134`, `:156`, `e2e/db/leave-guard.spec.ts:160`, `:167`, `:181`, `e2e/db/lightbox.spec.ts:197`. At `e2e/db/works.spec.ts:492`, `:617`, `:620`, `:629`, `:782`, `:904`, `:942`, `:1009` the toggle also settles the open work form (#85: `owner-profile-view.tsx:546-553`; `work-form.tsx:1179-1194`) or leaves editing before a reload; neither the panel ✓ nor the work page ✓ (`design/ui_kits/public-web/WorkPage.jsx:161`) does either (section 5, WK-19); „Zapisywanie…” (`e2e/db/works.spec.ts:491`); `#owner-avatar-file` (`e2e/db/avatar-upload.spec.ts:63`, `e2e/db/happy-path.spec.ts:150`); `article img` / `article div[aria-hidden="true"]` for the avatar and alt „Zdjęcie profilowe {name}” — the panel avatar has `alt=""` and no `article` (`e2e/db/happy-path.spec.ts:158-162`, `:205-210`, `:238`; `design/components/profile/AboutPanel.jsx:181`); `getByRole("heading", { level: 1, name })` fails whenever the panel is closed (`e2e/db/happy-path.spec.ts:117`, `:138`, `:196`; `e2e/db/profile-sections.spec.ts:163`); `getByLabel("Nazwa", { exact: true })` for the work form would also match the panel name textbox if both were on one page (`e2e/db/leave-guard.spec.ts:66`, `:75`; `design/components/profile/AboutPanel.jsx:212`). `getByRole("button", { name: "Edytuj profil" })` keeps working for the bar pencil (`design/ui_kits/public-web/PublicProfile.jsx:138`).
- **Decisions and findings.** Overturned: `D-PROFILE-4` (identity row), `D-PROFILE-7` (edit toggle with a text label), and — depending on the save model — `D-PROFILE-8`; `D-PROFILE-3` (sections absent when empty) holds in read-only but not in edit (sections always shown — `design/components/profile/AboutPanel.jsx:228`, `:236`); `D-PROFILE-10` and `D-PROFILE-11` (places search and reordering) are partly contradicted by the reference adder and the missing grip. Resolved or made moot by the reference: `F-SHELL-15` (plaque moves into the panel and is `aria-hidden` — `design/components/core/Plaque.jsx:28`), `F-PROFILE-6` (scope note deleted — `design/docs/claude-code-prompt-195.md:84`). `F-PROFILE-4` / `F-SHELL-14` (plaque strings outside the dictionaries) are NOT resolved by the reference — its `Plaque` still defaults `name = "Architektów"`, `footer = "Architektów 3d"` (`design/components/core/Plaque.jsx:15-16`); prompt-195 asks for a `Brand.wordmark` key to resolve them (`design/docs/claude-code-prompt-195.md:122`).

**Contradictions touching this part (section 6):** Q-E01 — Identity edits: saved on leaving a field, or held until ✓; Q-E03 — Phone panel focus target once the close button is gone; Q-D03 — About panel avatar copy: 96/72 without border versus page size; Q-D04 — Gap between avatar shape toggle and camera: 8 versus 4 px; Q-E05 — Place reorder grip: kept by decision, absent from reference chip; Q-E07 — Owner's works count under the profile address; Q-C09 — About panel focus rules after the × and bar avatar are gone; Q-E04 — Panel open on load from 64rem, phone line at 40rem

### WorkCard

| reference file | equivalent in src | what to do | risks |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `design/components/profile/WorkCard.jsx`, `design/components/profile/WorkCard.d.ts`, `design/components/profile/WorkCard.prompt.md`; used in `design/ui_kits/public-web/PublicProfile.jsx:193-195` (profile wall), owner empty state `design/ui_kits/public-web/PublicProfile.jsx:186-192`; data shape `design/ui_kits/public-web/data.js:16-21`; layout choice and cover/thumbnail derivation in `design/ui_kits/public-web/WorkPage.jsx:145,151-152,199-204` | `src/app/[locale]/(public)/[handle]/works-gallery.tsx` — `WorksGallery` (lines 128-265) and the private `WorkCard` (lines 267-516); `src/components/ui/badge.tsx` (R360 badge), `src/components/ui/empty-state.tsx` (owner empty state, mounted at `src/app/[locale]/(public)/[handle]/owner-profile-view.tsx:1003-1007`), `src/components/ui/use-reorder.ts` (grip) | **rebuild** — the two-column bordered card grid with a body row of owner buttons becomes a borderless full-column article with three stored layouts, link pictures, a caption with description, and one round pencil; it needs three new data fields and no longer opens a lightbox. | Every e2e spec that opens the lightbox, reads the card's ring/cue buttons, or edits a work in place targets this card (`e2e/db/lightbox.spec.ts`, `e2e/db/r360.spec.ts`, `e2e/db/works.spec.ts`, `e2e/db/works-order.spec.ts`, `e2e/db/happy-path.spec.ts`); reference sources disagree on the picture element (Q-F01) and reordering (Q-F10). |

**Reference — dimensions and behaviour**

Props and data (from the `.d.ts`):
- `work: Work` with `id?`, `name`, `href?` (permalink `/{handle}/{slug}`, #200), `investor?`, `developer?`, `description?` ("clamped to 2 lines under the picture, 6 beside it"), `cover?` (main picture; with an orbit it is the orbit's poster), `thumbs?: string[]` ("the card shows at most two"), `orbit?: { poster?, autorotate?, cues? } | null` — `design/components/profile/WorkCard.d.ts:9-23`.
- `layout?: "cover" | "cover-thumbs" | "cover-text"`, "Stored with the work", default `cover-thumbs` — `design/components/profile/WorkCard.d.ts:26-27`, `design/components/profile/WorkCard.jsx:46`.
- `phone?: boolean` — "Stacked variant for narrow screens (< 40rem)" — `design/components/profile/WorkCard.d.ts:28-29`. The component does not measure anything itself; the page passes `phone` — `design/ui_kits/public-web/PublicProfile.jsx:194`.
- `owner?: boolean`, `onOpen?(work)`, `onEdit?(work)`, `style?`, plus rest props spread onto the `<article>` — `design/components/profile/WorkCard.d.ts:30-36`, `design/components/profile/WorkCard.jsx:46,105-106`.
- The page builds `href` as `"/" + profile.handle + "/" + w.slug` and passes `layout={w.layout}`, `owner`, `onOpen={onOpenWork}`, `onEdit={onEditWork}` — `design/ui_kits/public-web/PublicProfile.jsx:194`.
- "Replaces the two-column card grid of `works-gallery.tsx` (V-WORKS-LIST)" — `design/components/profile/WorkCard.d.ts:5`.

Placement on the page (profile):
- Cards are rendered straight into `<main>` (no `ul`/`li`), in data order — `design/ui_kits/public-web/PublicProfile.jsx:193-195`.
- `<main>`: `max-width: var(--measure-works)` (100rem, `design/tokens/spacing.css:11`), centred, flex column, gap between cards `var(--sp-10)` = 48 px on phone / `var(--sp-14)` = 80 px on desktop — `design/ui_kits/public-web/PublicProfile.jsx:185`, values `design/tokens/spacing.css:5`.
- No „Realizacje” heading above the cards — `design/ui_kits/public-web/PublicProfile.jsx:185-196`.

Article (the card itself):
- `<article>`, `position: relative`; no border, no background, no shadow, no radius — `design/components/profile/WorkCard.jsx:9-10,102-107`.
- Layouts `cover` and `cover-thumbs` (and `cover-text` on phone): `display: flex; flex-direction: column` — pictures block, then caption — `design/components/profile/WorkCard.jsx:50,105`.
- `cover-text` on desktop (`beside = layout === "cover-text" && !phone`): `display: grid; grid-template-columns: minmax(0,3fr) minmax(0,1fr); align-items: end` — pictures in the wide left column, caption bottom-aligned in the narrow right column — `design/components/profile/WorkCard.jsx:50,105`.

- prompt-195 §4.2 reordering: grip kept, always available to the owner, #173 motion (held card follows the pointer with `transform: translateY`, the others slide over 180 ms, jump under reduced motion), auto-scroll within 80 px of the viewport edge, order posted 300 ms after the last move — `design/docs/claude-code-prompt-195.md:102`; still an open question for Dawid — `design/docs/claude-code-prompt-195.md:199`. The reference card has no grip.

**Risks**

- Consumers: `WorksGallery` is imported by `src/app/[locale]/(public)/[handle]/page.tsx:36` and `src/app/[locale]/(public)/[handle]/owner-profile-view.tsx:39`; the `GalleryWork` type by `src/app/[locale]/(public)/[handle]/owner-profile-view.tsx:39` and `src/app/[locale]/(public)/[handle]/work-form.tsx:67`. `Badge` stays in use elsewhere (`src/app/[locale]/(app)/onboarding/onboarding-steps.tsx:5`, `src/app/[locale]/(app)/settings/account/two-factor-settings.tsx:6`). `EmptyState` has one consumer (`src/app/[locale]/(public)/[handle]/owner-profile-view.tsx:10`). `useReorder` also orders the places (`src/app/[locale]/(public)/[handle]/owner-profile-view.tsx:168`).
- e2e selectors that break or change meaning: `getByRole("button", { name: "Powiększ zdjęcie 1 z 1: …" })` opening the lightbox from the card — `e2e/db/lightbox.spec.ts:57,84,152,189`; `getByRole("button", { name: /Dwa kanały/ })` on the card — `e2e/db/lightbox.spec.ts:82`; the card's ring, counter and cue buttons on the profile — `e2e/db/r360.spec.ts:150,183,197,215-285,316-319,344-368,381-386`; the card's „Powiększ widok 360°: …” button — `e2e/db/r360.spec.ts:389,404`; „Edytuj: {name}” opening an in-place form — `e2e/db/works.spec.ts:795,816,830,842,951,1025` (the name survives, the destination changes); grip count 0 outside edit mode — `e2e/db/works-order.spec.ts:66-71,149`; `article h3` order — `e2e/db/works-order.spec.ts:46` (still valid if `h3` stays); "the profile card is the page's first article" / `article img` — `e2e/db/happy-path.spec.ts:158,203-205,238` (the profile card article is removed by the redesign, `design/docs/claude-code-prompt-195.md:84`).
- Accessibility: every card now has several links to the same URL (cover, each thumbnail, the name) — `design/components/profile/WorkCard.jsx:57,64,67,87`; the reference components set no focus style of their own on the photo links or the pencil and rely on the kit's global 2 px outline at 2 px offset — `design/components/profile/WorkCard.jsx:24,77`, `design/tokens/base.css:7`; the product's inset focus ring (`src/app/[locale]/(public)/[handle]/works-gallery.tsx:370`) has no counterpart.
- Breakpoint: the reference switches layout on a `phone` boolean described as "< 40rem" (`design/components/profile/WorkCard.d.ts:28-29`); the product `phone:` variant also matches a coarse pointer with height < 32rem (`src/app/globals.css:15-19`).
- Decisions overturned or touched: D-WORKS-1 (strip of three, orbit first — `docs/ui-specification.md:3945`), D-WORKS-3 (R360 badge for the owner — `docs/ui-specification.md:3947`), D-WORKS-4 (in-place form — `docs/ui-specification.md:3948`), D-WORKS-5 (grips only while editing — `docs/ui-specification.md:3949`), D-WORKS-7 (focus back to „Edytuj” after the in-place form — `docs/ui-specification.md:3951`); prompt-195 lists only D-WORKS-4 of these as overturned (`design/docs/claude-code-prompt-195.md:194`).
- Findings resolved or made moot: F-WORKS-8 and F-WORKS-9 (only if the grip is built as prompt-195 §4.2 says), F-WORKS-11 (placeholder dropped), F-WORKS-12 (the card no longer counts pictures if pictures become links), F-WORKS-13 (edit name), F-WORKS-2 (R360 badge gone), F-WORKS-3/-4/-5/-6 (delete leaves the card) — `docs/ui-specification.md:3956-3967`, `design/docs/claude-code-prompt-195.md:192`.
- Backend: three new columns plus `slug` are required before the card can render its reference form; `cover-thumbs` availability depends on a photo count that A12 caps at 3 (`src/db/schema.ts:390-394`).
