**Reference — dimensions and behaviour**

Status of the reference:
- "The real product renders frames on a canvas (orbit-viewer.tsx); here a poster and a slow horizontal pan stand in so layouts can be judged" — `design/components/profile/OrbitTile.jsx:4-6`, `design/components/profile/OrbitTile.d.ts:2-4`; "the product keeps its own viewer" — `design/readme.md:250-251`. The pan (`object-position` + `scale(1.18)`), the 0–100 slider value and the stand-in ring dot are layout aids, not behaviour to port — `design/components/profile/OrbitTile.jsx:25,64-66,92,140`.

Props (`.d.ts`) — `design/components/profile/OrbitTile.d.ts:11-32`, defaults `design/components/profile/OrbitTile.jsx:11-24`:
- `poster?` (start frame = the work's main picture), `name?` (default `""`, used in every accessible name), `cues?: string[]` (default `[]`), `autorotate?` (default `false`, "The owner sets this per work"), `ring?` (default `false`), `aspect?` (default `"16 / 10"`), `onEnlarge?` ("Landing page only … maximize icon"), `onOpen?` ("Profile card … arrow-up-right icon. Takes precedence over onEnlarge"), `openLabel?` (default „Otwórz realizację: {name}”), `radius?` (default `var(--radius-picture)`), `style?`, rest props on the outer `div`.
- "Never both" `onOpen` and `onEnlarge` — `design/components/profile/OrbitTile.prompt.md:8`.

Outer wrapper:
- `display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: var(--sp-4)` (12 px between the tile and the cue row), then `style` — `design/components/profile/OrbitTile.jsx:60`.

Tile (the drag surface):
- `role="slider"`, `aria-label` „Widok 360° realizacji {name}: przeciągnij po obrazie, by go obrócić” (gloss: "360° view of {name}: drag across the picture to turn it"), `aria-valuemin={0}`, `aria-valuemax={100}`, `aria-valuenow`, `tabIndex={0}` — `design/components/profile/OrbitTile.jsx:61-67`.
- `position: relative; aspect-ratio: {aspect}; border-radius: {radius}; overflow: hidden; background: var(--n-900)` (#161c22); `cursor: grab`; `touch-action: pan-y`; `outline: none` (no replacement focus style; the inline value also cancels the kit's global `:focus-visible` outline for `[tabindex]`, `design/tokens/base.css:7`) — `design/components/profile/OrbitTile.jsx:76-85`, `design/tokens/colors.css:4`.
- Pointer: down stores `{ x, pos }` and captures the pointer; move turns by `(clientX − x) / 6`; up/cancel clears the drag — `design/components/profile/OrbitTile.jsx:43-54,68-71` (stand-in arithmetic).
- Keys: ArrowLeft / ArrowRight step the stand-in by 2 % — `design/components/profile/OrbitTile.jsx:72-75`.
- Poster `<img>`: alt „{name}, widok 360°” (gloss: "{name}, 360° view"), `draggable="false"`, absolute `inset: 0`, 100 % × 100 %, `object-fit: cover`, `user-select: none` — `design/components/profile/OrbitTile.jsx:87-93`.

„360°” mark:
- `<span aria-hidden="true">` absolute `top: var(--sp-4); left: var(--sp-4)` (12 px / 12 px); `padding: 4px 10px`; `border-radius: var(--radius-full)`; `background: rgba(12,17,22,.72)`; `color: #fff`; font `var(--type-eyebrow)` (750, .6875rem, line-height 1.2); `letter-spacing: var(--ls-caps)` (.09em); `text-transform: uppercase`; text „360°” — `design/components/profile/OrbitTile.jsx:95-111`, `design/tokens/typography.css:12,22,40`.

Corner button (only when `onOpen` or `onEnlarge` is given):
- `<button type="button">`; `aria-label` and `title`: with `onOpen` → `openLabel` or „Otwórz realizację: {name}”; with `onEnlarge` only → „Powiększ widok 360°: {name}” (gloss: "Enlarge the 360° view: {name}") — `design/components/profile/OrbitTile.jsx:112-116`.
- Click → `onOpen || onEnlarge`; `onPointerDown` stops propagation so pressing the button never starts a drag — `design/components/profile/OrbitTile.jsx:117-118`.
- `position: absolute; right: var(--sp-4); bottom: var(--sp-4)` (12 px / 12 px); 40 × 40 px; `display: inline-flex`, centred; `border-radius: var(--radius-full)`; `border: 0`; `background: rgba(255,255,255,.94)`; `cursor: pointer`; no shadow, no hover style, no focus style of its own (focus gets the global 2 px `--focus-ring` outline, `design/tokens/base.css:7`) — `design/components/profile/OrbitTile.jsx:119-133`.

Off under reduced motion" — `design/components/profile/OrbitTile.d.ts:18`; "one autorotating orbit at a time per page (the one most in view — reuse the `useInView` gate)", setting `works.r360_autorotate` boolean default false — `design/docs/claude-code-prompt-195.md:99`.

**Risks**

- Consumers of the parts: `OrbitViewer`, `OrbitRing`, `OrbitCueButtons`, `useOrbit`, `useFrameLoader` are imported by `src/app/[locale]/(public)/[handle]/works-gallery.tsx:17-22` and by the owner's form `src/app/[locale]/(public)/[handle]/work-form.tsx:18-23`; `orbit-ring.tsx`, `orbit-cues.tsx` and `orbit-viewer.tsx` depend on `use-orbit.ts` (`src/components/ui/orbit-ring.tsx:23`, `src/components/ui/orbit-cues.tsx:6`, `src/components/ui/orbit-viewer.tsx:7`). Restyling the cue buttons or ring changes the form preview too unless it is scoped.
- e2e: `getByTestId("orbit-viewer")`, `data-frame`, `aria-valuetext` — `e2e/db/r360.spec.ts:78,99-106,115-137`; poster `src` `800/003.webp` — `e2e/db/r360.spec.ts:99-105`, `e2e/db/works.spec.ts:913-921`; poster alt „Dom na skarpie, widok 360°” — `e2e/db/r360.spec.ts:106`; `getByText("360°", { exact: true })` — `e2e/db/r360.spec.ts:107`; ring box, `orbit-ring-cue`, `orbit-ring-cue-label`, `orbit-counter` on the profile card — `e2e/db/r360.spec.ts:150,183,197,225,243,248,347,359`; card cue list „Punkty widoku 360°: Dom na skarpie” — `e2e/db/r360.spec.ts:215,316`; phone „no ring” on card and lightbox — `e2e/db/r360.spec.ts:371-399`; enlarge button name — `e2e/db/r360.spec.ts:389,404`; axe runs `public-r360-card`, `public-r360-cues`, `public-r360-phone`, `public-r360-lightbox` — `e2e/db/r360.spec.ts:139,284,397,420`; owner preview canvas and loaded arc — `e2e/db/works.spec.ts:252-260,591`. All card-based ring/cue tests lose their target when the card drops ring and cues.
- Accessibility: the reference tile sets `outline: none` with no focus replacement (`design/components/profile/OrbitTile.jsx:84`); the product's inset focus ring (`src/components/ui/orbit-viewer.tsx:108`) is covered by axe runs. Autorotation changes `aria-valuenow` continuously (`design/components/profile/OrbitTile.jsx:37,66`).
- Accessibility, a control inside the slider: in the reference the corner button is a child of the drag surface. The `<div role="slider" tabIndex={0}>` opens at `design/components/profile/OrbitTile.jsx:61-67` and closes at `design/components/profile/OrbitTile.jsx:143`; the `<button>` sits between, at `design/components/profile/OrbitTile.jsx:112-136`. Two kit uses render that button: the profile card with `onOpen` (icon `arrow-up-right`, ↗; `design/components/profile/WorkCard.jsx:55`) and the read-only work page with `onEnlarge` (icon `maximize-2`; `design/ui_kits/public-web/WorkPage.jsx:262`). The edit-mode tile passes neither and puts its white pill in a sibling wrapper outside the tile (`design/ui_kits/public-web/WorkPage.jsx:224-231`); the lightbox passes neither (`design/ui_kits/public-web/WorkPage.jsx:297`).
  - The axe rule: `nested-interactive` carries the tag `wcag2a` and passes only through the check `no-focusable-content` (`node_modules/.pnpm/axe-core@4.13.0/node_modules/axe-core/axe.js:33262-33268`, main checkout `D:/platform-lite`; the worktree has no `node_modules`). It applies to every element whose role has presentational children (`node_modules/.pnpm/axe-core@4.13.0/node_modules/axe-core/axe.js:28472-28477`), and `slider` is one (`node_modules/.pnpm/axe-core@4.13.0/node_modules/axe-core/axe.js:13500-13507`). The check fails on "Element has focusable descendants" (`node_modules/.pnpm/axe-core@4.13.0/node_modules/axe-core/locales/_template.json:759-762`). No test was run; this reading comes from the rule definition.
  - The gate: `e2e/axe.ts` runs every rule tagged `wcag2a`, `wcag2aa`, `wcag21a` or `wcag21aa` (`e2e/axe.ts:19`, `e2e/axe.ts:29`) and fails on any violation (`e2e/axe.ts:143-148`). The orbit runs today are `public-r360-card`, `public-r360-cues`, `public-r360-phone` and `public-r360-lightbox` (`e2e/db/r360.spec.ts:139,284,397,420`).
  - The product today: the `role="slider"` element is `OrbitViewer`'s root (`src/components/ui/orbit-viewer.tsx:106-129`), rendered by `PublicOrbit` (`src/app/[locale]/(public)/[handle]/works-gallery.tsx:756-768`). On the card the enlarge button is a sibling that follows `PublicOrbit` inside the tile's `div` (`src/app/[locale]/(public)/[handle]/works-gallery.tsx:855-889`, button at `src/app/[locale]/(public)/[handle]/works-gallery.tsx:880-888`), so it is outside the slider. `OrbitViewer` renders a `children` prop inside the slider (`src/components/ui/orbit-viewer.tsx:53,163`), but neither caller passes children (`src/app/[locale]/(public)/[handle]/works-gallery.tsx:756-768`, `src/app/[locale]/(public)/[handle]/work-form.tsx:1543-1553`).
- Loading and data: autorotating needs frames; the card only loads frames once ≥ 50 % in view and after `load` (D-WORKS-15, `docs/ui-specification.md:4265`), and all orbits share one queue of 3 (F-WORKS-18, `docs/ui-specification.md:4277`). The card still requests the 800 px set (`src/app/[locale]/(public)/[handle]/works-gallery.tsx:867`; `design/docs/claude-code-prompt-195.md:99`) while the reference cover can span the full 100rem column in `cover` layout (`design/components/profile/WorkCard.jsx:51`).

- Findings: F-WORKS-19 (ring box swallows presses — `docs/ui-specification.md:4278`) disappears from the card but not from the work page/lightbox; F-WORKS-21 (stale `OrbitTile` comment "beside the 360° mark" — `docs/ui-specification.md:4280`, `src/app/[locale]/(public)/[handle]/works-gallery.tsx:833-835`); F-WORKS-24 (lazy poster — `docs/ui-specification.md:4283`) matters for a first-screen card.

**Reference — dimensions and behaviour**

The photos are plain `<img>` elements with `onClick` (not buttons, not focusable) — `design/ui_kits/public-web/WorkPage.jsx:265`.

**Risks**

- Consumers: `LightboxOverlay` has one host, `WorksGallery` (`src/app/[locale]/(public)/[handle]/works-gallery.tsx:254-262`); `ChannelReveal` has one consumer, the lightbox (`src/app/[locale]/(public)/[handle]/works-gallery.tsx:15,655`). Moving the lightbox to the work page removes it from `page.tsx` and `owner-profile-view.tsx` indirectly.
- e2e: `e2e/db/lightbox.spec.ts` opens from „Powiększ zdjęcie 1 z 1: …” on the profile (lines 57, 84, 152, 189), closes with „Zamknij podgląd” (line 70), uses `getByRole("dialog")` (59, 143, 154, 191, 194), the reveal slider „Porównanie kanałów: …, zdjęcie 1” and „W poprzek” (87, 131); owner Back/leave-guard interplay (189-194) depends on the profile edit mode that the redesign removes. `e2e/db/r360.spec.ts:401-423` expects `dialog.getByText("1 / 1")`, cue buttons in the dialog, Escape to close and axe `public-r360-lightbox`; `e2e/db/r360.spec.ts:391-394` expects no ring in the dialog on an iPhone 13.
- Accessibility: the reference names the dialog with the owner's text only, has no focus management, no trap, no scroll lock and no focus style of its own on its buttons (`design/ui_kits/public-web/WorkPage.jsx:288-301`) — they get only the global ink outline (`--focus-ring` = `--n-950`, `design/tokens/base.css:7`, `design/tokens/colors.css:20`) on the `rgba(12,17,22,.96)` ground (`design/ui_kits/public-web/WorkPage.jsx:290`), while `design/readme.md:151` says focus is white on photographs; its global ArrowLeft/Right steps pictures while an orbit slider is focused (`design/ui_kits/public-web/WorkPage.jsx:283`), where the product's orbit uses those keys to turn (`src/components/ui/use-orbit.ts:289-297`).
- Layout: the reference stage keeps 96 px side padding at every width (`design/ui_kits/public-web/WorkPage.jsx:296`) — on a 390 px phone the picture gets about 198 px; a 16:9 orbit at up to 1400 px wide has no overflow handling (`design/ui_kits/public-web/WorkPage.jsx:290,297`), where D-WORKS-12 made the product overlay scroll (`docs/ui-specification.md:4106`).
- Decisions touched: D-WORKS-8 (Back closes), D-WORKS-9 (focus), D-WORKS-10 (1600 px variant), D-WORKS-11 (sliders own arrows), D-WORKS-12 (scroll, 10rem floor) — `docs/ui-specification.md:4102-4106`; D-WORKS-19 (no ring on phones) — `docs/ui-specification.md:4269`.
- Findings: F-WORKS-14 (every picture called a photo — `docs/ui-specification.md:4110`) changes with the reference's neutral „Poprzednie”/„Następne”; F-WORKS-15 (enlarged orbit does not continue from the card — `docs/ui-specification.md:4111`) moves to the work page's tile; F-WORKS-16 (phone decided three ways — `docs/ui-specification.md:4112`); F-WORKS-17 (no portal, page not inert — `docs/ui-specification.md:4113`); F-WORKS-25 / #159 (reveal flashes — `docs/ui-specification.md:4374`).

**Reference — dimensions and behaviour**
- Contract: `padding` `"none" | "sm" | "md" | "lg"` — "md = 32px (default) · lg = 48px for the profile card · sm = 20px for rows" (design/components/core/Card.d.ts:7-8); `as` limited to `"div" | "section" | "article" | "form" | "li"` (design/components/core/Card.d.ts:9); `tone` `"default" | "sunken"` (design/components/core/Card.d.ts:10); `interactive` — "Adds the hover border + shadow lift. Only for cards that are links." (design/components/core/Card.d.ts:11-12); `style` (design/components/core/Card.d.ts:13). Defaults `padding="md"`, `as="div"`, `tone="default"`, `interactive=false` (design/components/core/Card.jsx:5).
- Padding map: `none` 0, `sm` `var(--sp-6)` = 20 px, `md` `var(--card-pad)` = 32 px, `lg` `var(--card-pad-lg)` = 48 px — one value at every width, no phone step (design/components/core/Card.jsx:3, :16; design/tokens/spacing.css:5-6).
- Background `var(--surface-card)` (white), or `var(--surface-sunken)` (`--n-100`) for `tone="sunken"` (design/components/core/Card.jsx:13; design/tokens/colors.css:16).
- Border 1 px: `var(--border-default)` (`--n-200`) for the default tone, `var(--border-hairline)` (`--n-150`) for sunken, `var(--border-strong)` (`--n-300`) while an interactive card is hovered (design/components/core/Card.jsx:14; design/tokens/colors.css:17).
- Radius `var(--radius-card)` = `--radius-md` = 16 px (design/components/core/Card.jsx:15; design/tokens/radius.css:5-6).
- Shadow `var(--shadow-none)` at rest, `var(--shadow-md)` while an interactive card is hovered (design/components/core/Card.jsx:17; design/tokens/elevation.css:4, :7).
- Motion `transition: var(--transition-surface)` = background-color, box-shadow and transform over `--dur-2` 180 ms `--ease-standard` (design/components/core/Card.jsx:18; design/tokens/motion.css:3, :6, :10).
- Hover is JavaScript state, wired only when `interactive` (design/components/core/Card.jsx:6, :10-11). No focus style, no role.
- Rules: "Flat at rest. Only pass `interactive` when the whole card is clickable." (design/components/core/Card.prompt.md:9); "Stack cards with `gap: var(--sp-6)` in a `max-width: var(--measure-form)` column." (design/components/core/Card.prompt.md:10); readme: "a card is white, `1px solid var(--border-default)`, 16px radius, no shadow" (design/readme.md:127-128).
- Kit usages: every auth screen `padding="lg"` (design/ui_kits/app/Auth.jsx:14); onboarding `padding="lg"` capped at `--measure-form` (design/ui_kits/app/Onboarding.jsx:35); settings one `padding="md"` card holding every section as a flex column with `gap: var(--sp-6)` (design/ui_kits/app/AccountSettings.jsx:74); legacy editor `section`/`md`, `lg`, `sm` (design/ui_kits/app/ProfileEditor.jsx:11, :48, :118, :128); specimen `sm` at 250 px (design/components/core/core.card.html:34). No kit file passes `interactive` or `tone="sunken"` (search of design/ui_kits and design/components).

Defaults `locales=["pl","en"]`, `names={ pl: "Polski", en: "English" }`, `current="pl"`, `tone="default"` (design/components/navigation/LocaleSwitcher.jsx:3).
- `<nav aria-label="Language selection">` (English literal), `display: flex; align-items: center; gap: var(--sp-4)` (12 px) (design/components/navigation/LocaleSwitcher.jsx:6).
- Each option `<a href="#" lang={l} hrefLang={l}>`, `aria-current="true"` on the current one, click calls `onChange(l)` after `preventDefault` (design/components/navigation/LocaleSwitcher.jsx:10-16).
- Type `--type-sm`; weight `--fw-semibold` current / `--fw-regular` other (design/components/navigation/LocaleSwitcher.jsx:18-19).
- Colour: on photo `--text-on-photo` current / `rgba(255,255,255,.78)` other; otherwise `--text-strong` current / `--text-muted` other (design/components/navigation/LocaleSwitcher.jsx:20).
- Underline only on the current option, `text-underline-offset: 3px`; `padding: var(--sp-1) 0` (2 px vertical) (design/components/navigation/LocaleSwitcher.jsx:21-23). No hover style of its own; the kit's base rule removes the underline and darkens the colour on hover (design/tokens/base.css:6).
- Rules: "Two-language switch, always visible on public pages." (design/components/navigation/LocaleSwitcher.prompt.md:1); "Polish first" (:7); "No flags, no globe icon, no dropdown." (:8).

**Product today**
- No inline switch anywhere; the only switcher is `LanguageChip` in the homepage and visitor-profile bars, and there is no footer switch (docs/ui-specification.md:202, :527 D-SHELL-9; src/components/ui/footer.tsx).
- The chip's open panel is this component's markup: `<nav aria-label={LanguageSwitcher.label}>` of next-intl `Link`s with `lang`, `hrefLang` and `aria-current="true"` (src/components/ui/language-chip.tsx:109-121); names and label from the dictionary (src/components/ui/language-chip.tsx:73, :110, :125; messages/pl.json:456-459).
- Spec: C-LANGUAGE-CHIP (docs/ui-specification.md:486-531); F-SHELL-12 (:531).

**Gaps to close** (only if a text-link switch is adopted)
1. Always-visible row of both languages (design/components/navigation/LocaleSwitcher.jsx:6-29) vs a collapsed chip that shows only the current one (src/components/ui/language-chip.tsx:84-107).
2. Current language marked by weight and underline (design/components/navigation/LocaleSwitcher.jsx:19-21) vs no visual difference in the product list (src/components/ui/language-chip.tsx:120-122).
3. Label and names: English literal and prop defaults (design/components/navigation/LocaleSwitcher.jsx:3, :6) vs dictionary keys (src/components/ui/language-chip.tsx:73, :110).
4. Navigation: `href="#"` plus a callback (design/components/navigation/LocaleSwitcher.jsx:12-16) vs a real link to the same path in the other locale (src/components/ui/language-chip.tsx:114-117).

**Risks**
- Consumers: none in `src`.
- Accessibility: `lang` on each language name keeps „English” pronounced as English on a Polish page (WCAG 3.1.2, language of parts). LocaleSwitcher and the product panel set it (design/components/navigation/LocaleSwitcher.jsx:13-14; src/components/ui/language-chip.tsx:118-119); the kit's chip options and phone menu items do not (design/ui_kits/public-web/Hero.jsx:41-43; design/ui_kits/public-web/PublicProfile.jsx:65-66).
- e2e: `getByRole("link", { name: "English" })` (e2e/i18n.spec.ts:39) matches this component's links and the product's panel links, not the kit's `role="option"` items (§2 LanguageChip/AccountMenu/Footer LanguageChip risks).
- Contradiction touching LocaleSwitcher: a second switch in the profile footer (Q-C05), which D-SHELL-9 excludes (docs/ui-specification.md:527). The switch form: this component's rule "No flags, no globe icon, no dropdown." (design/components/navigation/LocaleSwitcher.prompt.md:8) describes the text-link switch, while decision A5 makes the bar's switch a flag chip with a list (design/docs/handoff/00-decyzje-2026-09-14.md:13).

### EmptyState

| reference file | equivalent in src | what to do | risks |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| design/components/feedback/EmptyState.jsx, EmptyState.d.ts, EmptyState.prompt.md; used in design/ui_kits/app/ProfileEditor.jsx:110-114 (legacy) and design/components/feedback/feedback.card.html:19; the profile kit's works empty state is an inline box, not this component (design/ui_kits/public-web/PublicProfile.jsx:186-191) | src/components/ui/empty-state.tsx (`EmptyState`) | re-skin — dashed strong border, `--type-h3` title in an `<h3>`, a 22 px icon, 48/24 px padding and an optional action; the profile screen's own box has different measurements (§2 WorkCard/OrbitTile/Lightbox, WorkCard gap 24). | One consumer (the owner's works empty state); an `<h3>` title adds a heading the spec says is absent today; the profile kit draws its own box with other measurements, and decision B6 takes the empty state from that kit (design/docs/handoff/00-decyzje-2026-09-14.md:28). |

**Reference — dimensions and behaviour**
- Contract: "A slot on the profile that has nothing in it yet — no photo, no name, no address. Dashed border, one sentence, one action." (design/components/feedback/EmptyState.d.ts:1-4); `icon` Lucide name, default `"square-dashed"`; `title?`, `body?`, `action?` node, `style` (design/components/feedback/EmptyState.d.ts:5-12; design/components/feedback/EmptyState.jsx:4).
- Box: flex column, `align-items: center`, `text-align: center`, `gap: var(--sp-4)` (12 px), `padding: var(--sp-10) var(--sp-7)` (48 px vertical, 24 px horizontal), `border: 1px dashed var(--border-strong)` (`--n-300`), `border-radius: var(--radius-card)` (16 px), `background: var(--surface-card)` (design/components/feedback/EmptyState.jsx:6-17; design/tokens/spacing.css:5; design/tokens/radius.css:5-6).
- Icon 22 px, `tone="subtle"`, background forced to `--text-subtle` (design/components/feedback/EmptyState.jsx:21).
- Title, when given: `<h3>`, `--type-h3`, `--ls-heading`, `--text-strong`, margin 0 (design/components/feedback/EmptyState.jsx:22).
- Body, when given: `<p>`, `--type-sm`, `--text-muted`, `max-width: 26rem`, margin 0 (design/components/feedback/EmptyState.jsx:23).
- Action node rendered last, no wrapper (design/components/feedback/EmptyState.jsx:24).
- No role, no live region (design/components/feedback/EmptyState.jsx:6-26).
- Rules: "Only for the owner's own view. A visitor never sees an empty state — the public profile just omits the slot." (design/components/feedback/EmptyState.prompt.md:7); readme: "`EmptyState` is used only for the owner's own view" (design/readme.md:253-254).
- The profile kit draws its works empty state inline instead: padding `--sp-14 --sp-7` (80/24 px), gap `--sp-3` (8 px), dashed `--border-strong`, `--radius-card`, no background, `folder-open` 28 px, title in a `<p>` at `--type-h3`, body `--type-sm` muted at 26rem (design/ui_kits/public-web/PublicProfile.jsx:186-191); prompt-195 describes the same 80 px / 28 px box (design/docs/claude-code-prompt-195.md:103).

**Product today**
- Props `icon` (required), `title` (required), `body` (required); no action, no default icon (src/components/ui/empty-state.tsx:6-14).
- Box: `flex flex-col items-center gap-(--sp-3)` (8 px), `rounded-md` (8 px today), solid `border-(--border-hairline)`, `bg-(--surface-card)`, `p-(--sp-8)` 32 px below `sm` / `sm:p-(--sp-10)` 48 px on all sides, centred text (src/components/ui/empty-state.tsx:16-18).
- Icon 28 px `--text-subtle`; title `<p>` `type-label` `--text-strong`; body `<p>` `type-sm` `max-w-[24rem]` `--text-muted` (src/components/ui/empty-state.tsx:19-21).
- Only call site: `icon="folder-open"`, `Works.emptyTitle` „Jeszcze bez realizacji”, `Works.emptyBody` (src/app/[locale]/(public)/[handle]/owner-profile-view.tsx:1003-1007; messages/pl.json:466-467).
- Spec: `PROFILE-OWNER.works.empty` — "icon + two `p` (no heading)" (docs/ui-specification.md:3058-3067); catalogue (:5168); F-PROFILE-6 (:3095).

**Gaps to close**
1. Border: 1 px dashed `--border-strong` (design/components/feedback/EmptyState.jsx:14) vs solid `--border-hairline` (src/components/ui/empty-state.tsx:18).
2. Padding: 48 px / 24 px (design/components/feedback/EmptyState.jsx:13) vs 32 or 48 px on all sides (src/components/ui/empty-state.tsx:18); the profile kit box uses 80 px / 24 px (design/ui_kits/public-web/PublicProfile.jsx:187).
3. Gap: 12 px (design/components/feedback/EmptyState.jsx:12) vs 8 px (src/components/ui/empty-state.tsx:18); the profile kit box uses 8 px (design/ui_kits/public-web/PublicProfile.jsx:187).
4. Icon: 22 px (design/components/feedback/EmptyState.jsx:21) vs 28 px (src/components/ui/empty-state.tsx:19); the profile kit box uses 28 px (design/ui_kits/public-web/PublicProfile.jsx:188).
5. Title: `<h3>` at `--type-h3` (design/components/feedback/EmptyState.jsx:22) vs `<p>` at `type-label` (src/components/ui/empty-state.tsx:20); the profile kit box uses a `<p>` at `--type-h3` (design/ui_kits/public-web/PublicProfile.jsx:189).
6. Body measure: 26rem (design/components/feedback/EmptyState.jsx:23) vs 24rem (src/components/ui/empty-state.tsx:21).
7. Background: the component and the product are both white (design/components/feedback/EmptyState.jsx:16; src/components/ui/empty-state.tsx:18) — a gap only against the profile kit box, which has none (design/ui_kits/public-web/PublicProfile.jsx:187).
8. Optional `action` slot and optional title/body (design/components/feedback/EmptyState.d.ts:8-10) vs three required props (src/components/ui/empty-state.tsx:10-14).

**Risks**
- Consumers (1 file): src/app/[locale]/(public)/[handle]/owner-profile-view.tsx:10.
- e2e: `getByText("Jeszcze bez realizacji")` (e2e/db/works.spec.ts:768) survives either element; the copy change for `Works.emptyBody` is section 4 (decision B6, design/docs/handoff/00-decyzje-2026-09-14.md:28).
- Accessibility: an `<h3>` title adds a heading level-3 to the profile outline, where the works section heading `Works.heading` is removed by the redesign (§7, PR 9 prompt 4); the page's heading order would jump from the panel's `h1` to this `h3`.
- F-PROFILE-6 (copy naming the wrong mode, docs/ui-specification.md:3095) is still present in the kit (Q-F09).

### StatusMessage

| reference file | equivalent in src | what to do | risks |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| design/components/feedback/StatusMessage.jsx, StatusMessage.d.ts, StatusMessage.prompt.md; used in design/ui_kits/app/Auth.jsx:67, :122, Onboarding.jsx:69-71, AccountSettings.jsx:88, :99, :109, ProfileEditor.jsx:77, :101 (legacy), design/components/feedback/feedback.card.html:13-17; the same roles appear inside design/components/forms/FormField.jsx:12-17 (§2 Button/Input/Icon) | none as a component; about 35 hand-written `<p role="status">` / `<p role="alert">` lines (list under Product today) and `ResendStatus` (src/app/[locale]/(auth)/resend-status.tsx) | new — no tinted status box exists in `src`, and every status line sets its own classes and role. | Live-region announcements change with the role mapping (danger → alert); several e2e helpers find these lines by exact text; where the tinted box replaces a heading-and-body block the structure changes (Q-H07, Q-H16). |

**Reference — dimensions and behaviour**
- Contract: "Every sentence the system says back to the user: sent, saved, rate-limited, failed. Announced live — danger as alert, everything else as status." (design/components/feedback/StatusMessage.d.ts:1-4); `tone` `"info" | "success" | "danger" | "warning"` (default info); `plain` — "No tinted box and no icon — just the coloured line, as the forms use it." (design/components/feedback/StatusMessage.d.ts:5-11; design/components/feedback/StatusMessage.jsx:11).
- Tones as background / text / icon: info `--state-info-bg` / `--state-info` / `info`; success `--state-success-bg` / `--state-success` / `check`; danger `--state-danger-bg` / `--state-danger` / `triangle-alert`; warning `--state-warning-bg` / `--state-warning` / `clock`; an unknown tone falls back to info (design/components/feedback/StatusMessage.jsx:4-9, :12; design/tokens/colors.css:12).
- Role: `alert` for danger, `status` for every other tone, in both forms (design/components/feedback/StatusMessage.jsx:15, :22).
- `plain`: `<p>`, `--type-sm`, text in the tone colour, margin 0 (design/components/feedback/StatusMessage.jsx:13-18).
- Box: `<div>`, `display: flex; gap: var(--sp-3)` (8 px), `align-items: flex-start`, `padding: var(--sp-4) var(--sp-5)` (12 px / 16 px), `border-radius: var(--radius-control)` (12 px), tone background, tone text colour, `--type-sm` (design/components/feedback/StatusMessage.jsx:20-33; design/tokens/spacing.css:5; design/tokens/radius.css:5-6).
- Icon 16 px in the tone colour, `margin-top: 3px`, `aria-hidden` through `Icon`; text in a `<span>` with `min-width: 0` (design/components/feedback/StatusMessage.jsx:36-37; design/components/core/Icon.jsx:18).
- Rules: "Inside a form use `plain`; for a whole-card outcome use the tinted box." (design/components/feedback/StatusMessage.prompt.md:8); "Copy comes from the product's dictionaries — full sentences, no exclamation marks." (:9).
- Kit usages: register sent — info box (design/ui_kits/app/Auth.jsx:67); two-factor e-mail code sent — info box shown at once (:122); onboarding step 2 — warning box about the 30-day lock (design/ui_kits/app/Onboarding.jsx:69-71); settings address changed and password changed — success boxes inside the forms (design/ui_kits/app/AccountSettings.jsx:88, :99); settings e-mail sent — info box followed by a muted TextLink (:108-111); legacy editor — plain success „Name saved.” and a success box (design/ui_kits/app/ProfileEditor.jsx:77, :101); specimens of all four tones and one plain danger line (design/components/feedback/feedback.card.html:13-17).
- The profile and work-page kits render no status line at all for saves (§2 AboutPanel, AboutPanel reference: "No status line („Zapisano profil”) … exist in the reference panel or kit").

**Product today**
- Success lines, `type-sm text-(--state-success)` `role="status"`: src/app/[locale]/(app)/handle-form.tsx:432-437 (`HANDLE-FORM.result.saved`); src/app/[locale]/(app)/settings/account/change-password-form.tsx:129-133 (`SETTINGS-ACCOUNT.password.done`); src/app/[locale]/(auth)/resend-status.tsx:17-22 (`REGISTER.sent.status`, `LOGIN.not-verified.status`, `REGISTER-VERIFIED.resend.status`); src/app/[locale]/(auth)/two-factor/two-factor-challenge.tsx:155-159 (`TWO-FACTOR.otp.status`); src/app/[locale]/(public)/[handle]/owner-profile-view.tsx:804-808 (`PROFILE-OWNER.card.saved-notice`).
- Neutral lines, `type-sm text-(--text-muted)` `role="status"`: src/app/[locale]/(app)/handle-form.tsx:402-406, :439-443; the feedback line switches between `status` and `alert` and between muted, success and danger colours (src/app/[locale]/(app)/handle-form.tsx:63-67, :393-401).
- Danger lines, `type-sm text-(--state-danger)` `role="alert"`: src/app/[locale]/(app)/settings/account/change-email-form.tsx:107-111; change-password-form.tsx:124-128; two-factor-settings.tsx:191, :252, :285, :326; src/app/[locale]/(auth)/login/login-form.tsx:138-142; register/register-form.tsx:162-166; reset-password/request-form.tsx:97; reset-password/new/new-password-form.tsx:122; two-factor/two-factor-challenge.tsx:189-197; src/app/[locale]/(public)/[handle]/owner-profile-view.tsx:817, :826, :1011, :1099, :1315; work-form.tsx:1606; works-gallery.tsx:428; src/components/ui/account-menu.tsx:102.
- Danger-coloured lines announced as `status`, not `alert`: resend „limited” and „failed” (src/app/[locale]/(auth)/resend-status.tsx:24-36).
- Block alerts: the login not-verified block is a `role="alert"` container that holds a resend button and a nested `ResendStatus` `role="status"` line (src/app/[locale]/(auth)/login/login-form.tsx:144-166); the dead reset link block (src/app/[locale]/(auth)/reset-password/new/new-password-form.tsx:79).
- Visually hidden status lines: src/app/[locale]/(public)/[handle]/owner-profile-view.tsx:873, :1015; src/components/ui/upload-progress.tsx:39.
- Outcome blocks without any live role: settings e-mail sent (h3 + body, src/app/[locale]/(app)/settings/account/change-email-form.tsx:62-79; `SETTINGS-ACCOUNT.email.sent`, docs/ui-specification.md:2562-2570); register sent (h2 + body, src/app/[locale]/(auth)/register/register-form.tsx:85-89).

The four state pairs exist as tokens (src/app/globals.css:62-68, :110-116).
- Spec elements that are status or alert lines: `LOGIN.form.error` (docs/ui-specification.md:919), `LOGIN.not-verified.message` (:937), `LOGIN.not-verified.status` (:969), `REGISTER.form.error` (:1148), `REGISTER.sent.status` (:1207), `REGISTER-VERIFIED.resend.status` (:1403), `RESET-REQUEST.form.error` (:1496), `RESET-NEW.form.error` (:1660), `RESET-NEW.dead-token.alert` (:1718), `TWO-FACTOR.otp.status` (:1902), `TWO-FACTOR.form.error` (:1937), `HANDLE-FORM.field.feedback` (:2328), `.field.cooldown-note` (:2348), `.result.saved` (:2366), `.result.saved-redirect` (:2375), `SETTINGS-ACCOUNT.password.form-error` (:2498), `.password.done` (:2507), `.email.form-error` (:2541), `.two-factor.*-error` (:2593, :2627, :2681, :2736), `PROFILE-OWNER.card.saved-notice` (:3030), `ACCOUNT-MENU.panel.error` (:428); findings F-AUTH-5 (:838), F-ACCOUNT-8 (:2430).

**Gaps to close**
1. Component: one `StatusMessage` with tone → colour, icon and role (design/components/feedback/StatusMessage.jsx:4-40) vs per-call classes and roles (list above).
2. Tinted box (12/16 px padding, 12 px radius, 16 px icon) for whole-card outcomes (design/components/feedback/StatusMessage.jsx:20-38) vs no box anywhere (src/app/[locale]/(auth)/register/register-form.tsx:85-89; src/app/[locale]/(app)/settings/account/change-email-form.tsx:62-79).

4. Warning and info tones: used by the kit (design/ui_kits/app/Onboarding.jsx:69; design/ui_kits/app/Auth.jsx:67, :122) vs no warning or info status line in the product (search of `src` for `state-warning` and `state-info` finds only counters and tokens: src/app/[locale]/(public)/[handle]/owner-profile-view.tsx:1089, work-form.tsx:1661, src/app/globals.css:65-68).
5. Neutral status colour: the reference has no neutral tone — `info` uses `--state-info` (`#3c4650`, design/tokens/colors.css:12) — vs `--text-muted` for neutral lines (src/app/[locale]/(app)/handle-form.tsx:66, :403, :440).
6. Icons `info`, `triangle-alert`, `clock` are not in the product set (§2 Button/Input/Icon, Icon gap 1).

**Risks**
- Consumers: none (new). Adoption touches every file in the Product today list.
- e2e finds status and alert text by exact string: „Ten adres jest wolny.” (e2e/db/happy-path.spec.ts:109; e2e/db/account.ts:208), „Zapisano profil” (e2e/db/profile-sections.spec.ts:112, :137), „Zbyt wiele prób. Odczekaj chwilę i spróbuj ponownie.” (e2e/db/account.ts:147, :156, :175; e2e/db/avatar-upload.spec.ts:269), „Wysyłka pliku nie powiodła się. Spróbuj ponownie.” (e2e/db/avatar-upload.spec.ts:246), „Limit 3 żądań na godzinę został wykorzystany.” (e2e/db/password-reset.spec.ts:57), „Nieprawidłowy e-mail lub hasło.” (e2e/db/password-reset.spec.ts:95), `/wysłaliśmy na Twój obecny adres/` (e2e/db/email-change.spec.ts:63). The box wraps text in a `<span>` (design/components/feedback/StatusMessage.jsx:37), which `getByText` still matches; a copy change breaks them (section 4).
- Accessibility: moving danger lines that are `status` today to `alert` makes them interrupt the screen reader; nesting a `StatusMessage` inside a `role="alert"` block (as login does today, src/app/[locale]/(auth)/login/login-form.tsx:145, :160) keeps two live regions; `FormField` also renders its own `alert` / `status` lines (design/components/forms/FormField.jsx:12-17), so a field error plus a `StatusMessage` can double-announce (§2 Button/Input/Icon Input risks).
- Contradictions touching StatusMessage: register sent structure (Q-H07), e-mail sent note (Q-H16), onboarding warning (Q-H11). The kit's settings forms use the tinted box inside a form (design/ui_kits/app/AccountSettings.jsx:88, :99), where the component's note says to use `plain` (design/components/feedback/StatusMessage.prompt.md:8). The kit's address-changed line says the old address redirects for 30 days (design/ui_kits/app/AccountSettings.jsx:8); A6 keeps it redirecting until someone claims the old name (SPEC.md:57).

### HandleField

| reference file | equivalent in src | what to do | risks |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| design/components/forms/HandleField.jsx, HandleField.d.ts, HandleField.prompt.md; used in design/ui_kits/app/Onboarding.jsx:62-68, ProfileEditor.jsx:93-99 (legacy), design/components/forms/forms.card.html:21-22; the kit's settings screen does not use it (design/ui_kits/app/AccountSettings.jsx:84-87) | src/app/[locale]/(app)/handle-form.tsx (`HandleForm`, the field part: label, input, preview, hint, feedback) | rebuild — the reference puts the host inside the field, adds a state badge and an always-visible preview row, reorders the lines and has fewer states than the product. | The in-field prefix reverses D-ACCOUNT-6; `reserved` changes from a blocking problem to a neutral status; two onboarding e2e helpers drive this field. |

**Reference — dimensions and behaviour**
- Contract: "The product's signature field: the handle that becomes the visitor's public address. Origin prefix inside the border, live availability, and a preview of the finished address underneath." (design/components/forms/HandleField.d.ts:1-4); props `label` (default "Profile address"), `origin` — "Host without a scheme; rendered as prefix and in the preview line" (default "architektow3d.pl"), `value`, `onChange`, `state` `"idle" | "checking" | "available" | "taken" | "reserved" | "own" | "invalid"` (default idle) — "Drives the badge and which line the message renders as", `message` — "The sentence for the current state, from the product's dictionaries", `hint`, `id` (default "handle"), `style` (design/components/forms/HandleField.d.ts:8-21; design/components/forms/HandleField.jsx:16-26).
- Wrapper: flex column, `gap: var(--sp-3)` (8 px) between the field group and the preview row (design/components/forms/HandleField.jsx:29).
- Field group: `FormField` with `label`, `htmlFor={id}`, `hint`; `error` = `message` when `taken` or `invalid`; `status` = `message` when `checking`, `available`, `own` or `reserved`; neither when `idle` (design/components/forms/HandleField.jsx:30-36). Through `FormField` the lines are label → input → error (`role="alert"`, danger) or status (`role="status"`, muted) → hint (subtle), 4 px apart (design/components/forms/FormField.jsx:5-20; §2 Button/Input/Icon FormField bullets).
- Input: `mono`, `prefix={origin + "/"}`, `invalid` when `taken` or `invalid`, `autoComplete="off"`, `spellCheck={false}` (design/components/forms/HandleField.jsx:37-46); the prefix sits inside the 48 px bordered box in `--type-mono` `--text-subtle` (design/components/forms/Input.jsx:46-70; §2 Button/Input/Icon Input bullets). No `name`, `maxLength`, `autoCapitalize`, `required`, `disabled` or `aria-describedby` (design/components/forms/HandleField.jsx:37-46).
- Preview row: flex, `align-items: center`, `gap: var(--sp-3)` (8 px), no wrapping rule (design/components/forms/HandleField.jsx:48); eyebrow "Your address" (English literal) in `--type-eyebrow`, `--ls-caps`, uppercase, `--text-subtle` (:49-51); `{origin}/{value || "…"}` in `--type-mono` `--text-strong` — shown even when the value is empty (:52-54); a `Badge` (mono, 24 px) per state (:55).
- Badge per state: `checking` neutral „checking…”, `available` success „free”, `taken` danger „taken”, `reserved` warning „reserved”, `own` neutral „yours”, `invalid` danger „invalid”, `idle` none — English literals (design/components/forms/HandleField.jsx:6-14, :27, :55).
- Rules: "Handle picker used in onboarding and in profile settings" (design/components/forms/HandleField.prompt.md:1); "Always show the address preview line" (:13); "`checking` must be debounced upstream — the badge should not flicker per keystroke." (:14).
- Kit usages: onboarding step 2, states computed locally (`idle`, `invalid` under 3 characters, `taken` from a list, `available`), hint "3 to 30 characters: lowercase letters, digits and hyphens.", in a column with `gap: var(--sp-6)` followed by a warning `StatusMessage` and the buttons (design/ui_kits/app/Onboarding.jsx:19-30, :61-75); legacy editor with `own` (design/ui_kits/app/ProfileEditor.jsx:29-35, :93-99). The kit's settings address uses `FormField` + `Input mono` without a prefix, a mono subtle preview `https://dev.architektow3d.pl/<wbr>{handle}` inside the field group, `status` = „To jest Twój obecny adres.” when unchanged, and the hint as the error text when invalid (design/ui_kits/app/AccountSettings.jsx:24, :84-87).

**Product today**
- `HandleForm` column `gap-(--sp-3)` (8 px) for every line (src/app/[locale]/(app)/handle-form.tsx:333-337).
- Label `type-label text-(--text-body)` `HandleForm.label` „Adres profilu” (src/app/[locale]/(app)/handle-form.tsx:338-340; messages/pl.json:96).
- Input: no prefix ("The prefix used to sit INSIDE the field…", src/app/[locale]/(app)/handle-form.tsx:341-345), `id`/`name` handle, `mono`, `autoComplete="off"`, `autoCapitalize="none"`, `spellCheck={false}`, `maxLength` 30, `required`, disabled while the change limit runs, lowercases as typed, `aria-invalid` on a problem, `aria-describedby="handle-hint handle-feedback"` (src/app/[locale]/(app)/handle-form.tsx:328-330, :346-368).
- Preview: only when the value is non-empty; `<p>` `type-sm wrap-break-word text-(--text-muted)`, visually hidden „Twój adres profilu:”, then `{origin}/<wbr>{normalized}` in mono; `origin` is the APP_URL origin with its scheme (src/app/[locale]/(app)/handle-form.tsx:86-87, :380-389; messages/pl.json:115).
- Hint `p#handle-hint` `type-sm text-(--text-muted)` (src/app/[locale]/(app)/handle-form.tsx:390-392).
- Feedback `p#handle-feedback`: one line; role `alert` for problems, else `status`; colour danger for problems, success for `available`, muted otherwise (src/app/[locale]/(app)/handle-form.tsx:63-67, :240-256, :393-401).
- States beyond the reference: `rateLimited`, `failed` (no line), submit errors `cooldown` / `generic`, the lock with its date, the forward-looking change warning, saved and redirect lines (src/app/[locale]/(app)/handle-form.tsx:29-37, :81-83, :220-236, :402-443). `reserved` is a problem: red, `alert`, `aria-invalid`, submit disabled (src/app/[locale]/(app)/handle-form.tsx:55-59, :201-206).
- Live check 400 ms after typing stops, aborting the previous request (src/app/[locale]/(app)/handle-form.tsx:24, :171-195).
- Call sites: onboarding (src/app/[locale]/(app)/onboarding/onboarding-steps.tsx:13, :102); settings (src/app/[locale]/(app)/settings/account/page.tsx:17, :136-142).
- Spec: C-HANDLE-FORM (docs/ui-specification.md:2281-2431), `HANDLE-FORM.field.input` (:2305), `.field.preview` (:2318), `.field.feedback` (:2328); D-ACCOUNT-5 (:2423), D-ACCOUNT-6 (:2424), D-ACCOUNT-7 (:2425); F-ACCOUNT-8 (:2430), F-ACCOUNT-9 (:2431).

**Gaps to close**
1. Host inside the field (design/components/forms/HandleField.jsx:40; design/components/forms/Input.jsx:46-70) vs none (src/app/[locale]/(app)/handle-form.tsx:341-345; docs/ui-specification.md:2424) — Q-H10.

**Risks**
- Consumers of `HandleForm` (2 files): src/app/[locale]/(app)/onboarding/onboarding-steps.tsx:13, src/app/[locale]/(app)/settings/account/page.tsx:17.
- e2e: `getByLabel("Adres profilu")` then `fill` (e2e/db/happy-path.spec.ts:102; e2e/db/account.ts:205) keeps working while the label is a `<label for>` on the input; a `fill` into a field whose visible prefix is a separate `<span>` still types only the handle. `getByText("Ten adres jest wolny.")` with a 15 s timeout (e2e/db/happy-path.spec.ts:109; e2e/db/account.ts:208) keeps working if the message copy stays; the badge copy must not repeat that sentence or strict mode fails. The submit „Ustaw adres” (docs/ui-specification.md:2393) is outside HandleField.
- Accessibility: the badge is not live and duplicates the message in English literals (design/components/forms/HandleField.jsx:6-14); the preview row can overflow a phone card with a long handle because it has no wrap rule (design/components/forms/HandleField.jsx:48-54) — the overflow the product fixed (src/app/[locale]/(app)/handle-form.tsx:369-379).
- Decisions touched: D-ACCOUNT-6 (prefix and preview), D-ACCOUNT-5 (`reserved` and a failed check); findings F-ACCOUNT-8 (silent failed check) unaddressed by the reference.
- Contradictions touching HandleField: prefix (Q-H10), onboarding warning (Q-H11). The component's usage example reads "8 to 30 characters" (design/components/forms/HandleField.prompt.md:9); A5 allows 3–30 (SPEC.md:56), as the kit's onboarding hint does (design/ui_kits/app/Onboarding.jsx:67).

| reference file | equivalent in src | what to do | risks |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| design/components/forms/PhotoUpload.jsx, PhotoUpload.d.ts, PhotoUpload.prompt.md; used only in design/ui_kits/app/ProfileEditor.jsx:82-89 (the editor that predates panel editing, design/readme.md:195) and design/components/forms/forms.card.html:23 | none as a component; the owner's avatar picker in src/app/[locale]/(public)/[handle]/owner-profile-view.tsx:686-742 with src/components/ui/upload-progress.tsx (`UploadProgress`) | unchanged — no screen targeted by prompt-195 or the 14.09 decisions renders PhotoUpload; the avatar camera is mapped under AboutPanel (§2 AboutPanel) and prompt-195 keeps C-UPLOAD-PROGRESS as it is. | If PhotoUpload were used, its busy label would replace the percentage bar and cancel button that D-FORM-26 and SPEC A13 require. |

**Reference — dimensions and behaviour**
- Contract: "Profile-photo row: the current photo (or monogram) beside the file picker and its format hint. Mirrors the product's presign → PUT → confirm flow." (design/components/forms/PhotoUpload.d.ts:1-4); props `src`, `name`, `size` (default 128), `emptyLabel` (default "You have no profile photo yet."), `chooseLabel` ("Choose a photo"), `hint` ("JPEG, PNG or WebP, up to 10 MB. We crop it to a square."), `busy` (false), `busyLabel` ("Uploading and processing…"), `onChoose`, `style` (design/components/forms/PhotoUpload.d.ts:5-16; design/components/forms/PhotoUpload.jsx:5-16).
- Row: flex, `gap: var(--sp-7)` (24 px), `align-items: flex-start`, `flex-wrap: wrap` (design/components/forms/PhotoUpload.jsx:18).
- `Avatar` at `size`, alt "Your current profile photo" when a photo exists (design/components/forms/PhotoUpload.jsx:19); `Avatar` draws a 1 px `--border-default` ring (design/components/core/Avatar.jsx:16).
- Column: flex column, `gap: var(--sp-3)` (8 px), `min-width: 0`, `flex: 1` (design/components/forms/PhotoUpload.jsx:20).
- Empty label `<p>` `--type-sm` `--text-muted`, only without a photo (design/components/forms/PhotoUpload.jsx:21).
- `Button variant="quiet"` with `chooseLabel`, `onClick={onChoose}`, `disabled={busy}` — no file input of its own (design/components/forms/PhotoUpload.jsx:22).
- Hint `<p>` `--type-sm` `--text-subtle`; while busy the same line shows `busyLabel` instead (design/components/forms/PhotoUpload.jsx:23). No progress bar, no percentage, no cancel, no error line, no live role.
- Rules: "The one upload surface in the product — the profile photo." (design/components/forms/PhotoUpload.prompt.md:1); "Never a drag-and-drop zone: the product's own UI is a plain file button." (:7); "While busy the hint line is replaced by the progress sentence; the button disables." (:8). Readme: "A busy control changes its label; there is no spinner in this system." and "no skeleton shimmer" (design/readme.md:156-157).

**Product today**

The reference replacement is the 44 px camera button on the panel's avatar (§2 AboutPanel, AboutPanel gap 26).

- `UploadProgress`: props `fraction` 0..1, `label`, `onCancel`, `compact`, `className` (src/components/ui/upload-progress.tsx:11-26); row flex `gap-(--sp-3)` (:36-38); visually hidden `role="status"` announcing the label at start and „Przetwarzanie…” once (:31-41); `role="progressbar"` with `aria-label`, `aria-valuemin` 0, `aria-valuemax` 100, `aria-valuenow` absent while processing, `aria-valuetext` „Wysyłanie {percent}%” (:42-48; messages/pl.json:271-272); track 6 px (`h-1.5`) full-radius, `--surface-sunken` (compact: white 30 %) (:49-51); fill `--action-solid` (compact: white), 200 ms width transition, pulsing under `motion-safe:` while processing (:53-58); percentage in mono tabular digits, `type-sm` muted (compact: `type-eyebrow` white), `aria-hidden` (:60-67); cancel 32 px round (compact 28 px on `n-950/70`), `x` 14 px (12 px), label „Przerwij wysyłanie”, only while bytes move (:68-82; messages/pl.json:273).

**Gaps to close**

### Brand mark and logo (A3D mark, `Mark`, `LogoMark`, `Logo`, `BrandMark`)

| reference file | equivalent in src | what to do | risks |

| No component; inline marks in design/components/navigation/TopBar.jsx:42-64, design/ui_kits/public-web/Hero.jsx:52-58, :65-67 (`HeroMark`), design/ui_kits/app/Auth.jsx:10-13, design/components/profile/ProfileBar.jsx:56-57 (§2 ProfileBar); design/readme.md:32-35, :258 | src/components/ui/mark.tsx (`Mark`), src/components/ui/logo-mark.tsx (`LogoMark`), src/components/ui/logo.tsx (`Logo`), src/app/brand-mark.tsx (`BrandMark` for the tab and home-screen icons) | re-skin — the square's radius, letter size, weight and tracking change, and the image-route copy keeps ratios that stop matching the browser mark once the tokens PR lands. | 10 files render `Logo` and 1 renders `LogoMark`; `brand-mark.tsx` states a sync rule it cannot keep, and two of its comments are false today. |

- Hero mark (`HeroMark`): whole `<span aria-hidden="true">`, 30 × 30 px, `flex: 0 0 auto`, same radius and colours, `font-family: var(--font-sans)`, `--fw-bold`, `font-size: 11px`, `letter-spacing: -.02em`, band 12 % (design/ui_kits/public-web/Hero.jsx:52-58); link `inline-flex`, gap 8 px, colour inherited; wordmark „Architektów 3d” `--type-h3`, `--ls-heading`, white (design/ui_kits/public-web/Hero.jsx:65-67).

5. Vertical centring: letters centred on the whole square (design/components/navigation/TopBar.jsx:45-47) vs `padding-bottom: band / 2` (src/components/ui/mark.tsx:19; src/app/brand-mark.tsx:70).
6. Size on the profile: 32 px (design/components/profile/ProfileBar.jsx:56) vs 30 px — §2 ProfileBar, ProfileBar gap 6.
7. Auth size: 30 px mark + `--type-h3` (design/ui_kits/app/Auth.jsx:11-12) vs 26 px + `type-h4` (src/components/ui/logo-mark.tsx:28-29) — Q-H05.
8. Mark-to-wordmark gap: 8 px at every width (design/components/navigation/TopBar.jsx:42; design/ui_kits/public-web/Hero.jsx:65; design/ui_kits/app/Auth.jsx:10) vs 8 px below `sm`, 12 px from `sm` (src/components/ui/logo-mark.tsx:36).
9. Wordmark source: literal „Architektów 3d” (design/components/navigation/TopBar.jsx:8; design/ui_kits/public-web/Hero.jsx:66; design/ui_kits/app/Auth.jsx:12) vs `Brand.wordmark` (src/components/ui/logo.tsx:20-21). Wordmark tracking already matches: `--ls-heading` in the reference (design/components/navigation/TopBar.jsx:63) and in the product's `.type-h3` class (src/app/globals.css:279-282).

**Risks**
- Consumers: `Logo` in 10 files (src/app/[locale]/(app)/settings/account/page.tsx:9; src/app/[locale]/(auth)/email-changed/page.tsx:4, login/page.tsx:4, register/page.tsx:4, register/verified/page.tsx:5, reset-password/new/page.tsx:4, reset-password/page.tsx:4, two-factor/page.tsx:4; src/app/[locale]/(public)/page.tsx:7; src/app/[locale]/(public)/[handle]/page.tsx:31); `LogoMark` in src/app/[locale]/(public)/[handle]/owner-profile-view.tsx:13 and src/components/ui/logo.tsx:4; `Mark` in src/components/ui/logo-mark.tsx:3; `BrandMark` in src/app/icon.tsx:2 and src/app/apple-icon.tsx:2.
- Drift: the tokens PR changes `rounded-xs` for the browser mark and the logo link's focus ring shape (src/components/ui/logo-mark.tsx:49) without touching `BrandMark`, so the tab icon and the bar mark stop matching unless `RADIUS_RATIO` changes in the same PR (src/app/brand-mark.tsx:10-11, :24).
- Weight in images: the committed font file is a static 700 face (src/app/brand-mark.tsx:39, :44); a 750 letter weight cannot be drawn in the icon images without a different font file.
- Accessibility: the reference TopBar and Auth marks leave "A3D" readable (only the band is `aria-hidden`, design/components/navigation/TopBar.jsx:61; design/ui_kits/app/Auth.jsx:11), so a link built that way would be named "A3D Architektów 3d", against the spec's "the A3D mark is not announced" (docs/ui-specification.md:575); the hero and profile marks hide it (design/ui_kits/public-web/Hero.jsx:54; design/components/profile/ProfileBar.jsx:56). The reference draws no focus style for the logo link (design/components/navigation/TopBar.jsx:42; design/ui_kits/public-web/Hero.jsx:65); the product draws a ring (src/components/ui/logo-mark.tsx:24-26, :49).
- e2e: no test selects the logo (docs/ui-specification.md:580). The title template test reads „· Architektów 3d” from the page title, not from the logo (e2e/db/happy-path.spec.ts:201).
- Decisions and findings: D-SHELL-10 / D-AUTH-6 (non-link auth logo) kept by prompt-195 (design/docs/claude-code-prompt-195.md:64); on profiles the mark stops being a link (§2 ProfileBar); F-SHELL-14 (the "A3D" lettering outside dictionaries) is not addressed by the reference, which also hard-codes it.

---

**Contradictions touching this part (section 6):** Q-C05 — A second language switcher in the profile footer; Q-F09 — Empty-state copy names „Edytuj” and shows during editing; Q-G13 — Dashed „drop tile” versus „Never a drag-and-drop zone”; Q-H05 — Auth logo: compact pairing versus the kit's top-bar-size mark; Q-H06 — Auth frame: phone step-downs and 24 px padding versus one kit set; Q-H07 — Register "sent" state: kept structure versus kit's new heading and actions; Q-H10 — Handle field: address prefix inside the border versus a bare field; Q-H11 — 30-day change warning shown during onboarding; Q-H12 — Settings bar on a phone: chip before the menu, or language inside it; Q-H13 — Settings bar: `measure-page` and 56 px phone height versus kit TopBar; Q-H14 — Settings sections: one card with dividers or a column of cards; Q-H15 — Settings column: card width and padding by width; Q-H16 — E-mail change "sent" note: kit predates the 13.09 fix and adds a link; Q-H17 — Two-factor settings: setup and password-guarded disable versus kit method rows; Q-H18 — Settings address line: `https://` in body type versus bare mono host

## 3. Screens

### 3.1 The profile — `/{handle}` · `/en/{handle}`

Both addresses render the same page; the English one differs only in dictionary strings, canonical URL and `og:locale` (`src/lib/public-profile.ts:175-207`). Every row below therefore applies to both. "Viewer" uses the spec's words (`docs/ui-specification.md:51`): `signed-out`, `no-handle` (signed in, no handle yet), `other` (signed in, someone else's profile), `owner`. Widths: desktop = the 1440 px reference stage, phone = the 390 px stage (`design/ui_kits/public-web/shots.html:5-6`); the line between them is the `phone` prop, below 40rem (`design/components/profile/AboutPanel.d.ts:29`).

#### `/{handle}` · `/en/{handle}`

##### Layout, top to bottom

Tokens used below (values from `design/tokens/spacing.css:5`, `design/tokens/colors.css:9,21`, `design/tokens/motion.css:3-4`, `design/tokens/radius.css:6`): `--sp-3` 8 px, `--sp-4` 12 px, `--sp-5` 16 px, `--sp-6` 20 px, `--sp-7` 24 px, `--sp-8` 32 px, `--sp-9` 40 px, `--sp-10` 48 px, `--sp-12` 64 px, `--sp-14` 80 px, `--sp-16` 96 px; `--measure-works` 100rem (`spacing.css:11`); `--plaque-navy-deep` `#063684`; `--scrim-photo` `rgba(12,17,22,.42)`; `--dur-2` 180 ms, `--dur-3` 280 ms. `src/app/globals.css` has `--sp-14` / `--sp-16` (`src/app/globals.css:184-185`) but no `--measure-works` and no `--radius-picture` (no match in the file).

1. **Bar — two fixed layers** (component `ProfileBar`; section 2 owns its internals). What the page decides:
   - Toolbar `<header>`: `position: fixed; top: 0; left: 0; right: 0; z-index: 44`, height 64 px desktop / 56 px phone, side padding `--sp-7` 24 px desktop / `--sp-4` 12 px phone, `pointer-events: none` except the right slot (`ProfileBar.jsx:22,27-40,46`). Transparent with no border while the band is under it; `--surface-card` with a 1 px `--border-hairline` bottom once solid; background/border/colour transition `--dur-2` (`ProfileBar.jsx:37-41`). Right-slot gap `--sp-3` 8 px phone / `--sp-4` 12 px desktop (`ProfileBar.jsx:46`).
   - Logo button (A3D mark 32 px + label + `chevron-right` 18 px) is a separate `position: fixed` layer, `z-index: 48`, height 44 px, `top: (bar − 44) / 2` = 10 px desktop / 6 px phone, `left` 24 / 12 px (`ProfileBar.jsx:48-54`). It toggles the panel; `disabled` while identity editing (`ProfileBar.jsx:52-53`, `PublicProfile.jsx:164`). Accessible name „Otwórz panel: {name}” / „Zamknij panel: {name}”, `aria-expanded` (`ProfileBar.jsx:50-51`). Label crossfades studio name → „Architektów 3d” when the panel opens; chevron rotates 180°, `--dur-3` (`ProfileBar.jsx:59-63`). Group ink when the panel is open at every width (`ProfileBar.jsx:21`). The logo is not inside the `<header>` element (`ProfileBar.jsx:24-65`: sibling in a fragment).
   - `solid` = the band's bottom edge has passed under the bar: `IntersectionObserver` on the band, `rootMargin: -{bar}px 0 0 0`, `threshold: 0` (`PublicProfile.jsx:16-25,117-120`). `onPhoto` = not solid (`PublicProfile.jsx:120`).
   - Right slot by viewer (`PublicProfile.jsx:121-141`):
     - `signed-out` desktop: LanguageChip, „Zaloguj się” (`onPhotoQuiet`, `ghost` when solid), „Załóż konto” (`onPhoto`, `solid` when solid). Phone: hamburger button 40 × 40, icon `menu` 22 px, on-photo tone while transparent (`PublicProfile.jsx:91-95`).
     - `other`: desktop LanguageChip + AccountMenu; phone AccountMenu only.
     - `owner`: desktop LanguageChip; then (every width) the pencil — 40 × 40, round, background `rgba(255,255,255,.94)`, `--shadow-md`, icon `pencil` 16 px, `aria-label` and `title` „Edytuj profil”, `aria-pressed` = editing, `disabled` and opacity 0.5 while editing (`PublicProfile.jsx:138`); then AccountMenu.
   - Popovers (all viewers): menu `position: absolute; top: calc(100% + 8px); right: 0; min-width: 224px`, padding `--sp-2`, `--radius-lg`, `--shadow-lift`, 1 px hairline, items 2 px apart (`PublicProfile.jsx:44`); items 44 px tall, padding `0 --sp-4`, `--radius-sm`, icon 18 muted, trailing `check` 16 for the current language (`PublicProfile.jsx:54-57`); dismissed by outside press, Escape or a pick (`PublicProfile.jsx:34-39,72,90`). AccountMenu trigger: 40 × 40, `box-shadow: 0 0 0 2px var(--surface-card)`, radius `--radius-xs` when the avatar is square else `--radius-full` (`PublicProfile.jsx:74-75`). Items: „Profil” (`user`), „Konto” (`settings`), phone only „─, Polski / English” with flags, „─, Wyloguj” (`log-out`) (`PublicProfile.jsx:80-84`). Visitor menu: „Polski / English, ─, Zaloguj się” (`log-in`), „Załóż konto” (`user-plus`) (`PublicProfile.jsx:98-101`).

2. **Cover band** — always present, scrolls with the page (not sticky) (`PublicProfile.jsx:109,165`).
   - Box: `position: relative; z-index: 2; background: var(--n-900)`; height `clamp(168px, 19vh, 240px)` desktop, `clamp(128px, 17vh, 150px)` phone. The floor is computed as bar + avatar/2 + gap = 64 + 88 + 16 = 168 / 56 + 60 + 12 = 128 (`PublicProfile.jsx:144-147,165`).
   - Click layer: `position: absolute; inset: 0; overflow: hidden`, `role="button"`, `tabIndex 0`, `aria-expanded`, same accessible name as the logo; click, Enter or Space toggles the panel; does nothing while editing (`PublicProfile.jsx:166`).
   - Photo: `object-fit: cover; object-position: 50% 45%`, alt „Zdjęcie w tle profilu {name}” (`PublicProfile.jsx:168`).
   - Placeholder (no cover): `aria-hidden`, `background: repeating-linear-gradient(135deg, rgba(255,255,255,.035) 0 2px, transparent 2px 14px), linear-gradient(180deg, var(--plaque-navy-deep), #052a68)` (`PublicProfile.jsx:171`).
   - Top scrim over both: `linear-gradient(to bottom, rgba(12,17,22,.5), rgba(12,17,22,0) 60%)` (`PublicProfile.jsx:173`).

3. **Page avatar + name** — inside the band's stacking layer.
   - Wrapper: `position: absolute; left: max(padX, calc((100% - var(--measure-works)) / 2 + padX)); right: padX; bottom: -avatar/2` (−88 px desktop / −60 px phone), flex, `align-items: flex-end`, gap `--sp-6` 20 px desktop / `--sp-4` 12 px phone, `z-index: 3`, `pointer-events: none` (only the avatar takes `auto`) (`PublicProfile.jsx:142,151,175-176`). padX = 24 px desktop / 12 px phone (`PublicProfile.jsx:142`). The avatar's left edge is therefore flush with `<main>`'s content edge.
   - Avatar button: 176 px desktop / 120 px phone, `box-shadow: 0 0 0 4px var(--surface-card)`, radius `--radius-md` when square else `--radius-full`, `aria-expanded`, same „Otwórz / Zamknij panel: {name}” name, toggles the panel, inert while editing (`PublicProfile.jsx:144,156-161`). `Avatar` gets `alt=""` (`PublicProfile.jsx:159`).
   - Name: `<p>`, `--type-h1` desktop / `--type-h2` phone, `--ls-heading`, `--text-strong`, padding-bottom 10 / 6 px, `overflow-wrap: anywhere`, `text-wrap: balance`; when the panel is open: `opacity: 0; transform: translateX(-12px)`, `aria-hidden`, transition `--dur-3` (`PublicProfile.jsx:178`). It sits on the page ground below the band (aligned to the avatar's bottom edge).

4. **Owner-in-edit overlays** (only `owner && editing`):
   - „Zmień tło”: `Button variant="onPhoto"` with `image` 16 px, `position: absolute; right: padX; bottom: --sp-4 (12 px); z-index: 3` inside the band (`PublicProfile.jsx:180`).
   - „+ Realizacja”: `Button variant="quiet"` with `plus` 16 px and the text „Realizacja”, `position: absolute; top: gap (24 px desktop / 16 px phone); right: <avatarLeft expression>; z-index: 3` in the content wrapper just under the band — i.e. top-right of the works column, level with the avatar's lower half; it opens the new-work page in edit mode (`PublicProfile.jsx:153,184`; kit routing `index.html:47-49`).

5. **Content wrapper**: `position: relative; z-index: 1; background: var(--surface-page)` (`PublicProfile.jsx:182`) holding `<main>` and the footer.

6. **`<main>`**: `max-width: var(--measure-works)`, centred; padding `{avatar/2 + gap}px padX bottom` = `112px 24px 96px` desktop, `76px 12px 64px` phone (bottom `--sp-16` / `--sp-12`); flex column, gap `--sp-14` 80 px desktop / `--sp-10` 48 px phone (`PublicProfile.jsx:185`). One `WorkCard` per work in `position` order with `href = /{handle}/{slug}`, the work's own `layout`, `phone`, `owner` (`PublicProfile.jsx:193-195`). No „Realizacje” heading, no count. Card-level geometry (aspect ratios 21:9 / 16:10 / 4:3, grid gaps, caption gap `--sp-7` 24 px desktop / `--sp-5` 16 px phone, pencil 40 px at `--sp-4` from the top-right of the picture group) is section 2 (`WorkCard.jsx:51,59-83,105`).

7. **Owner empty state** (`works.length === 0 && owner`, view and edit alike): `padding: --sp-14 --sp-7` (80 px 24 px), `text-align: center`, `border: 1px dashed var(--border-strong)`, `--radius-card`, column centred, gap `--sp-3` 8 px; `folder-open` 28 px subtle; title „Jeszcze bez realizacji” in `--type-h3` `--text-strong`; body „Wejdź w „Edytuj” i dodaj pierwszą plusem pod zdjęciem w tle. Nazwa i jedno zdjęcie wystarczą na start.” (en "Open “Edit” and add the first one with the plus under the cover. A name and one photo are enough to start.") in `--type-sm` `--text-muted`, `max-width: 26rem` (`PublicProfile.jsx:10-11,186-192`). Visitors with 0 works: nothing inside `<main>`.

8. **Footer**: `Footer` with note „Warszawa · architektow3d.pl”, links „Regulamin”, „Prywatność”, „Kontakt”, `locale` and `onLocaleChange` (`PublicProfile.jsx:197`); the component's own box is `max-width: var(--measure-wide)`, padding `--sp-9 --sp-7`, and it renders a `LocaleSwitcher` when `onLocaleChange` is passed (`design/components/navigation/Footer.jsx:18-20,42`).

9. **About panel** — what the page passes (`PublicProfile.jsx:199`): `top = bar height` (64 / 56), `start = 0` (`PublicProfile.jsx:154`), `width = 380` (`:143`), `headroom = calc(coverH + avatar/2 + gap)` = `calc(coverH + 112px)` desktop / `calc(coverH + 76px)` phone (`:155`), `avatarTop = calc(coverH − avatar/2)` (`:152`), `avatarSize` 176 / 120. Resulting box: `position: fixed; top: 0; bottom: 0; left: 0; z-index: 45`; width 380 px desktop / `min(100% - 88px, 320px)` phone; padding `headroom` on top, sides `--sp-8` 32 px / `--sp-6` 20 px, bottom `--sp-10` 48 px / `--sp-9` 40 px; `--surface-card`, 1 px hairline right border, `--shadow-lift` when open; `transform: translateX(0 | -102%)`, transition `--dur-3`; `overflow-y: auto`; content gap `--sp-8` 32 px / `--sp-6` 20 px; `aria-label` „O nas” (editing: „Edytuj profil”), `aria-hidden` when closed (`AboutPanel.jsx:128,144-172`). Phone scrim when open: `position: fixed; inset: 0; z-index: 44; background: var(--scrim-photo)`, press closes (not while editing) (`AboutPanel.jsx:148`). Panel avatar copy: `position: absolute; top: avatarTop; left: 50%; margin-left: -avatar/2`, 4 px card ring, `z-index: 1`; read-only it is a button „Zamknij panel” that closes the panel (`AboutPanel.jsx:175-183`). Edit-mode corner buttons: `top` 12 px desktop (`(64 − 40) / 2`) / 64 px phone (`56 + 8`), `right` `--sp-5` 16 px desktop / `--sp-4` 12 px phone, gap `--sp-2`, size 40 / 32 px, icons 20 / 16 (`AboutPanel.jsx:133-134,198-208`). Panel content (name `h1`, headline, „Adres profilu” with copy button, places, „O nas”, sticky Plaque foot at scale 0.5) is section 2 (`AboutPanel.jsx:210-249`).

10. **Stacking, bottom to top**: content wrapper `z 1` (`PublicProfile.jsx:182`) → band `z 2` with avatar/name/„Zmień tło” at `z 3` inside it, and „+ Realizacja” `z 3` inside the content wrapper (`:165,175,180,184`) → toolbar `z 44` (`ProfileBar.jsx:31`) → phone scrim `z 44`, later in the DOM so it paints over the toolbar (`AboutPanel.jsx:148`) → panel `z 45` (`AboutPanel.jsx:157`) → logo `z 48` (`ProfileBar.jsx:54`). Consequences: the open panel covers the page avatar (it carries its own copy); on a phone with the panel open the toolbar (account menu, pencil, hamburger) is under the scrim; the logo stays above the panel at every width.

11. **Scroll behaviour**: the bar and the panel are fixed; the band, page avatar and name scroll with the document and pass under the bar; the bar turns solid as soon as the band's bottom edge is under it; the panel scrolls internally, its avatar copy scrolls with the panel's content, and its Plaque foot is `position: sticky` at the bottom (`AboutPanel.jsx:166,176,247`). The page avatar and the panel copy coincide vertically only while neither has scrolled; horizontally they differ (page avatar left-aligned to the column, copy centred in the panel) and nothing animates between them.

12. **Derived values** (assumption: the `vh` unit refers to the browser window; stated windows 1440 × 900 and 390 × 844):

| value | desktop 1440 × 900 | phone 390 × 844 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| band height | 19vh = 171 px (inside 168–240) | 17vh = 143.5 px (inside 128–150) |
| page avatar top edge from the viewport top | 171 − 88 = 83 px (bar 64) | 143.5 − 60 = 83.5 px (bar 56) |
| page avatar left edge | `max(24, (1440 − 1600)/2 + 24)` = 24 px | `max(12, …)` = 12 px |
| name left edge | 24 + 176 + 20 = 220 px | 12 + 120 + 12 = 144 px |
| first card top | 171 + 112 = 283 px | 143.5 + 76 = 219.5 px |
| panel width | 380 px | `min(390 − 88, 320)` = 302 px |
| panel avatar copy centre x | 190 px | 151 px |

Note: `capture.mjs` renders the stages in a 1600 × 1000 window (`design/docs/handoff/shots/capture.mjs.txt:37`), so in the reference PNGs the band is 190 px (desktop) and 150 px (phone), not the values above (see Q-J01).

##### Behaviour per viewer

- **Panel on load**: open on desktop, closed on a phone (`PublicProfile.jsx:110`: `aboutDefault ?? !phone`); the interactive kit forces closed on a phone and lets the Tweaks panel set the desktop default (`index.html:30,54,76`); the shot stage passes `about` as given, so phone-open shots exist (`shots.html:33`). No storage of the user's choice in the reference.
- **Toggles**: logo button, page avatar, band (all three toggle); panel avatar copy closes; on a phone the scrim closes too (`ProfileBar.jsx:52`, `PublicProfile.jsx:158,166`, `AboutPanel.jsx:148,180`). The reference has no Escape handler, no focus move and no `inert` for the panel.
- **`signed-out`**: bar as above; cards link to `/{handle}/{slug}`; the orbit turns in place, its bottom-right `arrow-up-right` button opens the work's page (`WorkCard.jsx:54-58`, `design/components/profile/OrbitTile.jsx:112-135`). No lightbox on the profile. No link to `/` anywhere on the page (the logo is a panel toggle).
- **`other` / `no-handle`**: as `signed-out`, right slot with AccountMenu; the kit's AccountMenu for `other` is fed a placeholder person (`PublicProfile.jsx:133`), so the product must supply the signed-in viewer's own avatar, name, handle and shape. The kit does not model `no-handle`; where its „Profil” item goes is not specified.
- **`owner`, view**: pencil + AccountMenu (+ chip on desktop); pencil on every card at every width (no edit mode needed) → the work's page in edit mode (`PublicProfile.jsx:194`, `index.html:54`).
- **`owner`, edit** (entered only by the bar pencil): `startEdit` copies the profile into a draft, opens the panel and sets editing (`PublicProfile.jsx:113`); the pencil turns disabled at 50 %; the logo, page avatar and band stop toggling; the phone scrim stops closing (`PublicProfile.jsx:138,158,164,166`; `AboutPanel.jsx:148`). „Zmień tło” and „+ Realizacja” appear (`PublicProfile.jsx:180,184`). ✓ saves the draft (display name, headline, bio, places, avatar shape — one patch) and leaves the panel open; × drops the draft and closes the panel (`PublicProfile.jsx:114-116`). The owner empty state stays visible in edit mode (`PublicProfile.jsx:186`). The reference contains no saved-status line, no error lines, no upload progress, no cover removal, no leave guard.

##### Data migrations this page needs

- **`profiles.avatar_shape` — does not exist.** Today's `profiles` columns: `user_id`, `display_name`, `handle`, `handle_changed_at`, `avatar_file_id` (`drizzle/0000_regular_harry_osborn.sql:35-42`), `headline`, `locations`, `bio`, `cover_file_id` (`drizzle/0010_profile_sections.sql:43-46`); schema `src/db/schema.ts:185-259`. No shape column and no shape enum (the only enums are `place_kind` and `file_kind`, `schema.ts:422-430,462-480`). The reference's value set is `"circle" | "square"`, default circle (`design/components/profile/AboutPanel.d.ts:17-18`, decision B5). The sources do not say whether it is a Postgres enum or `text` with a `CHECK`; both patterns exist in the schema (`pgEnum` at `schema.ts:422`; `text` + `CHECK` for `county_kind` at `schema.ts:443,451-454`). **No API accepts it**: `POST /api/profile` accepts only `{ displayName }` (`src/app/api/profile/route.ts:16`), `POST /api/profile/sections` only the sections schema — headline, places, bio (`src/app/api/profile/sections/route.ts:12,34`), `POST /api/profile/avatar` only `{ fileId }` (`src/app/api/profile/avatar/route.ts:16`). The reference's ✓ sends name, headline, bio, places and shape in one patch (`PublicProfile.jsx:116`), whereas today these are three endpoints. **No read carries it**: `PublicProfile` (`src/lib/public-profile.ts:14-30`), `OwnerProfile` (`owner-profile-view.tsx:50-58`), and the `AccountMenu` props (`owner-profile-view.tsx:604-608`). The visitor branch of the page reads nothing about the signed-in viewer (`page.tsx:192,209-228`), so the `other` viewer's account-menu avatar and shape have no source today.
- **Works columns read by the cards** — none exist (`schema.ts:268-308`; `PublicWork` `public-profile.ts:32-45`): `works.slug` (card and title links `/{handle}/{slug}`, `PublicProfile.jsx:194`), `works.card_layout` (`layout={w.layout}`, `PublicProfile.jsx:194`), `works.r360_autorotate` (`WorkCard.jsx:55`), `works.description` (caption, `WorkCard.jsx:96-98`). `work_images.position` 0–2 (`schema.ts:390-394`) limits a work to three photos: without an orbit that is a cover plus at most two thumbnails; with an orbit as the cover (SPEC A12 allows 0–3 photos then, `SPEC.md:63`) up to three photos remain, and the kit card shows only the first two thumbnails (`WorkCard.jsx:48,54-55`).

- Still open in the reference: `F-PROFILE-6` second half (the empty state telling the owner to enter „Edytuj” is shown while editing — `PublicProfile.jsx:186`); `F-SHELL-8` (the bar is a `<header>` but the logo is outside it and there is no skip link — `ProfileBar.jsx:24-65`); `F-SHELL-13` (popovers move no focus, no arrow keys — `PublicProfile.jsx:31-60`); `F-SHELL-11` / `F-PROFILE-25` (sign-out during identity editing — AccountMenu stays usable on desktop while editing, `PublicProfile.jsx:139`); `F-SHELL-14` / `F-PROFILE-4` (plaque footer and bar brand are literals — `Plaque.jsx:16`, `ProfileBar.jsx:18`); `F-WORKS-13` (card pencil name built by concatenation „Edytuj: ” + name — `WorkCard.jsx:74`); `F-PROFILE-7`, `-9`, `-10`, `-11` (errors, progress, cover removal: no counterpart drawn); `F-PROFILE-13` (the framed headline is `aria-multiline="true"` and accepts line breaks — `AboutPanel.jsx:56,217`); `F-PROFILE-14` (the place adder has no limit state — `AboutPanel.jsx:76-123`); `F-PROFILE-12` (while editing the `h1` carries `role="textbox"`, so the page still has no heading level 1 — `AboutPanel.jsx:56,212`); `F-PROFILE-8`, `-15`, `-16`, `-17`, `-18`, `-24`, `-26`, `-27` depend on the unresolved save model and leave-guard questions below.

##### Open points

1. Identity save model — draft with ✓ / × (decisions C5, C6) versus save-on-blur (prompt-195 §4.4, `D-PROFILE-8`, SPEC A12). See Q-E01.
2. With the panel closed (the phone default) the page's only `h1` is inside an `aria-hidden` panel and the visible name beside the avatar is a `<p>` (`AboutPanel.jsx:151,214`, `PublicProfile.jsx:178`); prompt-195 §4.3 also asks for `inert` when closed (`claude-code-prompt-195.md:113`). No source says what heading a screen reader finds then.
3. Panel focus handling (Escape, focus on open, focus return, trap on a phone) is in prompt-195 §4.3 (`claude-code-prompt-195.md:114`) but not in the reference, and decision C2 removed the phone close button the prompt's focus target was.
4. Three controls share one accessible name „Otwórz panel: {name}” (logo, page avatar, band) (`ProfileBar.jsx:51`, `PublicProfile.jsx:158,166`), all hard-coded Polish, no dictionary key.
5. `no-handle` viewer: the AccountMenu's „Profil” destination is not drawn (today on settings it goes `/` → 307 `/onboarding`, `docs/ui-specification.md:197`).
6. The new-work address: prompt-195 says `/{handle}/new?edit=1` "or equivalent" (`claude-code-prompt-195.md:104`); the kit's empty work has slug „nowa-realizacja” (`index.html:47`).
7. „+ Realizacja” at the 10-works limit (`PROFILE-EDIT.works.limit-note`): no disabled or explained state in the reference.
8. Cover removal, upload progress, cover/avatar/name errors, saved notice and the leave guard have no position in the reference.
9. Reference PNGs were captured in a 1600 × 1000 window, so every `vh`-based band height in them is taller than in a 1440 × 900 / 390 × 844 browser.

**Contradictions touching this part (section 6):** Q-E01 — Identity edits: saved on leaving a field, or held until ✓; Q-E04 — Panel open on load from 64rem, phone line at 40rem; Q-D08 — Phone side gutter and profile main top padding; Q-E07 — Owner's works count under the profile address; Q-F10 — Reordering works on the profile: grip, a mode, or none; Q-E05 — Place reorder grip: kept by decision, absent from reference chip; Q-F11 — „+ Realizacja” visible text versus the reused Works.add key; Q-F02 — Owner pencil on desktop cover-thumbs: cover corner or thumbnail corner; Q-F09 — Empty-state copy names „Edytuj” and shows during editing; Q-D01 — Monogram colours: white on --n-900 versus the stone palette; Q-C05 — A second language switcher in the profile footer; Q-J01 — Reference shots render in 1600×1000, not the stage size
