#### Reference shots of the work page — what is shot and what rests on the JSX alone

**What exists.** Nine shots, all from the public kit (`design/docs/handoff/shots/matrix.json:26-34`):

| shot id | viewer | width | work | state |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `realizacja_read-only_desktop` | `other` | desktop | w1 | read-only (`matrix.json:26`) |
| `realizacja_read-only_phone` | `other` | phone | w1 | read-only (`matrix.json:27`) |
| `realizacja_read-only_desktop_panel-otwarty` | `other` | desktop | w1 | about panel opened by clicking the logo (`matrix.json:28`) |
| `realizacja_edycja_desktop` | `owner` | desktop | w1 | edit mode (`matrix.json:29`) |
| `realizacja_edycja_phone` | `owner` | phone | w1 | edit mode (`matrix.json:30`) |
| `realizacja_nowa_desktop` | `owner` | desktop | new (empty, `layout: "cover"`, `design/ui_kits/public-web/shots.html:26`) | edit mode (`matrix.json:31`) |
| `realizacja_nowa_phone` | `owner` | phone | new | edit mode (`matrix.json:32`) |
| `realizacja_lightbox_r360_desktop` | `other` | desktop | w1 | lightbox at index 0, the orbit (`matrix.json:33`) |
| `realizacja_lightbox_zdjecie_phone` | `other` | phone | w1 | lightbox at index 1, a photo (`matrix.json:34`) |

w1 is the only existing work ever shot: orbit with `autorotate: true` and cues, 6 photos, investor set, developer empty, a description, `layout: "cover-thumbs"` (`design/ui_kits/public-web/data.js:17`). In the lightbox shots the stage renders `window.Lightbox` itself over the page (`design/ui_kits/public-web/shots.html:34`); the opening from a picture click is not shot.

**Each shot is one viewport, not the whole page.** The stage is 1440 × 900 px (desktop) or 390 × 844 px (phone), the page scrolls inside it (`design/ui_kits/public-web/shots.html:4-7`), the capture photographs only the `.stage` element (`design/docs/handoff/shots/capture.mjs.txt:56`), and no work-page shot has a scroll action (`matrix.json:26-34`). Arithmetic from the cited kit values for desktop: content width 1440 − 2 × 24 = 1392 px, so a 16:9 picture is about 783 px tall; the first picture starts at least 104 px (top padding) + 48 + 48 px (two `<main>` gaps) = 200 px down, before adding the back link and the header (`design/ui_kits/public-web/WorkPage.jsx:180`), so it ends below 983 px — past the 900 px frame. Therefore on desktop the cue row under the orbit, every photo after it and the footer are in no read-only shot, and in `realizacja_edycja_desktop` (the same 16:9 orbit tile in the „Widok 360° (R360)” section, `WorkPage.jsx:225`) the whole „Zdjęcia” section — filmstrip, full-size tiles, pills — is in no shot. How much of the phone pages and of the new-work desktop page fits in the frame was not measured.

**States with no reference shot — they rely on reading the JSX only:**

- *Read-only viewers:* `signed-out` at any width (no work-page shot uses `viewer: "visitor"`, `matrix.json:26-34`); `no-handle` (the kit has no such viewer: `WorkPage` only tests `viewer === "owner"`, `WorkPage.jsx:132`); `owner` read-only on desktop and phone (pencil + account control, `WorkPage.jsx:165-166`).
- *About panel:* open on a phone (scrim, 320 px width rule); open while the work is in edit mode.
- *Work data:* a work without an orbit (w2, w3, w4, `data.js:18-20`) at any width, read-only or edit; a work without investor and developer (no `dl`); a work without a description; a work with a single picture (lightbox without prev / next).
- *Below the first viewport on desktop* (see the arithmetic above): cue row, photo column, footer; the edit mode's „Zdjęcia” section.
- *Edit mode:* existing work without an R360 set (compact 120 px drop tile on a work that has photos); 1–2 photos („Okładka + 2 miniatury” disabled with its `title`, and the fallback hint for w4's stored `cover-thumbs`, `data.js:20`); 0 photos with an R360 set (260 px tile with ✓ enabled); empty description („Okładka + opis” disabled); autorotate switch off; drag in progress (thumb at 40 %, 2 px drop outline), keyboard move, disabled phone arrows at the ends; ✓ disabled with a name but no picture; delete (the kit has no confirmation to shoot).
- *Routes:* `?edit=1` opened by a non-owner; `/{handle}/new` opened by a non-owner; `/{handle}/{unknown-slug}` (the `404_desktop` / `404_phone` shots render the kit's 404 page on its own, `matrix.json:37-38`, not reached through this route); case-variant and old-handle redirects (nothing visual).
- *Lightbox:* the orbit on a phone; a photo on desktop; a two-channel photo, inline or in the lightbox (the kit has no reveal at all, see the photo row in the layout below).
- *Language:* English — no work-page shot sets `locale`, and the stage defaults to `"pl"` (`design/ui_kits/public-web/shots.html:37`).

#### /{handle}/{slug} — read-only

**Route and data (from prompt-195, not in the kit).** `force-dynamic`; one lookup shared with `generateMetadata`: profile by handle (same pipeline as V-PROFILE) → work by slug → 404 otherwise; `isOwnerViewing` decides `owner`; title `{work.name} · {displayName} · Architektów 3d`; description = the work's description, else `PublicProfile.description`; canonical + hreflang; `og:type article`; `og:image` = the cover's 1600 variant (`design/docs/claude-code-prompt-195.md:137`). Today's building blocks for this: `isOwnerViewing` (`src/app/[locale]/(public)/[handle]/page.tsx:49-58`), `export const dynamic = "force-dynamic"` (`src/app/[locale]/(public)/[handle]/page.tsx:68`), the cached lookup (`src/app/[locale]/(public)/[handle]/page.tsx:79-98`), `loadPublicProfile`, which already loads every work of the profile (`src/lib/public-profile.ts:72-126`, `listWorks` at `src/lib/public-profile.ts:81`), and `profileMetadata`, which today emits `og:type profile` and the title `{displayName} · {brand}` (`src/lib/public-profile.ts:175,195`). `listWorks` selects no slug, layout, description or autorotate today (`src/lib/works.ts:104-116`) and `WorkView` has no such fields (`src/lib/works.ts:78-92`).

**Layout, top to bottom (reference).**

1. **Page ground** `--surface-page`, `min-height: 100%` (`design/ui_kits/public-web/WorkPage.jsx:177`).
2. **Bar — `ProfileBar` with `solid`** (`design/ui_kits/public-web/WorkPage.jsx:178`):
   - `<header>` `position: fixed; top: 0; left: 0; right: 0; z-index: 44`, height **64 px desktop / 56 px phone**, flex, gap 12 px, side padding **24 px desktop / 12 px phone**, background `--surface-card`, bottom border 1 px `--border-hairline`, `pointer-events: none`; transition of background, border and colour over `--dur-2` (`design/components/profile/ProfileBar.jsx:25-43`). The right group is `margin-left: auto`, gap **12 px desktop / 8 px phone**, `pointer-events: auto` (`design/components/profile/ProfileBar.jsx:46`).
   - **Logo — a separate fixed button**, `z-index: 48`, `top: (bar - 44) / 2` = 10 px desktop / 6 px phone, `left` 24 / 12 px, height 44 px, gap 8 px, padding-right 8 px, `aria-expanded`, `aria-label` „Otwórz panel: {name}” / „Zamknij panel: {name}” (hard-coded Polish in the kit) (`design/components/profile/ProfileBar.jsx:48-55`). Contents: the A3D mark 32 × 32 px, `--radius-xs`, `--plaque-navy`, red band 12 % of its height (`design/components/profile/ProfileBar.jsx:56-58`); a label in `--type-h3` that crossfades — panel closed: the studio's display name (ellipsis, `max-width` 44vw phone / 24rem desktop); panel open: „Architektów 3d”; opacity + 6 px vertical slide over `--dur-3`, `aria-live="polite"` (`design/components/profile/ProfileBar.jsx:59-62`); a `chevron-right` 18 px rotating 180° when the panel is open, `--dur-3` (`design/components/profile/ProfileBar.jsx:63`; decision A2). On the work page the bar is always solid, so the group is always ink (`design/components/profile/ProfileBar.jsx:21`).
   - **Right slot by viewer.** Reference: only `owner` gets controls — pencil 40 × 40 px, round, `rgba(255,255,255,.94)`, `--shadow-md`, `pencil` 16 px, `aria-label` and `title` „Edytuj”, click enters edit mode in place (`design/ui_kits/public-web/WorkPage.jsx:165`); then a 40 × 40 button `aria-label` „Menu konta” containing a **32 px** `Avatar` (square when `avatarShape === "square"`), no ring, no popover (`design/ui_kits/public-web/WorkPage.jsx:166`). Every other viewer: `actions = null` (`design/ui_kits/public-web/WorkPage.jsx:155,169`). The decisions (A5, A6) and prompt-195 §5.2 item 1 say otherwise — see Q-C02.
3. **About panel** (see the subsection below) rendered after the bar (`design/ui_kits/public-web/WorkPage.jsx:179`).
4. **`<main>`**: `max-width: var(--measure-works)` (1600 px), centred; padding **`104px 24px 96px` desktop**, **`80px 12px 64px` phone** (top = bar + 40 / bar + 24); flex column, gap **48 px desktop / 32 px phone** (`design/ui_kits/public-web/WorkPage.jsx:154,180`). Prompt-195 gives gap 40 / 24 (Q-G01).
5. **Back link** „Wszystkie realizacje” · "All works": `inline-flex`, gap 4 px, `--type-label`, `--text-muted`, no underline, `align-self: flex-start`, `arrow-left` 16 px muted, goes to `/{handle}` (`design/ui_kits/public-web/WorkPage.jsx:10,19,181-183`; new key `Works.page.back`, `design/docs/claude-code-prompt-195.md:143`).
6. **Header** (`design/ui_kits/public-web/WorkPage.jsx:208-218`): grid `minmax(0,1.4fr) minmax(0,1fr)` desktop / `1fr` phone; gap **64 px desktop / 16 px phone** (prompt-195: 64 / 20); `align-items: start`; `max-width: 80rem`.
   - `h1`: `--type-display` desktop / `--type-h1` phone, `letter-spacing: var(--ls-display)` at both widths, `--text-strong`, `text-wrap: balance`; text = the work's name, or „Bez nazwy” · "Untitled" when empty (`design/ui_kits/public-web/WorkPage.jsx:10,209`).
   - Right column: flex column, gap 12 px (`design/ui_kits/public-web/WorkPage.jsx:210`). A `dl` only when investor or developer is set: flex wrap, gap 4 px row / 24 px column, `--type-sm`; each pair flex gap 4 px; `dt` `--text-subtle` („Inwestor”, „Deweloper”), `dd` `--fw-semibold` `--text-body` (`design/ui_kits/public-web/WorkPage.jsx:170,211-215`). Then the description `p` in `--type-lead` `--text-muted` when set (`design/ui_kits/public-web/WorkPage.jsx:216`) — no `white-space: pre-line`.
7. **Pictures** (`design/ui_kits/public-web/WorkPage.jsx:259-269`): flex column, gap **20 px desktop / 12 px phone** (prompt-195: 24 / 16). Order: the orbit first when the work has one, then photos in list order (`design/ui_kits/public-web/WorkPage.jsx:144`) — the same list today's `picturesOf` builds (`src/app/[locale]/(public)/[handle]/works-gallery.tsx:76-85`). Every picture of the work is shown (today the card shows at most 3, `src/app/[locale]/(public)/[handle]/works-gallery.tsx:305`).
   - Photo: `<figure>` `position: relative`, `border-radius: var(--radius-picture)` (8 px), `overflow: hidden`, background `--n-150`, `aspect-ratio` **16 / 9 desktop, 4 / 3 phone** (`design/ui_kits/public-web/WorkPage.jsx:174,264`); `<img>` absolute `inset: 0`, `object-fit: cover`, `cursor: zoom-in`, click opens the lightbox at this index; alt „{name}, zdjęcie {n}” counted among photos (`design/ui_kits/public-web/WorkPage.jsx:265`; existing key `Works.photoAlt`, `messages/pl.json:468`). The kit's `<img>` carries the click itself (no `<button>`). Prompt-195 adds `loading="lazy"` from the second picture, `srcSet` 480w/1600w, `sizes="(max-width: 100rem) 100vw, 1600px"`, and two-channel photos as an inline `ChannelReveal` that shows nothing until both channels load (#159) (`design/docs/claude-code-prompt-195.md:145`); the kit has none of these.
   - Orbit: `OrbitTile` with `ring={!phone}`, `aspect` 16/9 · 4/3, `autorotate` = the work's setting, cues, `onEnlarge` (`design/ui_kits/public-web/WorkPage.jsx:262`). Tile: `role="slider"`, `aspect-ratio` as passed, radius 8 px, background `--n-900`, `cursor: grab`, `touch-action: pan-y` (`design/components/profile/OrbitTile.jsx:61-86`); „360°” pill top 12 px / left 12 px, padding 4 px 10 px, `rgba(12,17,22,.72)`, white `--type-eyebrow` uppercase `--ls-caps`, `aria-hidden` (`design/components/profile/OrbitTile.jsx:95-111`); corner button 40 × 40 px round at right 12 px / bottom 12 px, `rgba(255,255,255,.94)`, icon `maximize-2` 18 px, `aria-label` „Powiększ widok 360°: {name}” (`design/components/profile/OrbitTile.jsx:112-136`); ring (desktop only) centred at bottom 16 px, width `min(38%, 10rem)`, `aspect-ratio: 3 / 1`, 2 px `rgba(255,255,255,.55)` ellipse, 10 px white dot (`design/components/profile/OrbitTile.jsx:137-142`); cue row under the tile, wrapper gap 12 px, list gap 8 px, pills 32 px tall, padding 0 12 px, `--radius-full`, active = `--n-950` fill (`design/components/profile/OrbitTile.jsx:60,144-169`). Autorotate advances the pan by `dt × 0.004` of 100 per ms — one full cycle in 25 s — paused while dragged, off under `prefers-reduced-motion` (`design/components/profile/OrbitTile.jsx:28-42`). The product equivalent is `OrbitViewer` + `OrbitRing` + `OrbitCueButtons` at 1600 px (`design/docs/claude-code-prompt-195.md:146`); today `OrbitViewer` + `OrbitRing` live in `PublicOrbit` with the ring hidden on `phone:` (`src/app/[locale]/(public)/[handle]/works-gallery.tsx:694-772`, `phone:hidden` at `:742-743`), while `OrbitCueButtons` is rendered beside it by the card (`src/app/[locale]/(public)/[handle]/works-gallery.tsx:399`) and by the lightbox's `OrbitFull` (`src/app/[locale]/(public)/[handle]/works-gallery.tsx:928`).
8. **Footer**: `Footer` with note „Warszawa · architektow3d.pl” and links „Regulamin”, „Prywatność”, „Kontakt”, no `onLocaleChange` (`design/ui_kits/public-web/WorkPage.jsx:273`); the `<footer>` has a top hairline and `--surface-card` (`design/components/navigation/Footer.jsx:15`); its inner box is `max-width: var(--measure-wide)` (78rem, `design/tokens/spacing.css:10`), padding 40 px 24 px (`design/components/navigation/Footer.jsx:16-20`).

**Stacking and scroll.** Page scrolls normally; bar `z 44`, phone scrim `z 44` (rendered after the bar), panel `z 45`, logo `z 48` (`design/components/profile/ProfileBar.jsx:31,54`; `design/components/profile/AboutPanel.jsx:148,157`); kit lightbox `z 100` (`design/ui_kits/public-web/WorkPage.jsx:290`) — today's lightbox is `z-50` (`src/app/[locale]/(public)/[handle]/works-gallery.tsx:619`). Nothing in `<main>` is sticky.

**Behaviour per viewer.**

- `signed-out`, `other`, `no-handle`: read the page, turn the orbit, open the lightbox, open the about panel from the logo; `?edit=1` ignored (`design/docs/claude-code-prompt-195.md:45`).
- `owner`: the same, plus the pencil (A8) → edit mode. In the kit the pencil flips local state (`design/ui_kits/public-web/WorkPage.jsx:165`); prompt-195 names the URL form `?edit=1` (`design/docs/claude-code-prompt-195.md:45,149`). Today's card owner row (grip, R360 badge, „Edytuj”, „Usuń”) does not appear on this page.
- **Lightbox (kit)**: `role="dialog"`, `aria-modal`, `aria-label` = work name, fixed `inset: 0`, `z 100`, background `rgba(12,17,22,.96)`, grid `auto 1fr`; top row padding 12 px 20 px with name (`--type-label`), mono counter „{i} / {n}” and a 44 px close „Zamknij”; stage padding `0 96px 32px`; 44 px round prev/next „Poprzednie” / „Następne” at 20 px from the edges, only with more than one picture; Escape / ← / → with wrap; the orbit inside is `OrbitTile` with `ring` always on, 16/9, `width: min(100%, 1400px)` (`design/ui_kits/public-web/WorkPage.jsx:278-307`). Today's lightbox keeps history (#84), focus trap, reveal and orbit hands (`docs/ui-specification.md:4082-4106`); prompt-195 keeps `V-LIGHTBOX.*` with the ring on desktop only (`design/docs/claude-code-prompt-195.md:175`).

#### About panel on the work page (A7)

**Wiring** (`design/ui_kits/public-web/WorkPage.jsx:137-141,179`): `open` = local state, **closed on load at every width** (`design/ui_kits/public-web/WorkPage.jsx:138`); `onToggleAbout` from the logo; `onClose`; `onAvatar = onBack` (the panel's avatar goes to `/{handle}`); `owner` passed (kept "for API compatibility", `design/components/profile/AboutPanel.d.ts:31`); `top = start = bar` (64 / 56); `width` 380; `avatarTop` 32 px desktop / 24 px phone; `avatarSize` **120 px desktop / 96 px phone**; `headroom` = avatarTop + avatarSize + 24 / 16 = **176 px desktop / 136 px phone**. No `editing` — the panel is read-only here, also while the work is in edit mode (A7, `design/docs/handoff/00-decyzje-2026-09-14.md:15`); the logo is not disabled in edit mode (no `toggleDisabled`, `design/ui_kits/public-web/WorkPage.jsx:178`).

**Box** (`design/components/profile/AboutPanel.jsx:125-173`): `<aside aria-label="O nas">`, `aria-hidden` when closed (no `inert` in the kit; prompt-195 asks for `inert`, `design/docs/claude-code-prompt-195.md:113`); `position: fixed; top: 64 | 56; bottom: 0; left: 0; z-index: 45`; width **380 px desktop**, **`min(100% - 88px, 320px)` phone** (`design/components/profile/AboutPanel.jsx:128`); padding top = headroom, sides **32 px desktop / 20 px phone**, bottom **48 px desktop / 40 px phone** (`design/components/profile/AboutPanel.jsx:144-145,160`); `--surface-card`, right hairline, `--shadow-lift` when open; `transform: translateX(0 | -102%)` over `--dur-3`; `overflow-y: auto`; flex column, gap **32 px desktop / 20 px phone** (`design/components/profile/AboutPanel.jsx:161-170`). Phone only, when open: scrim `position: fixed; inset: 0; z-index: 44; background: var(--scrim-photo)`, click closes (`design/components/profile/AboutPanel.jsx:148`). No × and no corner buttons in read-only (C2; `design/components/profile/AboutPanel.jsx:198`).

**Content, top to bottom.**
1. Avatar copy: absolute, `top` 32 / 24 px, centred on the panel's width, ring `0 0 0 4px var(--surface-card)`, `z 1`; a button with `aria-label` / `title` „Przejdź do profilu: {name}” that calls `onAvatar` (`design/components/profile/AboutPanel.jsx:175-183`, label text `:137`). Square avatars: `--radius-md` at ≥ 96 px (`design/components/core/Avatar.jsx:15`; decision B5).
2. Name `h1` in `--type-h1` desktop / `--type-h2` phone, `--ls-heading`, centred; headline `p` in `--type-lead` / `--type-body`, muted (`design/components/profile/AboutPanel.jsx:130-131,210-219`; C3).
3. Section „Adres profilu”: mono `architektow3d.pl/{handle}` + 32 px round copy button (`design/components/profile/AboutPanel.jsx:220-227`).
4. Section „Siedziba i obszar działania” with 32 px chips when the profile has places (`design/components/profile/AboutPanel.jsx:228-235`).
5. Section „O nas” with the bio, `white-space: pre-line`, `--type-body` / `--type-sm` (`design/components/profile/AboutPanel.jsx:236-244`).
6. Plaque as a sticky footer: `position: sticky; bottom: -padding-bottom; flex-shrink: 0`, white, top hairline, negative side margins, padding 16 px 32 px 24 px desktop / 12 px 20 px 20 px phone, `Plaque scale={0.5}` without shadow, horizontal scroll when wider (`design/components/profile/AboutPanel.jsx:247-249`; C4).

No `Works.count` and no language chip in this panel (A6: "Język zniknął z panelu", `design/docs/handoff/00-decyzje-2026-09-14.md:14`). Reference shot: `realizacja_read-only_desktop_panel-otwarty` (`design/docs/handoff/shots/matrix.json:28`).

**Data needed on the work page for the panel**: display name, handle, avatar URL, `avatarShape`, headline, places, bio — i.e. the whole `PublicProfile` identity (`src/lib/public-profile.ts:14-30`) plus `profiles.avatar_shape`.

**Open points.** Focus handling on open/close (prompt-195 §4.3 defines it for the profile, `design/docs/claude-code-prompt-195.md:114`) is not restated for the work page; on a phone the avatar copy navigates away, so only the logo and the scrim close the panel (`design/components/profile/AboutPanel.jsx:148,180`).

#### /{handle}/{slug}?edit=1 — edit mode (owner, existing work)

Decision E keeps prompt-195 §5.3 items 1–4 (`design/docs/handoff/00-decyzje-2026-09-14.md:50`); A9 replaces the bar's text buttons (`design/docs/handoff/00-decyzje-2026-09-14.md:17`). The URL query form is `?edit=1` (`design/docs/claude-code-prompt-195.md:45`); the kit keeps edit mode in component state (`design/ui_kits/public-web/WorkPage.jsx:134`).

**Bar in edit mode** (`design/ui_kits/public-web/WorkPage.jsx:156-162`), left to right in the right slot (gap 12 px desktop / 8 px phone):
- **Trash** — existing works only: 40 × 40 px round, transparent, `trash-2` 18 px `danger` tone, `aria-label` / `title` „Usuń realizację”; calls `onDelete(work)` directly (`design/ui_kits/public-web/WorkPage.jsx:159`). In the kit the host deletes and returns to the profile with no confirmation (`design/ui_kits/public-web/index.html:51`); the key `deleteHint` „Razem ze zdjęciami i paczką R360. Nie da się cofnąć.” is defined but not rendered (`design/ui_kits/public-web/WorkPage.jsx:16`). Prompt-195: existing confirmation extended to name the R360 set, success → `/{handle}` (`design/docs/claude-code-prompt-195.md:153`).
- **×** — 40 × 40 px, transparent, `x` 20 px muted, „Anuluj”: a new work → back to the profile; an existing work → draft reset and edit mode left (`design/ui_kits/public-web/WorkPage.jsx:160`).
- **✓** — 40 × 40 px, `--action-solid` fill, `check` 20 px in `--action-solid-text`, „Zapisz”; `disabled` and opacity 0.4 (cursor default) unless the name is non-blank **and** there is ≥ 1 photo or an orbit (`design/ui_kits/public-web/WorkPage.jsx:153,161`); saves `{ ...draft, layout }` with the fallback layout and leaves edit mode.
- No pencil, no account control, no language chip in edit mode (`design/ui_kits/public-web/WorkPage.jsx:156-162`).

Prompt-195 for save/cancel: „Zapisz” posts name, parties, description, `card_layout`, `r360_autorotate`, picture order with `PATCH /api/works/{id}` (or `POST /api/works` then redirect to `/{handle}/{slug}`) extended by the three new fields; success → the same URL without `?edit=1` and a status line „Zapisano”; „Anuluj” discards unsaved fields, pictures already uploaded stay (A12) with a hint; the leave guard arms (`design/docs/claude-code-prompt-195.md:161`). The kit shows no status line, no hint and no guard.

#### /{handle}/{unknown-slug} — 404

Target: the localized 404 body (`design/docs/claude-code-prompt-195.md:49`). Today every two-segment address already renders it through the catch-all (`src/app/[locale]/[...rest]/page.tsx:14-16`); with `[handle]/[slug]` in place, a two-segment address is claimed by the new page instead, so the 404 must come from the page's own `notFound()` for: no profile, a redirect-less unknown handle, or no work with that slug under the profile. `e2e/not-found.spec.ts:14` (`/some-profile/works`) will then be answered by the new route, not the catch-all. The 404 body is `V-404` (`design/ui_kits/public-web/NotFound.jsx:7-24`), covered in its own section.

**Findings this resolves.** None of the open findings. The unmatched-address half of `F-SHELL-3` was already fixed on 13.09.2026 by the catch-all (`docs/ui-specification.md:175`), and prompt-195 counts `F-SHELL-3` "both halves" as resolved by the direction (`design/docs/claude-code-prompt-195.md:192`), the other half being the error screen (`design/docs/claude-code-prompt-195.md:185`). What this route must do is *keep* that half fixed for two-segment addresses, which it takes over from the catch-all ("The catch-all `[locale]/[...rest]` keeps catching everything deeper", `design/docs/claude-code-prompt-195.md:49`).

**Conditions the new page inherits from today's 404 behaviour** (stated in the spec for the profile page, not restated for the work page):
- The `<title>` of a 404 is `NotFound.title`, which the profile page's `generateMetadata` also sets for a non-profile result (`docs/ui-specification.md:696`); the work page's `generateMetadata` has the same case for an unknown slug.
- A missing `DATABASE_URL` reads as "no such profile" → 404, every other failure → 500 (`src/app/[locale]/(public)/[handle]/page.tsx:89-97`; `D-PROFILE-2`, `docs/ui-specification.md:2960`). `e2e/not-found.spec.ts` is a database-less smoke test (`e2e/not-found.spec.ts:3-6`), so once `/some-profile/works` reaches the new page's lookup instead of the catch-all, that test depends on the new page mapping a missing `DATABASE_URL` the same way.
- The request pipeline (`docs/ui-specification.md:136-150`, steps 8 and 9) describes one-segment profile addresses and "two or more segments that no route claims"; a two-segment work address is neither and has no step yet.

**Open points.**
- **`/{handle}/new` for a non-owner** (`signed-out`, `other`, `no-handle`) and **for a handle with no such profile**: not stated in any source. In the kit a non-owner gets `editing = false` (`design/ui_kits/public-web/WorkPage.jsx:134`), so the empty new work would render as a read-only page: h1 „Bez nazwy”, no `dl`, no description, no pictures, no bar controls (`design/ui_kits/public-web/WorkPage.jsx:155,169,209-216`; the empty work at `design/ui_kits/public-web/index.html:47`) — not a designed state. Whether the answer is the 404, a redirect to `/{handle}` or to sign-in is open.
- **A missing work under `?edit=1`**: prompt-195's "unknown slug → the localized 404" (`design/docs/claude-code-prompt-195.md:49`) does not distinguish the owner; whether an owner opening a deleted work's `?edit=1` link (for example after „Usuń realizację” in another tab) also gets the plain 404 is not stated.
- **Which route answers the other two-segment test address.** `e2e/not-found.spec.ts:34` requests `/en/settings/unknown`, and its comment relies on that address not reaching the `(app)` session gate (`e2e/not-found.spec.ts:31-33`). With `[handle]/[slug]` in place it may be claimed by the new page with `handle = settings` — `settings` is a reserved handle (`src/lib/handle.ts:56`), which the profile pipeline answers with 404 (`docs/ui-specification.md:143`) — or stay with the catch-all; routing precedence between the static `settings` folder and the dynamic pair was not checked (no server run, framework documentation not read for this point).
- **Old handle or case variant with a slug**: today's 308 targets are built by `handlePath(handle, locale)`, a one-segment path (`src/app/[locale]/(public)/[handle]/page.tsx:182,189`), and the proxy's 301 matches one segment only (`src/proxy.ts:81`); reusing either as they are would drop the slug. The answer for `/{old-handle}/{slug}` is already an open point under read-only.
- **A slug that exists under another profile**: uniqueness is per profile (`design/docs/claude-code-prompt-195.md:49`), so `/{handle-a}/{slug-of-b}` is an unknown slug for profile A → 404 by that rule, though no source spells this case out.

#### Data migrations

Current state verified: the last migration is `drizzle/0019_works_position.sql` (journal entry `idx 19`, tag `0019_works_position`, `drizzle/meta/_journal.json:139-142`). **The next migration number is `0020`.** None of `slug`, `card_layout`, `autorotate`, `description`, `avatar_shape` appears in `src/db/schema.ts` or any `drizzle/*.sql` (search returned no match). Observation: `drizzle/meta/` holds no `0007_snapshot.json` although `drizzle/0007_email_out_of_display_names.sql` exists.

How works are written today, for every column below: `POST /api/works` parses `workInputSchema` (`src/app/api/works/route.ts:18-32`) → `createWork` (`src/lib/works.ts:332-369`); `PATCH /api/works/{id}` parses the same full schema — a whole replacement, not a partial update (`src/app/api/works/[id]/route.ts:41-59`) → `updateWork` (`src/lib/works.ts:423-509`); columns are mapped in `workColumnsOf` (`src/lib/works.ts:273-281`); reads go through `listWorks` (`src/lib/works.ts:102-217`) and `loadPublicProfile` (`src/lib/public-profile.ts:105-123`). Database CHECKs are pinned to Zod constants by `src/db/schema.test.ts` (`src/db/schema.ts:232-234`).

**The rollout rule every one of these migrations falls under.**
- G6: schema changes only through migration files (`SPEC.md:292`); they are generated with `pnpm db:generate` (`package.json:23`), which also writes `drizzle/meta/0020_snapshot.json` and journal entry `idx 20`.
- A deployment pulls the new image, runs *that image's* migrator, and only then starts the new container (`deploy/remote-deploy.sh:152-164`; `SPEC.md:375-380`). So for the time between the migration and `docker compose up`, the **previous container keeps serving against the new schema**. A migration that fails ends the deployment with the old container and the old schema untouched (`SPEC.md:379-380`).
- Rolling back is redeploying an older image of the code; a migration that has run stays run. That is why G6's expand-then-contract shape is load-bearing: a migration that only adds is one an older image can still run against, while one that drops or renames removes the possibility of rolling back and is a one-way door on the day it ships (`SPEC.md:381-385`).
- A preview copies dev's database and runs the pull request's own migrator on the copy (`SPEC.md:402-411`; `deploy/preview-up.sh:173-186`); dev's schema changes only when `main` deploys. (The header comment of `drizzle/0018_r360_key_prefix.sql:2-5` still says previews never migrate; `SPEC.md:402-411`, #113, supersedes it.)
- The migrator waits at most five seconds for a lock (`deploy/migrate.mjs:56`; `SPEC.md:446-449`).
- **What that means for these five columns.** The image serving today knows none of them, and it must keep working during the deployment window and after a rollback. Its insert paths name only today's columns: `createWork` (`src/lib/works.ts:355-363`), and for profiles the two upserts `updateDisplayName` (`src/lib/profile.ts:185-196`) and `setHandle` (`src/lib/profile-handle.ts:250-266`). A new column that is nullable or has a default is invisible to those inserts. A column that is `NOT NULL` without a default makes every one of them fail on that image. Its updates (`updateWork`, `src/lib/works.ts:484-496`; `updateProfileSections`, `src/lib/profile.ts:205-222`) do not touch unknown columns, so they keep whatever is stored.
- **The canary test.** `src/db/schema.test.ts:365-405` fails on any `DROP INDEX`, `DROP CONSTRAINT`, `DROP DEFAULT`, `DROP TABLE` or `ALTER TYPE` that is not on its accepted list (regular expression at `src/db/schema.test.ts:398-401`). `ADD COLUMN`, `SET NOT NULL`, `CREATE TYPE`, `CREATE INDEX` and `ADD CONSTRAINT` are not matched. So a migration that adds a column with a default and later drops the default must extend that list; a later "contract" step that only sets `NOT NULL` passes unnoticed.
- **Precedents in this repository.** `0019` added `position integer DEFAULT 0 NOT NULL` and back-filled it in the same file (`drizzle/0019_works_position.sql:2-13`). `0018` added a nullable column, back-filled it from existing rows, then added a CHECK, and calls itself "expand-only" (`drizzle/0018_r360_key_prefix.sql:2,6-22`). A back-fill that needs application logic has been a one-off TypeScript script run once per environment, not by the deployment: `scripts/backfill-file-keys.ts:8-22`, `pnpm db:backfill-file-keys` (`package.json:26`; no reference to it in `deploy/`). No migration creates a Postgres extension (no `CREATE EXTENSION` in `drizzle/*.sql`).

**Full-replacement save and the three new work fields.** `PATCH /api/works/{id}` parses the whole `workInputSchema` and `updateWork` rewrites every column `workColumnsOf` returns (`src/app/api/works/[id]/route.ts:41-59`; `src/lib/works.ts:273-281,484-496`). Once `cardLayout`, `r360Autorotate` and `description` are in that schema, a request body without one of them — today's form, which builds its body at `src/app/[locale]/(public)/[handle]/work-form.tsx:1053`, or a browser tab opened before the deployment — is either refused (field required) or overwrites the stored value with the schema's default, the way an absent `investor` becomes `""` and then NULL (`src/lib/work-schemas.ts:34-35`; `src/lib/works.ts:276-277`). The other direction: an older image receiving a new body drops the unknown keys and saves the rest, because `workInputSchema` is a plain `z.object` (`src/lib/work-schemas.ts:24-25`), unlike `worksOrderSchema`, which is `.strict()` (`src/lib/work-schemas.ts:106`). Prompt-195 lists the four migrations under PR 5, the profile (`design/docs/claude-code-prompt-195.md:208`), and the work page with its edit mode under PR 6 (`design/docs/claude-code-prompt-195.md:209`).

**`works.slug`**
- *Exists:* nothing. `works` has `id`, `user_id`, `name`, `investor`, `developer`, `r360_set_id`, `r360_params`, `r360_key_prefix`, `position`, timestamps (`src/db/schema.ts:268-308`); created in `drizzle/0010_profile_sections.sql:26`.
- *Rules (prompt-195):* the work's name through `slugify` — lowercase, ASCII, hyphens, ≤ 60 characters; unique per profile; back-filled by migration; unchanged when the name changes (permalink) (`design/docs/claude-code-prompt-195.md:49`).
- *Missing:* the column; a uniqueness constraint per profile (the profile is `works.user_id`; the handle is never a key, `SPEC.md:473-475`); a lowercase / pattern CHECK in the style of `profiles_handle_lowercase` (`src/db/schema.ts:220`) if wanted; the back-fill for existing rows (the `0019` back-fill is a precedent, `drizzle/0019_works_position.sql:6-13`); a lookup by `(user_id, slug)`; `slug` in `WorkView` / `PublicWork`; slug generation in `createWork` (under the per-user advisory lock, `src/lib/works.ts:340-341`) and no change in `updateWork`.
- *API / validation:* not client-supplied in any source — generated server-side on `POST /api/works`; the create response must return it for the redirect (`design/docs/claude-code-prompt-195.md:161`).
- *Unstated:* the suffix scheme when two names slugify alike (in back-fill and on create); the slug of a name with no ASCII letters; how Polish letters are transliterated (the data uses `hnb-bialobrzegi`, `design/ui_kits/public-web/data.js:17`); whether the owner can edit a slug; reserved slugs (`new`). Product precedent for the handle, not for works: `handleBaseFrom` strips diacritics (`ł` → `l` among others), collapses the rest to single hyphens and cuts to the handle length (`src/lib/handle.ts:236-265`), and `suggestHandle` tries `base-2` … `base-9`, then a 4-hex tail (`src/lib/profile-handle.ts:83-126`); no source says the work slug reuses it.
- *Nullability and default:* not stated (`design/docs/claude-code-prompt-195.md:49` gives only the value rule, uniqueness and back-fill). A constant default cannot serve: under per-profile uniqueness the second work of a profile to receive it would collide.
- *Uniqueness scope:* per profile, i.e. a unique index on `(user_id, slug)` — the profile's key is `works.user_id` (`src/db/schema.ts:272-274`). Work names are not unique within a profile (no unique constraint on `name`, `src/db/schema.ts:309-346`), so two works can slugify alike both in the back-fill and on create. A Postgres unique index treats NULLs as distinct, which the schema already relies on for `handle` ("unique index ignores NULLs", `src/db/schema.ts:192`): a nullable `slug` under a `(user_id, slug)` unique index accepts any number of rows without a slug.
- *Back-fill of existing rows:* every existing work needs a slug derived from its name with the transliteration, the 60-character cut and the per-profile suffixing — none of which is decided. Two shapes have precedents: inside the migration in SQL (as `0019`, `drizzle/0019_works_position.sql:6-13`) — then the transliteration is written once in SQL and once in the TypeScript `slugify` that new works use, and the two must agree; or a one-off script per environment (as `scripts/backfill-file-keys.ts:8-22`) — then the column cannot be `NOT NULL` before the script has run in that environment. No extension is installed that a SQL back-fill could lean on (no `CREATE EXTENSION` in `drizzle/*.sql`).
- *What `NOT NULL` + unique without a default does to every insert path:*
  - the back-fill has to finish in the same migration before `SET NOT NULL`, or that statement fails on the existing rows;
  - from then on the previous container (between migration and `up`) and any rolled-back image fail **every work add**: `createWork`'s insert names no `slug` (`src/lib/works.ts:357-362`), the not-null violation is not a `WorksError`, so `respondWithWorkResult` rethrows it and `POST /api/works` answers 500 (`src/app/api/works/respond.ts:11-26`);
  - `e2e/db/seed-works.ts` writes works with raw SQL that bypasses `createWork` (`e2e/db/seed-works.ts:86-88,104-106`), so it fails until it invents slugs itself; it also returns only `{ id, name }` (`e2e/db/seed-works.ts:11-14`), so a test cannot navigate to `/{handle}/{slug}` from what it seeded;
  - `scripts/seed-profiles.ts` adds works through `createWork` (`scripts/seed-profiles.ts:543-548`), and so do the unit tests (`src/lib/works.test.ts:76-359`, `src/lib/r360/frame-set.test.ts:356-850`) — they follow whatever `createWork` does;
  - `updateWork` must not rewrite the slug (permalink), but it shares `workColumnsOf` with `createWork` (`src/lib/works.ts:359,487`), so the slug cannot simply join that function.
- *Add-only reading of the rollback rule:* a nullable column (with the unique index) is invisible to the image serving today; a later `SET NOT NULL` would be the contract step, taken only once no deployable image lacks slug generation — and the canary does not catch it (see the rollout rule above). Whether to take that path or accept `NOT NULL` in one step is a decision, not stated in any source.

**`works.card_layout`**
- *Exists:* nothing. The schema uses both styles for closed sets: Postgres enums (`place_kind`, `file_kind`, `src/db/schema.ts:422,462`) and text + CHECK elsewhere.
- *Rules:* enum `cover | cover-thumbs | cover-text`, default `cover-thumbs`, "backend change, say so in the PR" (`design/docs/claude-code-prompt-195.md:93`). A disabled choice (fewer than 3 photos / no description) falls back to `cover` on save (`design/docs/claude-code-prompt-195.md:155`; `design/ui_kits/public-web/WorkPage.jsx:151-152`).
- *Missing:* the column + default; `cardLayout` in `workInputSchema` (`src/lib/work-schemas.ts:24-88`) and in `workColumnsOf`; whether the server re-applies the fallback rule or trusts the client is not stated; read in `listWorks` for the profile card.
- *Back-fill note:* with the default `cover-thumbs`, every existing work with fewer than 3 photos gets a value the editor shows as disabled (today's maximum is 3 photos, `src/lib/work-schemas.ts:12`).
- *Nullability and default:* the default is stated (`cover-thumbs`, `design/docs/claude-code-prompt-195.md:93`), nullability is not. `NOT NULL` with that default is the `0019` shape (`drizzle/0019_works_position.sql:2`): existing rows receive the default when the column is added, so no separate back-fill statement, and the image serving today keeps inserting. A nullable column would need a reader rule for NULL. The kit's new work starts at `cover`, not at the column default (Q-G10).
- *Enum or text + CHECK:* a new Postgres enum is `CREATE TYPE`, which the canary does not match, but a value added later is `ALTER TYPE … ADD VALUE`, which the canary lists (`src/db/schema.test.ts:394-396` accepts it only for `file_kind`) and which can never be removed (`SPEC.md:517-518`; `src/db/schema.test.ts:374-377`). A text column with a CHECK changes its set by dropping and re-adding the constraint, which the canary also lists.
- *Insert and update paths:* the previous image is unaffected with a default. `updateWork` rewrites the column on every save once it is in `workColumnsOf` — see "Full-replacement save" above for bodies that omit it.

**`works.r360_autorotate`**
- *Exists:* nothing; `r360_params` jsonb holds frame count, direction, frames per width, start frame, flattening, cues (`src/db/schema.ts:482-491`), with `works_r360_set_pairing` (`src/db/schema.ts:320-323`).
- *Rules:* boolean, default false; the orbit turns slowly (≈ 25 s per turn) until grabbed; off under reduced motion; one autorotating orbit per page (`design/docs/claude-code-prompt-195.md:99`). The switch appears only when the work has an orbit (`design/ui_kits/public-web/WorkPage.jsx:202`).
- *Missing:* the column; `r360Autorotate` in `workInputSchema` and `workColumnsOf`; read in `listWorks` (orbit view, `src/lib/works.ts:192-204`). Whether it is cleared or kept when the set is removed, and whether it must be false without a set (a CHECK like the pairing rule), is not stated. It is a column, not a key inside `r360_params` (whose Zod schema `r360ParamsSchema` is shared with the frame pipeline, `src/lib/work-schemas.ts:2-5`), per prompt-195's column name.
- *Nullability and default:* default false is stated (`design/docs/claude-code-prompt-195.md:99`), nullability is not. `NOT NULL DEFAULT false` fills existing rows at `ADD COLUMN` (no back-fill statement) and is invisible to the image serving today; a nullable boolean would carry three states. The kit keeps the flag inside the orbit object (`orbit: { poster, autorotate: true, cues }`, `design/ui_kits/public-web/data.js:17`) and sets it to true when a zip is added (Q-G08), so existing works with a set would start differently from a kit-made one.
- *Where the reader carries it:* `WorkOrbitView` (`src/lib/works.ts:71-76`) exists only when the work has a set, `WorkView` (`src/lib/works.ts:78-92`) always — not stated which.

**`works.description`**
- *Exists:* nothing.
- *Rules:* optional text; prompt-195 §4.2 says ≤ 600 characters (`design/docs/claude-code-prompt-195.md:100`, repeated as the proposal in §8 at `:200`); prompt-195 §5.3 and the kit say a 300-character textarea (`design/docs/claude-code-prompt-195.md:154`; `design/ui_kits/public-web/WorkPage.jsx:195-196`) — Q-G05. The card clamps it to 2 lines (6 in `cover-text`) (`design/docs/claude-code-prompt-195.md:100`); the page shows it in `--type-lead` (`design/ui_kits/public-web/WorkPage.jsx:216`).
- *Missing:* the column + `works_description_length` CHECK in the style of `works_investor_length` (`src/db/schema.ts:338-345`); a `WORK_DESCRIPTION_MAX` constant beside `WORK_NAME_MAX` / `WORK_PARTY_MAX` (`src/lib/work-schemas.ts:10-11`); `description` in `workInputSchema` (empty → NULL as `investor`, `src/lib/works.ts:276-277`); read in `listWorks`; used by `generateMetadata` (`design/docs/claude-code-prompt-195.md:137`).
- *Unstated:* line breaks. `partySchema`'s rule refuses control characters, newline included (`src/lib/work-schemas.ts:15-22`); the bio has a newline-allowing variant (`src/lib/profile-schemas.ts:15-16,46-56`); the kit's textarea accepts newlines and the page renders without `pre-line`.
- *Nullability and default:* "optional" (`design/docs/claude-code-prompt-195.md:100`) — a nullable text column with no default, following the product's rule that empty text is stored as NULL (`src/lib/works.ts:276-277` for the parties; `src/lib/profile.ts:211,213` for headline and bio). Existing rows get NULL; no back-fill; invisible to the image serving today.
- *The CHECK and the undecided limit:* the length CHECK carries a literal that `src/db/schema.test.ts:305-330` pins to the Zod constant, so it cannot be written until 300 versus 600 is settled (Q-G05). A CHECK tightened later fails on any stored row longer than the new limit; one loosened later means dropping and re-adding the constraint, which the canary lists (`src/db/schema.test.ts:365-405`).

**`profiles.avatar_shape`**
- *Exists:* nothing. `profiles` has `display_name`, `handle`, `handle_changed_at`, `avatar_file_id`, `headline`, `locations`, `bio`, `cover_file_id` (`src/db/schema.ts:185-217`).
- *Rules:* `"circle" | "square"`, default circle; every avatar of the profile follows it — page avatar, panel copy, account-menu avatar on the profile and on the work page (B5, `design/docs/handoff/00-decyzje-2026-09-14.md:27`; `design/components/profile/AboutPanel.d.ts:17-18`; `design/ui_kits/public-web/WorkPage.jsx:166`). Set by the square/circle toggle in identity editing and saved with ✓ together with name, headline, bio, places (`design/ui_kits/public-web/PublicProfile.jsx:116`; `design/components/profile/AboutPanel.jsx:187`).

Today no route accepts it: `POST /api/profile` takes only `{ displayName }` (`src/app/api/profile/route.ts:16`), `POST /api/profile/sections` takes a partial `{ headline, locations, bio }` (`src/app/api/profile/sections/route.ts:34`; `src/lib/profile-schemas.ts:79-85`). Which route and schema gain `avatarShape` is not stated. It must also be read into `PublicProfile` (`src/lib/public-profile.ts:14-30`) and into whatever feeds the signed-in viewer's own avatar in `AccountMenu`.

Existing rows receive the default at `ADD COLUMN`; enum versus text + CHECK has the same canary consequences as `card_layout`.
- *Insert paths:* the profile row is created by upsert in `updateDisplayName` (`src/lib/profile.ts:185-196`) and `setHandle` (`src/lib/profile-handle.ts:250-266`), and directly in tests (`src/db/seed.test.ts:446,490`; `src/lib/profile-handle.test.ts:102`). None names the column, so a default keeps all of them — and registration and onboarding on the image serving today — working; `NOT NULL` without a default would make the first profile write fail.

The share images: `GET /api/og/{handle}` draws a square monogram (`src/app/api/og/[handle]/route.tsx:60-80`; `D-PROFILE-5`, `docs/ui-specification.md:2963`) and `profileMetadata` uses the 512 px avatar as `og:image` (`src/lib/public-profile.ts:186-188`); whether B5's "everywhere the same shape" reaches share images is not stated.

**To decide before the migrations are written** (no source settles these; listed, not answered):
1. `works.slug`: nullable first and `NOT NULL` later, or `NOT NULL` in one step (and what the image serving during the deployment window does then); transliteration of Polish letters; the 60-character cut; the suffix scheme for equal slugs within a profile; the slug of a name with no ASCII letters; back-fill in SQL inside `0020` or by a script; reserved slugs (`new`); whether the owner can ever change a slug; whether the unique index joins the guarded list.
2. `works.card_layout`: Postgres enum or text + CHECK; `NOT NULL` or nullable; default `cover-thumbs` (prompt-195) versus `cover` for a new work (kit); whether the server re-applies the fallback for a disabled layout; what existing works with fewer than 3 photos should show.
3. `works.r360_autorotate`: `NOT NULL` or nullable; default false (prompt-195) versus true on adding a zip (kit); kept or cleared when the set is removed; a CHECK tying it to `r360_set_id` or not; whether it travels on the work or on the orbit view.
4. `works.description`: 300 or 600 characters; line breaks allowed or not.
5. `profiles.avatar_shape`: enum or text + CHECK; `NOT NULL` or nullable; which route and schema write it; which pull request ships it (not in prompt-195's PR 5 list); whether share images follow it.
6. All three work fields: required in `workInputSchema` or defaulted, given that `PATCH` is a full replacement and today's form keeps sending bodies without them until the edit mode replaces it.

**Also affected if the photo limit changes** (Q-G04): `work_images_position_range` CHECK `0–2` (`src/db/schema.ts:391-394`; `drizzle/0010_profile_sections.sql:23`), `WORK_PHOTOS_MAX = 3` (`src/lib/work-schemas.ts:12`), `IMAGE_MAX_BYTES` 10 MiB (`src/lib/image-upload-shared.ts:10`), A12 (`SPEC.md:63`), `SPEC.md` §9 "`position` 0–2" (`SPEC.md:492-493`).

**Contradictions touching this part (section 6):** Q-B01 — Icon sizes outside the allowed 16/18/20/24 set; Q-C01 — Profile bar side padding on a phone: 12 or 16 px; Q-C02 — Work page bar: empty right slot and a different account trigger; Q-C03 — Account menu in the work page's edit-mode bar; Q-F05 — Ring in the lightbox on a phone; Q-G01 — Work page main column gap: 40/24 versus 48/32 px; Q-G02 — Work page header gap on a phone: 20 versus 16 px; Q-G03 — Gap between pictures on the work page: 24/16 versus 20/12 px; Q-G04 — Photos per work: 1–3 at 10 MB versus ten or unlimited at 20 MB; Q-G05 — Work description limit: 300 versus 600 characters; Q-G06 — Work delete: extended confirmation versus delete on first press; Q-G07 — Photo removal: „with its confirmation” versus no confirmation; Q-G08 — Autorotate for a newly added orbit: off versus on; Q-G09 — Autorotate switch says „na profilu”; the work page obeys it too; Q-G10 — Card layout of a new work: „cover-thumbs” versus „cover”; Q-G12 — Photo reorder: HTML drag-and-drop versus pointer events (D-PROFILE-11); Q-G14 — Two h1 elements on the work page; Q-G15 — Pictures uploaded in edit mode after „Anuluj”: kept or discarded; Q-I03 — Work description hint: with or without „Do 300 znaków.”

### 3.3 Homepage hero, 404, error screen

Scope of this part: the homepage (`/`, `/en`), the localized 404 (`src/app/[locale]/not-found.tsx`, reached also through the catch-all `src/app/[locale]/[...rest]/page.tsx`) and the new error screen (`[locale]/error.tsx` + `global-error.tsx`). Sources that decide the target: `design/docs/claude-code-prompt-195.md` (13.09) §3.1, §3.2, §6.1, §6.5, §6.6, overridden where they differ by `design/docs/handoff/00-decyzje-2026-09-14.md` (`design/docs/handoff/00-decyzje-2026-09-14.md:3`); measurements from `design/ui_kits/public-web/Hero.jsx` and `design/ui_kits/public-web/NotFound.jsx`. The 14.09 decisions leave §6 ("re-skin reszty") untouched (`design/docs/handoff/00-decyzje-2026-09-14.md:50`), so §6.1, §6.5 and §6.6 of prompt-195 stand.

**Phone homepage and decision A6 — explicit answer.** A6 ("Telefon: wszystko pod jednym triggerem", hamburger → „Polski / English, ─, Zaloguj się, Załóż konto”, 224 px popover, 44 px items) sits in section „A. Pasek — `ProfileBar`” and cites `design/ui_kits/public-web/PublicProfile.jsx` `Popover`, `MenuItem`, `AccountMenu`, `VisitorMenu` as its source (`design/docs/handoff/00-decyzje-2026-09-14.md:5`, `design/docs/handoff/00-decyzje-2026-09-14.md:14`). The homepage reference does **not** use it: `HomeBar` on a phone keeps a hamburger that opens a white card with the language chip and two full-width buttons (`design/ui_kits/public-web/Hero.jsx:60`, `design/ui_kits/public-web/Hero.jsx:69-85`), and prompt-195 says „Homepage keeps its `TopBar` `onPhoto` + `MobileMenu` (D-SHELL-6)” (`design/docs/claude-code-prompt-195.md:62`). So the phone homepage **keeps MobileMenu**; A6 does not apply to it. A5 (the `LanguageChip` with flags) does apply, because A5 takes that chip from `design/ui_kits/public-web/Hero.jsx` `LanguageChip`, `Flag` (`design/docs/handoff/00-decyzje-2026-09-14.md:13`). The reference renders `<header>` but inside `<main>` (`design/ui_kits/public-web/Hero.jsx:94-97`) and has no skip link. Today: bar is a `<div>` inside `<main>` (`src/app/[locale]/(public)/page.tsx:69`, `src/app/[locale]/(public)/page.tsx:114`; F-SHELL-8 `docs/ui-specification.md:360`).

**Behaviour per viewer.**
- signed-out (including a session that cannot be verified): the page above. Links: logo → `/`; „Zaloguj się” → `/login`; „Załóż konto” (bar and hero) → `/register`; chip → same path in the other locale (`docs/ui-specification.md:206-252`, `docs/ui-specification.md:520`).
- signed-in with handle → 307 `/{handle}`; no handle → 307 `/onboarding` — unchanged (`src/app/[locale]/(public)/page.tsx:35-36`).
- Popovers must gain F-SHELL-13 focus handling (focus to first item on open, Escape/outside press returns focus to the trigger, arrow keys inside `role="menu"`) (`design/docs/claude-code-prompt-195.md:70`); the reference implements none of it (`design/ui_kits/public-web/Hero.jsx:25-31`, `design/ui_kits/public-web/Hero.jsx:70`, `design/ui_kits/public-web/Hero.jsx:79-84`).
- Motion: no entrance animation; transitions through `--transition-control` only (`design/ui_kits/public-web/Hero.jsx:35`; `design/docs/claude-code-prompt-195.md:187`).

**The kit's two pages: `design/ui_kits/public-web/index.html` and `design/ui_kits/public-web/shots.html`.** `design/ui_kits/public-web/Hero.jsx` and `design/ui_kits/public-web/NotFound.jsx` do not route anywhere themselves. Two pages in the kit mount them.
- `design/ui_kits/public-web/index.html` is the interactive demo.
  - It mounts the hero as `<window.Hero onGo={go} locale={t.locale} onLocale={…} phone={phone} />` (`design/ui_kits/public-web/index.html:53`).
  - Its `go` turns the screen names `"register"` and `"login"` into `"hero"`, then scrolls to the top (`design/ui_kits/public-web/index.html:44-45`).
  - The hero calls `onGo("login")` for „Zaloguj się” and `onGo("register")` for „Załóż konto” in three places: the desktop bar (`design/ui_kits/public-web/Hero.jsx:74-75`), the phone panel (`design/ui_kits/public-web/Hero.jsx:82-83`) and the two calls to action (`design/ui_kits/public-web/Hero.jsx:103-104`). So every „Zaloguj się” and „Załóż konto” click in the kit sends the viewer back to the hero.
  - The kit has no log-in or sign-up screen (switcher entries „Profil”, „Realizacja”, „Hero”, „404”, `design/ui_kits/public-web/index.html:62-66`). The destinations `/login` and `/register` come from the spec (`docs/ui-specification.md:206-252`), not from the kit.
  - The demo opens on the profile (`design/ui_kits/public-web/index.html:36`); the hero is reached through the switcher's „Hero” button (`design/ui_kits/public-web/index.html:63-64`).
  - The locale is the Tweaks panel's „Język” setting (`design/ui_kits/public-web/index.html:72`, default `"pl"` at `design/ui_kits/public-web/index.html:27`). A pick in the hero's chip writes it back (`design/ui_kits/public-web/index.html:53`).
- `design/ui_kits/public-web/shots.html` is the deterministic stage for reference screenshots, driven by `window.__shot({...})` (`design/ui_kits/public-web/shots.html:19-20`).
  - It mounts the hero and the 404 with `locale={s.locale}`, `phone={phone}` and a no-op `onGo` (`design/ui_kits/public-web/shots.html:30-31`). `window.__shot` fills in `locale: "pl"` only when the argument gives none (`design/ui_kits/public-web/shots.html:37`), so the stage accepts an English hero and an English 404.
  - `design/docs/handoff/shots/matrix.json` never passes one for these pages: `hero_desktop`, `hero_phone`, `404_desktop` and `404_phone` carry only `page` and `screen` (`design/docs/handoff/shots/matrix.json:35-38`). The one shot with `"locale": "en"` is the owner's profile (`design/docs/handoff/shots/matrix.json:21`).
  - The hero shots have no `actions` either (`design/docs/handoff/shots/matrix.json:35-36`). The two shots that open a language list and a hamburger, `menu_jezyk_desktop` and `menu_hamburger_phone`, render the default page, the profile (`design/docs/handoff/shots/matrix.json:22`, `design/docs/handoff/shots/matrix.json:25`, `design/ui_kits/public-web/shots.html:37`).

**`<title>`.** Stays the layout default „Architektów 3d” (`src/app/[locale]/layout.tsx:20`; `e2e/i18n.spec.ts:9`). The title template of F-SHELL-2 (`{page} · Architektów 3d`, `design/docs/claude-code-prompt-195.md:182`) needs a `title.default`, which the homepage keeps.

#### Error screen — `src/app/[locale]/error.tsx` and `global-error.tsx` (new)

**Layout.** No reference component and no reference screenshot exist. prompt-195 places it „in the 404's frame (D-SHELL-13 split with the facade photo)” (`design/docs/claude-code-prompt-195.md:185`), so every measurement is the 404's (above, `design/ui_kits/public-web/NotFound.jsx:10-21`): `<main>` padding 16 / 48 px, card max 560 px, one column on a phone / two columns on desktop, radius `--radius-picture`, photo panel 160 / 340 px with `object-position: 96% 42%` and the bottom-up gradient, text panel gap 16 px and padding 24×20 / 48 px. In the text panel:
- heading `Error.title` — pl „Coś poszło nie tak” · en "Something went wrong" (`design/docs/claude-code-prompt-195.md:185`); by analogy with the 404 an `<h1>` in `--type-h2` (`design/ui_kits/public-web/NotFound.jsx:18`) — not stated in prompt-195;
- body `Error.body` — pl „Spróbuj ponownie za chwilę. Jeśli to się powtarza, napisz do nas.” · en "Try again in a moment. If it keeps happening, write to us." (`design/docs/claude-code-prompt-195.md:185`);
- button „Spróbuj ponownie” (`Error.retry`) that re-runs the segment, and „the 404's home link” (`NotFound.homeLink` „Wróć do domu” · "Back home", `messages/pl.json:454`, `messages/en.json:454`) (`design/docs/claude-code-prompt-195.md:185`).

**Behaviour.**
- `[locale]/error.tsx` renders inside `LocaleLayout` and its `NextIntlClientProvider` (`src/app/[locale]/layout.tsx:63-69`), so it can read both dictionaries. An error boundary must be a client component and does not wrap the `layout.js` of its own segment (`node_modules/next/dist/docs/01-app/03-api-reference/03-file-conventions/error.md:21`, `node_modules/next/dist/docs/01-app/03-api-reference/03-file-conventions/error.md:96`), so an error thrown by `LocaleLayout` itself reaches only `global-error`.
- `global-error.tsx` replaces the root layout: it must render its own `<html>` and `<body>`, does not receive global styles, and cannot export `metadata`/`generateMetadata` (a React `<title>` instead) (`node_modules/next/dist/docs/01-app/03-api-reference/03-file-conventions/error.md:163-167`). prompt-195: it must not depend on the intl provider; both dictionaries' strings inlined (`design/docs/claude-code-prompt-195.md:185`).
- Case that reaches it today: the profile page rethrows every database/storage error other than a missing profile ("Everything else must surface as a 500", `docs/ui-specification.md:148`, `docs/ui-specification.md:175`).
- Viewers: prompt-195 does not distinguish signed-out and signed-in; the home link's target for a signed-in viewer on the 404 comes from the server-only `signedInDestination()` (`src/lib/signed-in-destination.ts:1`, `src/lib/signed-in-destination.ts:15-17`), which a client error boundary cannot call.

**What is deleted.** Nothing — new view.

**Findings resolved.** F-SHELL-3, remaining half: „no `error.tsx`/`global-error.tsx`” (`docs/ui-specification.md:175`; `design/docs/claude-code-prompt-195.md:192`).

**Open points.**
1. `Error.retry` has only the Polish label „Spróbuj ponownie” in prompt-195 (`design/docs/claude-code-prompt-195.md:185`); A8 needs an English string.
2. Which language `global-error.tsx` shows (no `[locale]` param, no provider) — not stated.
3. Home link target for signed-in viewers inside a client boundary (see Behaviour) — not stated.
4. Icon for the text panel: the 404 has `map-pin-off` (`design/ui_kits/public-web/NotFound.jsx:17`); nothing is named for the error screen (`design/readme.md:175-180` lists `triangle-alert` in the vocabulary without assigning it).

6. Key naming: prompt-195 calls the heading `Error.title`, while the existing convention is `NotFound.title` = document `<title>` and `NotFound.heading` = `<h1>` (`messages/pl.json:452-453`). The error screen's `<title>` text is not given.
7. `global-error.tsx` location: prompt-195 writes „`src/app/[locale]/error.tsx` + `global-error.tsx`” (`design/docs/claude-code-prompt-195.md:47`); Next documents `global-error` in the root app directory (`node_modules/next/dist/docs/01-app/03-api-reference/03-file-conventions/error.md:163`); the repository has no `src/app/layout.tsx` (`docs/ui-specification.md:98`).

### 3.4 Auth screens, onboarding, settings

Scope: the seven auth routes (`/login`, `/register`, `/register/verified`, `/reset-password`, `/reset-password/new`, `/two-factor`, `/email-changed`), `/onboarding`, `/settings/account`, `/settings/profile`. English paths shown unprefixed; every route also exists under `/en` (docs/ui-specification.md:106-121).

**Governing rules for these screens.**

- prompt-195 §6 says these screens are "re-skinned, structure kept" (design/docs/claude-code-prompt-195.md:179), and §3.1 lists "Homepage, auth, onboarding, settings, 404" as "unchanged · re-skinned" (design/docs/claude-code-prompt-195.md:46). The structural additions it does ask for are the bars, the language chip and the skip link (design/docs/claude-code-prompt-195.md:63-66), plus a title template (design/docs/claude-code-prompt-195.md:182).
- The 14.09 decisions do not name any of these screens. Section E keeps "re-skin reszty (§6)" (re-skin of the rest) untouched (design/docs/handoff/00-decyzje-2026-09-14.md:50). Decisions A5/A6 (`LanguageChip` on desktop for every viewer; on a phone everything under one avatar/hamburger trigger; popover 224 px, items 44 px) are written for `ProfileBar` (design/docs/handoff/00-decyzje-2026-09-14.md:13-14). Whether the settings and onboarding bars follow A6 on a phone is not said (open point O-BAR-1 below).
- The app kit (`design/ui_kits/app/`) is a snapshot of the product "as shipped (atlas 12.09.2026)" (design/ui_kits/app/AccountSettings.jsx:1-3) or "exactly as the product's (auth) routes render them" (design/ui_kits/app/Auth.jsx:2-3). It does **not** contain the §3.2 additions (the auth language chip, the onboarding bar, the settings `LanguageChip` and account menu, the skip link); the settings kit does draw a bar, but with a bare avatar only (design/ui_kits/app/AccountSettings.jsx:68-72). Yet it differs from the product's structure in a number of places. The contradictions among these places are listed in section 6 and are not resolved here.
- Reference shots exist for only nine of these states: `app_login_desktop`, `app_login_phone`, `app_rejestracja_desktop`, `app_2fa_email_desktop`, `app_2fa_aplikacja_desktop`, `app_onboarding_desktop`, `app_onboarding_phone`, `app_ustawienia-konta_desktop`, `app_ustawienia-konta_phone` (design/docs/handoff/shots/matrix.json:39-47). The stage is 1440×900 for desktop and 390×844 for phone (design/ui_kits/app/shots.html:5-6). The kit screens declare no narrow-screen rules of their own, so the phone shots render the desktop values in a 390 px box. No kit screen exists for `/register/verified`, `/reset-password`, `/reset-password/new`, `/email-changed`, onboarding step two, or any settings sub-state beyond the static form. Those states are re-skinned from the product's own structure.
- Dev screenshots of today's product (12.09.2026) exist for: `v-login--desktop`, `v-login--phone`, `v-register--desktop`, `v-register--phone`, `v-register-verified--desktop`, `v-reset-request--desktop`, `v-reset-request--phone`, `v-reset-new--desktop`, `v-two-factor--desktop`, `v-email-changed--desktop`, `v-settings-account--desktop`, `v-settings-account--phone` (design/uploads/atlas/). There is no atlas screenshot of `/onboarding` at any width, and no phone screenshot of `/register/verified`, `/reset-password/new`, `/two-factor` or `/email-changed`.
- Data migrations: none of these screens reads `works.slug`, `works.card_layout`, `works.r360_autorotate`, `works.description` or `profiles.avatar_shape` (`src/db/schema.ts` has none of those columns today). The only possible exception is the avatar in the settings and onboarding account menu: decision B5 says the same avatar shape is used everywhere, but it names only "avatar w menu konta (profil i strona realizacji)" (the account-menu avatar on the profile and work pages) (design/docs/handoff/00-decyzje-2026-09-14.md:27). The kit's `AccountMenu` trigger reads `profile.avatarShape` (design/ui_kits/public-web/PublicProfile.jsx:74-75). See open point O-BAR-2.

#### Shared frame of the seven auth routes (C-AUTH-SHELL)

**Layout top to bottom — today** (`src/app/[locale]/(auth)/shell.ts`):

1. `<main>` (the only landmark): `min-height: 100svh`, content centred on both axes, `--surface-page`. Side padding 16 px below `sm` / 24 px from `sm`; vertical padding 24 px at every width (`src/app/[locale]/(auth)/shell.ts:15-16`).
2. Column: full width up to `--measure-form` (28rem), items centred. Gap 16 px below `sm` / 20 px from `sm` (`src/app/[locale]/(auth)/shell.ts:20-21`).
   1. Compact logo, a `<span>` (not a link, not focusable). Mark 26 px + wordmark `type-h4`, gap 8 px / 12 px from `sm` (`src/components/ui/logo-mark.tsx:28-29, 36, 45`).
   2. Card `padding="lg"`: 40 px below `sm` / 48 px from `sm` (`src/components/ui/card.tsx:24`). Radius `rounded-md` (8 px, `src/app/globals.css:75`), hairline border (`src/components/ui/card.tsx:40`). Holds the `<h1>`: `type-h1`, font size `--fs-h2` below `sm`, `--fs-h1` from `sm` (`src/app/[locale]/(auth)/shell.ts:30-31`). Then the screen's content.
   3. Footer line: centred `type-sm` muted paragraph with one link (on some screens only, F-AUTH-1).
3. Buttons get `min-height: 48px` below `sm` and fall back to 40 px from `sm` (`src/app/[locale]/(auth)/shell.ts:38, 41`). Text fields are 48 px at every width (docs/ui-specification.md:745).

**Layout top to bottom — reference** (`AuthShell`, design/ui_kits/app/Auth.jsx:6-22). The kit gives one set of values for every width:

1. Page: `--surface-page`, `min-height: 100%`, flex centre on both axes. Padding `var(--sp-12) var(--sp-7)` = 64 px top/bottom, 24 px sides (design/ui_kits/app/Auth.jsx:8; design/tokens/spacing.css:5).
2. Column: `width: 100%`, `max-width: var(--measure-form)` = 28rem, flex column, gap `--sp-6` = 20 px (design/ui_kits/app/Auth.jsx:9; design/tokens/spacing.css:5,7). Items are not centred, so the card and footer take the full column width.
   1. Logo row, centred, gap `--sp-3` = 8 px. Mark 30×30 px, `--radius-xs` (8 px), `--plaque-navy`, "A3D" 12 px bold, red band 12 % high at the bottom. Wordmark „Architektów 3d” in `--type-h3`, `--ls-heading`, `--text-strong` (design/ui_kits/app/Auth.jsx:10-13; design/tokens/radius.css:5). Size differs from today's compact logo (Q-H05).
   2. `Card padding="lg"` = `--card-pad-lg` = 48 px (design/components/core/Card.jsx:3; design/tokens/spacing.css:6). White, 1 px `--border-default`, `--radius-card` = 16 px, no shadow at rest (design/components/core/Card.jsx:13-17; design/tokens/radius.css:6). `<h1>` in `--type-h1` (750, 2rem/1.28), `--ls-heading`, `--text-strong` at every width (design/ui_kits/app/Auth.jsx:15; design/tokens/typography.css:31).
   3. Footer node (per screen): `<p>` `--type-sm`, centred; on login and register the `<p>` is `--text-muted` (design/ui_kits/app/Auth.jsx:39, 78), on two-factor the `<p>` has no colour and its only child is a `muted` TextLink (design/ui_kits/app/Auth.jsx:112).
3. Form inside the card: `margin-top: --sp-7` = 24 px, flex column, gap `--sp-5` = 16 px (design/ui_kits/app/Auth.jsx:44, 83). This equals today's `mt-(--sp-7) gap-(--sp-5)` (`src/app/[locale]/(auth)/login/login-form.tsx:98`). Field: label `--type-label`, gap `--field-gap` = 4 px (design/components/forms/FormField.jsx:5-7; design/tokens/spacing.css:6). Input height `--field-h` = 48 px, `--radius-control` = 12 px (design/components/forms/Input.jsx:32-35; design/tokens/spacing.css:14). Submit: `Button fullWidth`, size `md` = `--control-h` 40 px, `--radius-control`, weight 650 (design/components/core/Button.jsx:4, 64-70). No 48 px phone floor in the kit (Q-H06).
4. **Not in the kit, required by prompt-195:**
   - Language chip under the card, right-aligned, card tone (design/docs/claude-code-prompt-195.md:64). The reference chip is `LanguageChip` in design/ui_kits/public-web/Hero.jsx:20-49. Trigger 40 px tall, padding `0 var(--sp-4)` (0 12 px), gap 8 px, `--radius-control`, `--type-sm` at weight `--fw-medium`, `--text-body` in card tone, hover `--surface-active`. Flag 18×12 px, radius 2 (design/ui_kits/public-web/Hero.jsx:14). Chevron-down 14 px. List `role="listbox"`, `position: absolute; top: calc(100% + 6px); right: 0; min-width: 160px`, padding 4 px, `--radius-card`, `--shadow-lift`, `z-index: 5`. Options 40 px, the current one `--surface-sunken` and semibold (design/ui_kits/public-web/Hero.jsx:34-46). It closes on an outside press and on Escape (design/ui_kits/public-web/Hero.jsx:25-31).
   - Skip link „Przejdź do treści” · "Skip to content" (new key `Shell.skipToContent`) as the first focusable element (design/docs/claude-code-prompt-195.md:66). On these screens there is no bar, so it precedes `<main>`.
   - Tab title template `{page} · Architektów 3d` in `LocaleLayout` (design/docs/claude-code-prompt-195.md:182). Today `LocaleLayout` sets a plain title with no template (`src/app/[locale]/layout.tsx:20`).

**Behaviour per viewer.** Unchanged: every viewer, signed in or not, sees every auth screen (F-SHELL-1 kept with a reason, design/docs/claude-code-prompt-195.md:192). The logo stays non-focusable (D-AUTH-6).

**Deleted / moved / kept.** `AUTH-SHELL.header.logo` is kept (its size is Q-H05). Footer lines are kept. Nothing is deleted. Added: the language chip, the skip link and the title template.

**Findings resolved.** F-SHELL-2 and F-AUTH-16 (title template, design/docs/claude-code-prompt-195.md:182). F-SHELL-4 and F-AUTH-2 (language switch on auth). F-SHELL-8 (skip link). All others in §5 stay open unless the rebuild makes them trivial (design/docs/claude-code-prompt-195.md:192): F-AUTH-1 (missing footer lines), F-AUTH-3 (text links without a touch floor), F-AUTH-5 (silent client errors), F-AUTH-6 (focus lost on result swaps).

**Open points.**

- O-AUTH-1: where the chip goes relative to the footer line (both are "under the card"; the footer line is centred, the chip right-aligned). Also which way its list opens when the column sits at the bottom of a short viewport.
- O-AUTH-2: which title `/register/verified` gets under the template. It has no `generateMetadata` today (`src/app/[locale]/(auth)/register/verified/page.tsx:1-95`) and no key is named.
- O-AUTH-3: the kit's Auth and Onboarding copy is English-only (`Auth.jsx`, `Onboarding.jsx` take no locale). The shot stage defaults to `locale: "pl"` (design/ui_kits/app/shots.html:32), so the reference shots `app_login_*`, `app_rejestracja_*`, `app_2fa_*` and `app_onboarding_*` show English text. Polish copy has to come from `messages/pl.json`.

#### /login

**Layout top to bottom.** The shared frame, then:

- Card: h1 `Login.heading` („Zaloguj się”); form with e-mail field, password field, form error (when any), not-verified block (when any), full-width submit, then the „Nie pamiętasz hasła?” link.
  - Today the link is muted and left-aligned (`src/app/[locale]/(auth)/login/login-form.tsx:173-175`).
  - Kit: the link sits in a `display: flex; justify-content: space-between` row, `--type-sm`, default `strong` tone (design/ui_kits/app/Auth.jsx:52-54; TextLink tone `strong` = `--text-strong`, weight 650, underline on hover, design/components/navigation/TextLink.jsx:4, 17-20). This is a tone difference only.
- Footer line: „Nie masz konta?” + link „Zarejestruj się” (`src/app/[locale]/(auth)/login/page.tsx:36-39`; kit design/ui_kits/app/Auth.jsx:39-41).
- Desktop vs phone: the kit gives one set of values (see the shared frame). Today the heading, gap, card padding, gutters and touch floor step down below `sm` (Q-H06).

**Behaviour.** Unchanged (validation on submit, busy label, 2FA redirect, not-verified resend) (`src/app/[locale]/(auth)/login/login-form.tsx:33-92`). The kit's busy label "Logging in…" (design/ui_kits/app/Auth.jsx:51) matches `Login.submitting`.

**Deleted / moved / kept.** All `LOGIN.*` elements kept. The not-verified block has no kit drawing and keeps today's structure.

**Findings.** None specific closes. F-AUTH-7 and F-AUTH-8 stay open.

**Open points.** None beyond the shared frame.

#### /register

**Layout top to bottom — form state.** Card: h1 `Register.heading` („Załóż konto”), then the form (e-mail; password with hint; form error; full-width submit). Footer: „Masz już konto?” + „Zaloguj się” (`src/app/[locale]/(auth)/register/page.tsx:32-39`, `register-form.tsx:108-171`). The kit draws the same form. The hint is under the field, `--type-sm`, `--text-subtle` (design/components/forms/FormField.jsx:18-20). Hint copy is "8 to 72 characters — no other requirements." (design/ui_kits/app/Auth.jsx:87) against the product's `{min} to {max}` with 8/128 (`messages/en.json:319`; SPEC.md:52).

**Layout top to bottom — sent state.**

- Today (`src/app/[locale]/(auth)/register/register-form.tsx:85-106`): h1 unchanged. Result block `margin-top: --sp-6`, gap `--sp-5`, containing an h2 in `type-h4` („Sprawdź skrzynkę”), the body with the address (`break-words`, `src/app/[locale]/(auth)/shell.ts:51`), the „Wyślij link ponownie” text button (48 px floor on a phone) and the resend status line. The footer line stays (`src/app/[locale]/(auth)/register/page.tsx:36-39`).
- Kit (design/ui_kits/app/Auth.jsx:63-72), a different structure:
  - `AuthShell heading="Check your inbox"`: the h1 changes and there is **no footer**.
  - Content `margin-top: --sp-6` (20 px), gap `--sp-5` (16 px).
  - `StatusMessage tone="info"` with "We sent an activation link to {email}. The link is valid for 24 hours.". It is a block with padding `--sp-4 --sp-5` (12/16 px), `--radius-control`, `--state-info-bg`, a 16 px `info` icon and `role="status"` (design/components/feedback/StatusMessage.jsx:4-9, 20-36).
  - `Button variant="quiet"` "I confirmed it — continue" → onboarding (design/ui_kits/app/Auth.jsx:68).
  - `TextLink tone="muted"` "Send the link again", which **returns to the form** (`setSent(false)`, design/ui_kits/app/Auth.jsx:69) instead of resending.

  See Q-H07.

**Behaviour.** Unchanged unless Q-H07 is decided otherwise: the sent state is component state, and the resend is capped at 3 per hour by the server (docs/ui-specification.md:1243-1244).

**Deleted / moved / kept.** Kept today: `REGISTER.form.*`, `REGISTER.sent.message`, `REGISTER.sent.resend`, `REGISTER.sent.status`, `REGISTER.footer.login`. Their fate in the sent state depends on Q-H07.

**Findings.** F-AUTH-10 (no way to correct the address) would be touched by the kit's "Send the link again → form" behaviour. It is not listed in prompt-195 §7. F-AUTH-11, F-AUTH-12 and F-AUTH-13 stay open.

**Open points.** O-REG-1: no phone shot of register and no shot of the sent state.

#### /two-factor

**Layout top to bottom — today** (`src/app/[locale]/(auth)/two-factor/two-factor-challenge.tsx:97-208`). Shared frame; card with h1 „Potwierdź logowanie”, then a column `margin-top: --sp-6`, gap `--sp-5`:

1. Method row, only when 2 or more modes are available: `role="group"`, wraps, gap `--sp-3`.
   - Pills „Aplikacja” (with a 16 px smartphone icon) and „Kod e-mail”: `rounded-sm` border, padding `--sp-1` vertical, 12 px sides below `sm` / 8 px from `sm`, 48 px floor below `sm`, `type-sm`. Selected pill: `--action-solid` border, sunken background, semibold (`two-factor-challenge.tsx:21-26, 99-136`).
   - „Kod zapasowy” as a muted text button (`two-factor-challenge.tsx:110-119`).
2. Intro paragraph per mode, `type-sm` muted (`two-factor-challenge.tsx:138`).
3. `otp` only: quiet button „Wyślij kod na e-mail” / „Wyślij kod ponownie”, then the success line „Kod wysłany — sprawdź skrzynkę.” (gap `--sp-1`) (`two-factor-challenge.tsx:140-161`).
4. Form, gap `--sp-5`: code field (monospace, `max-width: 140px`, disabled in `otp` until sent), error `<p role="alert">`, full-width submit (`two-factor-challenge.tsx:163-206`).
5. Footer: muted link „Wróć do logowania” (`src/app/[locale]/(auth)/two-factor/page.tsx:42-46`).

Modes come from `?methods=`: authenticator account → `totp, otp, backup`; e-mail account → `otp`; direct visit → all three (`src/app/[locale]/(auth)/two-factor/modes.ts:8-16`; the account-to-methods mapping is the spec's, docs/ui-specification.md:1791-1796).

**Layout top to bottom — reference** (design/ui_kits/app/Auth.jsx:96-140). Shared frame with the footer muted link "Back to login" (design/ui_kits/app/Auth.jsx:112). Content column `margin-top: --sp-6` (20 px), gap `--sp-5` (16 px) (design/ui_kits/app/Auth.jsx:114):

1. Method header: flex row, gap `--sp-3` (8 px). Icon 18 px, `strong` tone: `smartphone` (app), `mail` (e-mail) or `key-round` (backup). Label `--type-sm` at weight `--fw-semibold`, `--text-strong`: "Authenticator app" / "E-mail code" / "Backup code" (design/ui_kits/app/Auth.jsx:115-120). It is not a control.
2. Intro `--type-sm` muted:
   - totp "Enter the code from your authenticator app.";
   - otp "We sent a 6-digit code to your account's e-mail address.";
   - backup "Enter one of your backup codes." (design/ui_kits/app/Auth.jsx:104-108, 121).
3. `otp` only: `StatusMessage tone="info"` "Code sent — check your inbox." shown at once, with no send button before it (design/ui_kits/app/Auth.jsx:122).
4. `FormField` label "Code" / "Backup code". Input `mono`, `autoComplete="one-time-code"`, `maxWidth: 180` (design/ui_kits/app/Auth.jsx:123-125).
5. `Button fullWidth` "Confirm" (design/ui_kits/app/Auth.jsx:126).
6. Link row, flex, gap `--sp-6` (20 px), `--type-sm` (design/ui_kits/app/Auth.jsx:127-136):
   - `otp`: muted "Send the code again";
   - account method `totp`: muted "Use a backup code" ↔ "Back to the app code".
   - Per the comment, backup codes are "only an alternative to an app code — never to an e-mail one" (design/ui_kits/app/Auth.jsx:129-130). Per the header comment, "The factor was chosen long before this screen" (design/ui_kits/app/Auth.jsx:96-98).

The kit therefore offers **no e-mail-code option to an authenticator account** and **no explicit send step**. Structural difference: Q-H08.

**Behaviour per viewer.** Today, anyone can open the page. Signed in, the endpoints use the session (docs/ui-specification.md:1782-1787; F-AUTH-26). The kit models only the post-login challenge.

**Deleted / moved / kept (under prompt-195 §6 "structure kept").**

- Kept: `TWO-FACTOR.methods.group`, `.methods.pill`, `.methods.backup`, `.intro`, `.otp.send`, `.otp.status`, `.form.code`, `.form.error`, `.form.submit`, `.footer.back`.
- Under the kit's structure: `.methods.group` and `.methods.pill` would be dropped; `.methods.backup` would become a link row item; `.otp.send` would be dropped (replaced by a resend link); `.otp.status` would become a StatusMessage.
- e2e dependencies: `getByRole("button", { name: "Aplikacja" })`, `{ name: "Kod e-mail" }`, `{ name: "Kod zapasowy" }` (e2e/two-factor.spec.ts:37-42, 59, 82) and `{ name: "Wyślij kod na e-mail" }` (e2e/two-factor.spec.ts:62); the code field asserted disabled before sending (`getByLabel("Kod")`, e2e/two-factor.spec.ts:61) and the text „Kod wysłany — sprawdź skrzynkę.” appearing only after the press (e2e/two-factor.spec.ts:63-65). Not decided here.

**Findings.** None closed by prompt-195. The kit's single-factor model touches F-AUTH-18 (security issue #59, the e-mail code is accepted for authenticator accounts) and F-AUTH-21 (switching forgets the sent code). Neither is resolved here.

**Open points.** O-2FA-1: there is no phone shot. Today pills take the 48 px floor below `sm` (`src/app/[locale]/(auth)/two-factor/two-factor-challenge.tsx:21-22`); the kit has no pills.
